title: What the system is and how to read this package

sections.heading: What the system is and how to read this package
sections.html:
What the system is and how to read this package

Current status: S1.0 is the selected logical architecture. Complete contract consolidation and independent review remain active. This guide explains the intended system; it does not declare planning accepted, implementation started, provider accounts admitted or the system operational. Read durable state for the exact continuation point.

sections.heading: The intended transformation
sections.html:
The intended transformation

The founder directs a portfolio of businesses and complex projects through explicit purpose, constraints, commitments and accountable work. The system helps investigate opportunities, create products, conduct permitted marketing and sales, deliver actual service, support customers, manage money and institutional duties, learn, change direction and close responsibly. It carries work the founder cannot personally perform or observe while retaining the evidence and unresolved consequences needed to understand and stand behind it.

The unit of organization is a responsibility with an intended result, relevant authority, resources, evidence and surviving duties. A model is one possible performer. Deterministic software handles checks, arithmetic, state and scheduling; bounded model work helps investigate and produce; actual humans and professionals perform work requiring their competence, presence or legitimate authority. A generated report about delivery is never delivery.

Founder decisions, inferred preferences, system proposals and unknowns have distinct meanings. Original intent, changes of mind, rejected options and omissions remain inspectable. Accounts include attempted, failed, skipped, stale and unverified work. The system preserves uncertainty about why something happened instead of converting a plausible rationale into established cause.

sections.heading: How ordinary work proceeds
sections.html:
How ordinary work proceeds

Operator needIntended behavior and evidence
Explore an uncertain opportunityBound a question and resources; inspect customers and sources; preserve rival explanations and negative evidence. Authorized research can occur before a product or offer exists.
Create and offer somethingProduce and assess actual artifacts; establish capacity for the precise promise; assemble current acceptance evidence; release only permitted exposure. A limited pilot does not claim scale demand.
Sell and fulfillDistinguish agreement, payment, actual delivery and acceptance. Customer support, recurring service, refunds and records continue after an internal workflow ends.
Understand unobserved workReconstruct an account from authoritative records, context manifests, original evidence, judgments and omissions. The interface exposes what remains unknown or disputed.
Remain a capable ownerReserve authentic customer, taste, finance and intervention practice within consented attention limits. Test unfamiliar takeover; a declined practice is not a diagnosis of incapacity.
Pause, recover or closeStop new permitted effects, reconcile uncertain ones and continue due duties. Verify actual successor access, capacity and performance. Cancellation and exported packets do not discharge obligations.
Improve the systemPropose an evidenced change, assess risks and independent tests, stage its rollout and preserve a current rollback path. Ordinary producers cannot rewrite their own authority or acceptance history.

These paths are specified outcomes. Runtime conformance, sustainable attention, real customer value and reliable human continuity remain to be demonstrated.

sections.heading: Architecture and why it was selected
sections.html:
Architecture and why it was selected

The selected design combines common work and obligation control with bounded native production and protected authority, evidence and recovery mechanisms. Nine logical components have separate responsibilities; this does not require nine agents, people, services or computers.

ComponentResponsibility
C01 Direction and responsibilityPreserve purpose, choices, commitments, constraints and legitimate ownership
C02 Cases and schedulingManage work, dependencies, waiting, resources, interruption and continuation
C03 ProductionPerform bounded work through appropriate deterministic, model, human or external routes
C04 Authority and releaseCheck current consequence limits and exact intended effects before permitted execution
C05 Context and validitySupply authorized, current context with provenance, contradictions and omissions
C06 Evidence and acceptanceDistinguish attempts and observations from supported acceptance; preserve independent criteria and dependency invalidation
C07 Human and external responsibilityEstablish actual mandates, professional and service capacity, remedies, owner practice and continuity
C08 Recovery and continuityPreserve independently recoverable acknowledged state, reconcile uncertain effects and verify restored control
C09 Operator surfacesProject authoritative state into decisions, work, evidence, capacity, people, incidents and terminal interaction

The selection record explains the evidence, trade-offs and reopening conditions. The component contracts define owners, interfaces, state, boundaries, failures, evaluation, versioning and replacement.

The serious alternatives were a federated responsibility system and adaptive coordination, including a stronger candidate with compulsory inquiry rights. Their distinct control and information structures were independently attacked. S1 retains useful field responsibility, continuity, bounded discovery and context mechanisms without adopting a permanent departmental agent hierarchy. A smaller manual/native arrangement remains an eligible comparator. The selected design must lose if the simpler arrangement achieves the same duties and outcomes with less owner burden or if the added machinery cannot support useful ordinary work.

sections.heading: Authority, money and actual operation
sections.html:
Authority, money and actual operation

Autonomy follows possible consequence, reversibility, exposure, customer impact and repairability. Successful history can adjust review depth within an admitted boundary; it cannot silently raise the maximum consequence. Current authority is checked at use, and untrusted source material cannot become instruction or grant. Potential external effects keep their holds and reconciliation duties when acknowledgement is lost.

The internal model primarily uses authorized native Claude Code and Codex subscription environments. Provider identity, actual allowance, reset windows, scarce capacity and billing mode are distinct from money. Unknown internal provider usage stays unknown; observable job, process, time, output and network bounds remain enforceable construction targets. There is no silent switch to metered APIs or extra credits.

The economics worksheet and profiles include the reference AWS arrangement, a VPS alternative, a smaller comparator, storage, restore work, communications and professional/administrator/owner labor. These are dated estimates and explicit unknowns, not affordability findings or permission to purchase. Actual accounts, funding, jurisdiction-specific standing, service engagements and independent custodians are operating prerequisites. They do not require the founder to design the architecture or approve routine local construction.

sections.heading: Navigating the complete planning substance
sections.html:
Navigating the complete planning substance

Start with the 24-deliverable checklist. It maps each required planning family to its substantive locations and outstanding review status. The package index links the fourteen independent research lanes, primary-source audits, candidate attacks and specification documents. The decision ledger, risk register, source index and source-maintenance registers preserve their different evidence roles; a citation count is not verification.

The 566 original question joins, 62 supplemental concerns and 15 discovered cross-field concerns connect source wording to answers, contracts, decisions, uncertainty, accountable owners and planned implementation. Structural joins, substantive answers, planned discriminators, independent acceptance and executed results remain separate claims.

Construction follows the full twelve-stage dependency graph and implementation contract. Stages build durable production-intended parts of the complete system. They do not redefine the target as a prototype. After the complete package passes the independent acceptance protocol, the accepted plan must be committed before construction begins. Actual consequential deployment retains its separate authorization and admission requirements.

The largest residual uncertainty is whether the system can actually perform its duties within available human and financial resources. Accurate records and disciplined refusals cannot establish that. Matched useful-outcome trials, adverse recovery tests and actual operating evidence must answer it.

title: 01 — Understand the ambition before choosing the system

sections.heading: 01 — Understand the ambition before choosing the system
sections.html:
01 — Understand the ambition before choosing the system

Date: 2026-09-12. Stage: Understand. Status: framing artifact for subsequent expansion and challenge; no architecture selected and no founder acceptance inferred.

This document reconstructs the ambition from The vision, the fields, and the sectors and The path to the vision, read independently of prior architecture plans and other research lanes. The latest directive, supplied through the orchestrator's 2026-09-12 brief, governs conflicts with those historical inputs.

Evidence labels:

  • F — Founder constraint: a value, ambition, refusal, or current instruction supplied in these inputs.
  • I — Interpretation: this writer's reconstruction; open to correction.
  • H — Hypothesis: an empirical claim needing evidence, not a design entitlement.
  • U — Unknown: something not settled by the inputs.

These labels describe where authority or support comes from. Repetition does not turn H or I into F.

sections.heading: The company the owner is trying to make possible
sections.html:
The company the owner is trying to make possible

I, grounded in F: A person, or a small group of people, should be able to decide what is worth doing and have the work of a whole company carried through without personally supervising every step. That includes deciding what to try, learning whether anyone needs it, building and delivering, finding customers, selling, supporting, operating, maintaining, handling money and obligations, changing direction, and closing responsibly.

The intended benefit is that what reaches customers remains connected to what the owner meant, while the owner can give a defensible account of work they did not witness. The account must include uncertainty, failed attempts, omissions, assumptions, stale information, costs, unresolved commitments, and consequences. It must help them steer and correct the company, not merely reassure them that work occurred.

The company should run much of its ordinary work within established authority. The owner supplies direction and the personal choices the system cannot legitimately invent. They remain sufficiently in contact with the business to understand it, recognize an important mistake, change its course, and stand behind its promises. Their attention is treated as finite, so excess work is reduced, deferred, or declined before supervision becomes ceremonial.

The strategy allows many attempts and expects some to fail. Its promise depends on discovering failure early and ending attempts without abandoning customers or creating a growing burden of obligations. More production is useful only when the outcomes justify the total costs and consequences.

U: The inputs do not choose the first business, target customer, product category, jurisdiction, legal form, staffing arrangement, spending limits, working hours, or acceptable losses. Examples in this document do not decide them. A general system can be designed while leaving deployment-specific choices explicit; operating authority cannot be fabricated from those blanks.

sections.heading: Current constraints and historical material
sections.html:
Current constraints and historical material

F: Scope is the full responsible work system for one owner or a small team across the company lifecycle. Research and design must be independently derived. Counts, technology choices, organizing structures, and the shape of delegation are open. A fixed agent hierarchy or an architecture inherited from earlier plans is disallowed as a starting premise. No final architecture is selected at this stage, and ordinary progress must not depend on repeated founder approval.

F: The required planning order is Understand → Expand → at least three competing foundational candidates → independent attacks → synthesis → complete specification → independent review against the vision without privileging the selected architecture → full implementation. This framing does not substitute for the later stages or claim that any have passed.

I: Historical question counts are evidence of a substantial inventory, not a proof of completeness or a target number of components. Historical engine names, sealed-lane procedures, four-question rounds, specific tools, and a signoff step describe an earlier process. They cannot silently determine this system's topology or recreate routine approval gates under the current directive. The useful continuing discipline is to research what can be researched and ask the founder only for a decision that depends on their personal authority or values.

sections.heading: Invariants to carry into every candidate
sections.html:
Invariants to carry into every candidate

These are F, with I operational readings that still need precise acceptance criteria.

InvariantWhat a future candidate must make possibleObservable contradiction
Preserve intentKeep work connected to the desired outcome, reasons, scope, and refusals; support explicit changes of directionA local instruction changes the company's purpose without acknowledgement
Give a truthful accountDistinguish observation, testimony, inference, assumption, unknown, and unresolved outcomeA successful task report hides a failed action or an untested claim
Bound authority by consequencesKeep allowed exposure tied to what actions can affect, including cumulative effectsPast success alone grants broader spending, publication, or data access
Keep the owner competentSupport understanding and correction of the actual business over timeThe owner cannot explain important promises, risks, or why customers buy
Respect finite attentionMake ordinary decisions inside authority and respond deliberately when human capacity is unavailableThe work queue grows by turning every uncertainty into an approval request
Cover the whole lifecycleSupport real attempts, steady service, maintenance, transition, and responsible closureA venture can launch but cannot settle what remains owed when it ends
Preserve human answerabilityMake responsibility and the limits of delegation understandableAn agent's completion claim substitutes for someone standing behind an outcome
Permit correction and refusalAllow the company to challenge assumptions, stop work, and change its mind without falsifying historyPersistence continues only because work has already begun

No invariant supplies its own metric, budget, jurisdiction, implementation, or universal priority ordering. Truthfulness and consequence boundaries cannot be traded away merely to make another metric improve. Remaining conflicts need explicit reasoning.

sections.heading: Tensions that should remain visible
sections.html:
Tensions that should remain visible

I — Faithfulness versus learning. Exact preservation of an early instruction may defeat the reason it was given after facts change. Free reinterpretation may erase the owner's choice. The unresolved requirement is controlled, explainable revision: preserve both what was meant then and why something different is appropriate now.

I — Autonomy versus authority. Routine founder approval is disallowed; personal risk appetite cannot be invented. These can coexist if authority can be established and used repeatedly within its real scope. The open problem is recognizing when a seemingly ordinary action crosses that scope, including many individually small actions that accumulate. The file does not prescribe a particular permission mechanism.

I — Complete account versus finite attention and privacy. Raw detail can overwhelm, and some information should not be collected. Every summary excludes something. Truthfulness therefore needs an intelligible account of relevant omissions and limits, with access to appropriate evidence, rather than a claim to record everything or expose everyone's data.

I — Cheap failure versus durable obligations. It may be cheap to generate an experiment and expensive to withdraw what was sold or promised. Affordability must include support, closure, correction, reputation, and time, not just production. Whether the proposed strategy remains inexpensive is H.

I — Competence versus time saved. Handing the owner selected work may preserve judgement but also consume the scarce resource the system promises to save. Useful contact with customers and consequences must be distinguished from repetitive review. The best dose and form are U.

I — Stable taste versus evolving judgement. A recognizable standard need not mean that a person can never change. A correction may express learning, a contextual exception, or a new value. Treating every correction as global drift or every habit as permanent preference would both violate the ambition.

I — One person's intent versus other people's standing. Customers, partners, employees, suppliers, and successors can have legitimate claims that the founder cannot dissolve by changing a goal. Small-team operation requires explicit handling of competing human instructions and authority. Neither a universal single decision-maker nor majority voting follows from the vision.

I — Independent truth versus commercial scope. The older text says the account is the only part worth building; the latest directive calls for a full company system. The present reading makes truthful accounting a requirement throughout the whole system. It does not narrow the task to an audit product or establish whether capabilities should be bought or built.

I — Useful structure versus premature architecture. The field map calls subjects “workers,” “memory,” and “orchestration” to make them discussable. Those names can also bias the answer toward a familiar agent organization. Expansion must allow alternatives that satisfy the underlying need without reproducing those nouns as components.

sections.heading: Responsibilities that cannot be silently assigned to the system
sections.html:
Responsibilities that cannot be silently assigned to the system

F supplies the concern; the distinctions below are I. Nondelegable does not mean that the founder must personally perform every associated action.

ResponsibilityAssistance can provideWhat assistance cannot establish by itself
Decide what is worth wantingEvidence, possibilities, consequences, experimentsThat the owner endorses the end or the life required to pursue it
Choose personal exposureEstimates, alternatives, cumulative exposure analysisConsent to losses, hours, disclosure, or obligations outside existing authority
Stand behind a promiseFulfillment, monitoring, records, proposed remediesThat the other party accepts a substitution, release, or altered promise
Maintain personal relationships where personhood mattersPreparation, scheduling, factual supportThat automated attention is an acceptable substitute to the other person
Own taste and directionExamples, comparisons, consistency checksThat an inferred preference overrules a deliberate correction
Remain answerableTraceable decisions and evidence of consequencesA universal legal transfer of responsibility or meaningful accountability by software alone

I: The system's truthfulness is a requirement to establish through evidence and challenge, not a metaphysical claim that only a person can ever verify. Human approval also does not make a false statement true. Licensing, consent, and legal capacity are external constraints to research for the actual deployment, not facts supplied by the sector labels.

sections.heading: Claims that must not become founding facts without evidence
sections.html:
Claims that must not become founding facts without evidence

Historical assertionLabel and treatment
Nobody sells, and no vendor will build, the needed truthful accountH: universal market prediction; requires a definition of the account and current competitive evidence
Most ideas die because the cost of finding out is too highH: plausible causal account, unmeasured here; other causes remain possible
Judgement decays without direct workH: investigate which competencies, tasks, people, and periods; do not invent a universal decay rate
Owner drift produces no internal signalH: an absolute claim; distinguish imperfect detection from impossibility
Reading can be compressed but deciding cannotH/I: a warning about attention, not a demonstrated limit on decision support
The account is the sole durable commercial positionH: strategic thesis; the latest directive's scope does not depend on its truth
A sector marked OPEN needs only capability and trustH: provisional taxonomy; outside duties can still depend on activity and location
One person's judgement can scale without proportional checkingH: central feasibility proposition; test it rather than treating it as delivered

F: Wanting to avoid intent loss, remain competent, and refuse unbounded exposure does not require proving these hypotheses. I: Conversely, the values do not prove feasibility, profitability, or market exclusivity.

sections.heading: Questions that already carry architectural assumptions
sections.html:
Questions that already carry architectural assumptions

The left column paraphrases questions from the source inventory. The right column preserves the need while opening the possible answers. All rewrites are I.

Question with an embedded assumptionMore open question
How many workers and roles should exist?Which responsibilities and forms of work are needed, and what arrangement can meet them?
Who routes work to the right worker?How does needed work reach something capable of completing it, including deterministic execution or a person?
What belongs in shared memory?What must remain knowable, to whom, with what evidence, expiry, privacy, and cost?
What stages does work pass through?What evidence establishes readiness, progress, completion, interruption, or abandonment for this work?
Which steps always need approval?Which consequences are already authorized, and what genuinely requires a new human choice?
Which worker judges another worker?What evidence and challenge can reveal defects without relying on the producer's account?
How does the system improve itself?Which forms of change are beneficial and permissible, and how can that be established?
How is every run reproduced?What needs exact replay, what needs defensible reconstruction, and what cannot be recovered?

sections.heading: Missing questions and assumptions to carry forward
sections.html:
Missing questions and assumptions to carry forward

U — Founder or other authorized human choices: What kind of business and daily life should this serve? Which ends and relationships must remain personally chosen? Who may set or change limits when several people share the company? What should happen during prolonged absence, incapacity, or succession? These are not requests for an immediate questionnaire; many become necessary only when a concrete consequential choice depends on them.

U — Researchable questions: Which failures escape an apparently truthful account? How does observation coverage change when tools or vendors change? How can the owner contest a summary without reading its entire history? What obligations remain after a product, customer relationship, or company closes? Which forms of information must be forgotten even when retention would make reconstruction easier? What failures does aggregation create across ventures that appear individually safe?

U — Questions about interpretation: When is an instruction an idea, a standing rule, an authorized task, or an external commitment? What distinguishes changed intent from correction of an earlier misunderstanding? How far should a correction propagate? Who is allowed to say a goal was satisfied when outcomes depend on another person? Can the system represent unresolved disagreement without quietly choosing a winner?

U — Feasibility assumptions: Relevant consequences can be detected early enough to bound them; external actions leave enough evidence for a useful account; reduced supervision can coexist with maintained competence; a small team can sustain the residual human work; and responsible closure does not erase the economics of experimentation. None is established by this framing.

sections.heading: Non-goals and next-stage handoff
sections.html:
Non-goals and next-stage handoff

F/I: The ambition does not require removing all people, approving every action, perfect knowledge, unlimited autonomy, a named stack, a fixed hierarchy, or automatic entry into every industry. It is not fulfilled by producing only reports, only software, or only a governance wrapper around unfinished company capabilities. Phased implementation is a means to test and deliver the whole scope, not permission to quietly substitute a smaller final objective.

I: Expand should revisit the inventory by company outcomes, lifecycle, stakeholders, failures, and consequences; add missing concerns and remove misleading divisions. Subsequent foundational candidates must differ in the assumptions by which they coordinate responsible work, not merely in names or vendors. Independent attacks should be able to reject the premises, not only find missing features. Synthesis must preserve unresolved disagreements, and the complete specification must make expected behavior reviewable across ordinary operation and failure. Those are obligations for later artifacts, not decisions made here.

An architecture-neutral recognition test is available now: give only this framing to someone unfamiliar with the repository and ask what the company makes possible, what the owner does, what it refuses, what happens when a venture fails, and what remains unknown. Their answer should describe the intended company rather than a particular implementation. This test has not been run, and no founder endorsement of this reconstruction is claimed.

title: Phase E — Architecture selection and synthesis

sections.heading: Phase E — Architecture selection and synthesis
sections.html:
Phase E — Architecture selection and synthesis

Version: E1.2 · 2026-09-13 · original authoring base 05bdf385bf79179cecaaa3bc52ca4e00c2a71c5e; review reconciliation at root bd7b26d; F2 amendment at ca80355. Status: adopted by the orchestrator as the Phase F specification anchor after reconciling both final portable reviews. E1.2 records the F2 round's outcome for the work / agents / authority / tools / skills / context / shared-state / routing / task-state layer, per the F2 selection record §12.9: §3 gains the five layers and their precedence, §8 records which F2 candidate mechanisms were retained and which deferred with their comparators, and §9 gains the F2 reopen conditions. The architecture version moves S1.0 → S1.1, not S2.0: the six fixed boundaries and the nine logical components of §3 stand unchanged and the layer is re-specified inside them. Cross-lane examination of fourteen falsifier candidates returned zero against a fixed boundary, so nothing licensed reopening one, and this amendment routes no decision packet against one. No implementation, empirical superiority, deployment authorization, or Phase G acceptance is claimed. Original candidates and independent findings remain intact. This is an architecture authoring decision, not an independent review of its inputs.

The selected logical architecture is a common authority for admitted work and surviving obligations, specialized native production, and separately protected consequence, evidence, and recovery boundaries. Its version is S1.0 (S1 below), a logical specification anchor, not released software. Its organizing control is A-derived: one company case authority admits and maintains discretionary work under endorsed priorities. It incorporates the repaired responsibility and enforcement contracts, including native outcome sponsorship and independent challenge. It does not make a blackboard, distributed issuers, permanent agents, or compulsory independent discretionary inquiry jurisdiction foundational.

This choice is a design inference under uncertainty. The evidence establishes available mechanisms and important failure modes; it does not establish which candidate runs a business most effectively. S1 minimizes independently administered coordination decisions inside the proposed company while retaining specialized domain meaning and external standing. The cost of that choice is concentrated agenda authority and potentially expensive case-model maintenance. A measured demonstration that this concentration misses important work, increases owner labor, or obstructs independently capable domains must reopen the choice.

sections.heading: 1. Decision basis and limits
sections.html:
1. Decision basis and limits

The directive, understanding, and source vision define success: one responsible person or a small founding team directs complete discovery, production, commerce, operation, learning, and closure beyond what they can personally perform or inspect. Intent, counterparty standing, truthful uncertainty, consequence-based authority, finite attention and governing competence are constraints. The historical account-only thesis, old roster and template stack do not determine the architecture.

S1 adopts technical repairs TF1 and company repairs CF1 as normative proposed contracts, with the explicit selections below. Neither merely assigning responsibilities nor demonstrating safe refusal proves useful delivery. A capability requiring human relationships, physical fulfillment, licensed judgment, funding or external standing must have the actual competent performer and accepted continuity arrangement before dependent promises. Preparation of a professional packet is preparatory work, not the professional determination or filing.

The full D2 architecture/evidence and company reassessment, read at 4b99a9d, closes EAS-01–04 conceptually and finds CH-01/02/03/05’s foundations addressed. Its company section is the architecture reviewer’s fresh reassessment after its architecture judgment, not the original company reviewer’s signoff. The full D2 technical reassessment, archived from 1bd26176122716fe14132fbd24b29bc58fd60d18 and read at root bd7b26d, conceptually closes T01–08 and EAS-01’s lost-potential-obligation problem while retaining R1–R3 as mandatory specification obligations below. Both reviewed immutable subject 4182ead431220dc94ce61335170a798815aaf02c; independence was procedural and scenarios remain unexecuted. Their scope is synthesis readiness only. The orchestrator reconciled both reports and adopted S1.0 for Phase F; neither reviewer selected a winner or cleared a complete specification or implementation. EAS-R1 remains incorporated in section 9: rights conformance, business effectiveness and representation effects remain separate.

The cross-lane comparison preserves ten unresolved axes. S1 resolves their organizing choices without pretending to resolve their empirical unknowns. Shared intent/obligation contracts address X01; native production and actual service acceptance address X02; common case control resolves X03 provisionally; selective mappings and validity address X04/X09; independent interpretation addresses X05; ordered release and durable recovery address X06; fixed participation with competent assistance addresses X07; separate resource accounts and full closure costs address X08; bounded, removable improvement addresses X10.

Source-supported research retains its own dates, interests, confidence and expiry. The architectural evidence most consequential here is L02, L08, L09, L13, L14, and the repaired A/C distinction. These support particular mechanisms or bounded observations, with untested transfer to this company. No new current pricing, provider-rights, legal or supplier-availability claim is needed to choose these logical contracts.

sections.heading: 2. Alternatives compared on the same requirements
sections.html:
2. Alternatives compared on the same requirements

The baseline for comparison must cover full business delivery, evidence, consequences, competence and closure. Removing these obligations would make an artificially cheap competitor. Requirements specify outcomes and authority; they do not prescribe case records, charters, blackboards or organizational titles.

AlternativeNonoptional control choiceCredible reason to choose itPrincipal cost or falsifier
Simple comparator S0Native business tools, shared obligation/decision register, fixed grants, calendar, scheduled reconciliation, temporary assistance and accountable manual releasesExisting tools and a competent owner/service network may coordinate the required scale with less software and upkeepManual commissioning, recovery or evidence assembly scales with output; missed duties or owner overload defeat it
Repaired ACommon admitted-case authority and deterministic scheduling; bounded adaptive planning handles unfamiliar workOne accepted work state makes cross-domain ownership, change and recovery explicit without negotiating internal administrationCentral interpretation can be consistently wrong; mapping and case creation become hidden founder labor
Repaired BNative domains own administration and scheduling; sponsors commission complete outcomes; independent issuers prepare a commonly ordered releaseReal autonomous suppliers or domain operators can preserve expertise and replacement options without migrating internal methodsSponsorship disputes, prepared resource holds, shared validity and cross-issuer ordering can dominate coordination; native autonomy is unavailable where bypasses cannot be fenced
C2Standing inquiry charters entitle eligible observers to a bounded first discriminator and separately governed disposition despite ordinary production prioritiesProtects investigation from convenient local closure or indefinite discretionary deferralReserved analysis and assessor capacity can be consumed by false or low-value inquiries; continuity and appeal add permanent institutional labor

The originals are A, B, C1, and the C2 amendment. C1 overlaps an adaptive case implementation and is not credited as an additional foundation. C2’s distinction is genuine as a proposed jurisdictional choice: who owes a first investigation and who can retire it. Case engines can implement those rights; blackboard storage does not create them.

Why select A-derived control now: existing obligations, counterparty challenges, releases and shared scarce resources require explicit company decisions in every candidate. A common admitted-work authority offers one place to resolve missing ownership and retain continuation while native performers retain their own methods. This reduces the number of cross-authority contracts the company itself must administer compared with B’s independent issuer preparations. It also avoids imposing C2’s general protected inquiry allocation before evidence shows that scheduled cross-domain scrutiny and compulsory duty/grievance handling are inadequate. These are structural cost judgments, not observed performance advantages or claims that centralization is inherently simpler.

B remains the strongest replacement when actual independently administered domains are a benefit rather than simulated internal departments. It may run in one deployable application; microservices are not its defining feature. S1 keeps useful native semantics and contractual supplier autonomy. It does not keep B’s independently issued internal company grants or award exchange as the default. Introducing a genuinely independent issuer later requires TF1’s full preparation/revocation protocol or a new reviewed equivalent; ordinary remote checks cannot approximate a common authorization cutoff.

C2 remains the strongest challenge to agenda concentration. S1 must reserve discovery capacity, run cross-domain review, preserve adverse evidence, and protect actual grievance/rights duties. It can nevertheless defer or end a truly discretionary inquiry unresolved under authorized priorities, with reasons and reconsideration conditions. It has not adopted C2’s compulsory independent inquiry jurisdiction by another name. If deferred inquiry causes persistent missed opportunities, duties or owner blind spots despite those controls, compare C2 directly. A lawful deferral is not itself an A conformance failure; its business consequences remain evidence.

S0 must remain a serious operating comparator. It can use narrow execution gates and independently durable records; its simplicity concerns agenda automation, not weaker consequence protection. If manual/native coordination delivers equivalent useful outcomes and recovery within the same owner allowance at lower full cost, remove unnecessary orchestration. S1 is chosen for complete specification because the intended scale creates a credible need for persistent automatic coordination; actual scale, exceptions and maintenance economics remain unknown.

sections.heading: 3. Selected logical and responsibility model
sections.html:
3. Selected logical and responsibility model

S1 distinguishes an intention, a responsibility, a plan, a proposed effect and an observed result. A case coordinates work toward an outcome; an obligation survives that case; an operation can remain uncertain after both a worker and a plan stop. Accepted work cannot discharge external standing through an internal status.

Cases distinguish proposed, admitted, active, waiting-for-evidence, accepted, disputed, parked and abandoned states. Obligations distinguish reported performance from legitimate discharge, transfer and surviving dispute. Operations distinguish held, independently recorded, released, observed and unknown effect. The authority owning each transition verifies its prerequisites; a convenient common “done” flag cannot replace these distinctions.

Superseded 2026-09-13. The sentence "Obligations distinguish reported performance from legitimate discharge, transfer and surviving dispute" stands verbatim and needs one word pinned down. "Surviving dispute" here means a CONTESTED OBLIGATION that survives the closure of the Case carrying it — not a second state of an evidence judgment. Read the other way it appeared to contradict 01-contract-kernel.md's "Presentation may call contested \"disputed\"; it must not persist a second disputed verdict", and that misreading is what raised gap-contradiction-disputed-vs-contested in phase-content-gaps.json. The two passages were never about one subject. What the registry enforces: EvidenceJudgment declares no disputed phase at all — criterion.EvidenceJudgment.contested.v1 is where a challenged judgment's content lives — while Obligation, Case, SalesAgreement and Commitment each do declare one, because a duty, a piece of work and an agreement are the things that can legitimately be in dispute.

Consequence authority and releaseGrants, conflict holds, independent resource accounts, current restriction epochs, release order and controlled egress identitiesExact proposed operation plus current prerequisites → durable release/denial and attempt identity; no producer credentials or permission inferred from success
Context and validityCaptured input manifests, lineage, purpose/access restrictions, usable-reference state and deletion propagationAuthorized query and output staging → restricted context or atomically validated published derivative; cannot use a model’s selected citations as complete lineage
Evidence and acceptanceProtected capture, independent observation contracts, interpretation dependencies, evaluators, accepted outcomes and disagreementsRaw observations and tested definitions → scoped judgments with omissions; cannot equate delivery receipts, rationale, legality and customer satisfaction
Human and external responsibility interfaceDecision packets, grievance progress, professional/service handoffs, participation selection and accepted alternativesRequired decision or duty → competent decision/performance or owned incapacity; cannot create a professional by naming an endpoint
Recovery and continuityIndependently durable envelopes/frontiers, accepted restore evidence, surviving restrictions, fallback access and continuity arrangementsFault/absence → contained state, reconciled recovery or explicit unresolved scope; cannot authorize a restored writer from its own old history
Operator surfacesDisposable permission-filtered projections and acknowledged viewing positionAuthoritative state/evidence → conversation, terminal and accessible operational account; commands return to the appropriate authority boundary

Every contract specifies owner, inputs/outputs, authoritative source, lifecycle, access and consequence scope, retention, failure, observability, scaling, versioning, replacement and removal. These subjects can be records and functions in a modular application. Full Phase F must map all directive schema subjects without inventing an agent or service for each noun.

The selected production rule is deterministic computation for arithmetic, validation and known predicates; durable procedures for waiting, schedules, routing and repetition; bounded model work for interpretation and generation; capable people for human relationships and consequential judgment; qualified professionals and services for actual specialist or physical performance. Persistent model identities require demonstrated benefit over portable work records and temporary sessions. Existing roster names do not supply that justification.

Each offered customer journey has one accepted outcome sponsor. Subtasks may span product, finance, delivery and support, whose local acceptance supplies evidence to that sponsor. Necessary unsponsored work enters temporary protective custody and CF1’s bounded ownership resolver; it cannot remain an unowned queue. In S1 this function assigns a case/duty custodian under standing mandates. It cannot grant resources or become a second planner. Transfer requires acknowledged scope, access, competence and unfinished effects. When capacity is absent, admissions narrow and accepted continuity activates; the founder is not the routine reconstruction service.

S1.1 — the five layers of the work / agents / authority / skills / context / routing layer, and their precedence (F2, 2026-09-13). The nine logical components above are unchanged and no tenth is added. What the F2 round settles is which question each part of that layer decides, and which decision governs when two disagree. Named plainly: consequence class decides who may act; a declared procedure decides how the work runs and what each step may see; a typed standing interest decides when work becomes due; an existence record decides whether a worker may be created at all; and exactly one standing party exists for each duty that outlives the case carrying it.

*Every row is SPECIFICATION. The operative rules are in [specification/05-work-agents-skills.md](specification/05-work-agents-skills.md); this table fixes the layering and its order.*

LayerDecidesGoverning ruleWhere it is specified
L1 · consequence classwho may actEvery action carries the set of routing classes it reaches, computed by one deterministic function from records the acting party cannot author, recomputed at release on the frozen bytes; every reached class's gates apply and no rank is computed05 §11; restating [specification/02-authority-recovery.md](specification/02-authority-recovery.md) §4
L2 · declared procedurehow, and what each step may seeImmutable versioned steps declaring kind, read set, grants, validator and branch set; the loader delivers the read set and records what it delivered; a guard is a pure function and a model's output is never a jump; one effect per effect step05 §3
L3 · typed standing interestwhen work becomes dueRelevance is a computed, unstoppable armed set over typed fields after every committed transition; no precondition may invoke a model; all prerequisites simultaneously, unexpired, uncontradicted, at or above their trust class05 §7
**L4 · ExistenceJustification**whether a worker may existOne of six admitted reasons, the unit it predicates on, a test that can return false, the alternative, a removal criterion and an expected cost. Specialized knowledge refused; attributable identity mandatory and never a reason05 §4
L5 · standing accountabilitywho remains reachable after the work endsA holder exists for a duty class only if its clock can run with no case admitted, an outsider has a right to reach the company about it, and it survives closure. It is a record — address, mandate, reservation, alternate, suspension procedure, review date — and never produces, never releases, never decides the matter it is the subject of, and carries no model memory05 §12

Precedence is fixed and operative: the lower-numbered layer governs when two disagree. Class may raise what a procedure permits and never lower it. An interest may arm but never admit above its effect class. An existence record may refuse a worker the class would permit but never create one the class forbids. A holder may hold but never act. Why a layering rather than one organizing unit: the round established that there is no single unit of justification — the founder's five criteria predicate on five different objects, and a criterion applied to the wrong unit returns undecidable, which reads as satisfied. Each of the five candidate designs carried its worst blocking findings on its own routing unit, so a synthesis that picked one unit would have inherited that unit's blind spot. Layering the units and stating which governs does not. The five criteria themselves are judged in the F2 selection record §2: distinct tools or permissions confirmed and the strongest of the five, isolated context refined and split into an attention sense and a confidentiality sense with only the latter justifying a worker, independent verification refined with half of it unreachable inside one model family, parallel work refined to near-inert at the current concurrency pin, and specialized knowledge overturned as a reason to create a worker.

The production rule of this section is unchanged and it is what L4 defers to for people. The six existence reasons govern model workers only; the five-way production rule above — deterministic computation, durable procedures, bounded model work, capable people, qualified professionals and services — remains the performer-type decision, because two of the six reasons do not transfer to a person and two reasons that apply only to people are not among them.

sections.heading: 4. Control, admission and external effects
sections.html:
4. Control, admission and external effects

An authenticated directive, native observation, scheduled occurrence or complaint can propose or reopen work. Syntax/provenance validation establishes attribution within a boundary, not truth. The case authority applies existing duty and exploration mandates, identifies ownership and actual competence/capacity, and admits bounded work. Missing information creates a specific investigation or dependency; it never becomes assumed readiness.

The scheduler preserves capacity for due obligations, complaint assessment, authorized containment, semantic maintenance and planned discovery, then applies endorsed priorities to remaining work. Deadlines, meaningful progress, concurrency and causal episode totals constrain execution. New revisions, descendants, model replacements and provider resets do not renew a spent work allowance. Protected discovery capacity includes scheduled independent adverse samples and cross-domain review. Its discretionary agenda remains under the case authority; required safety or grievance performance remains nonoptional under its own mandate.

A work order names the outcome, input versions, permitted read set, expected evidence, executor/method constraints, budgets, checkpoint, stop rule and acceptance owner. Native performers may decompose it privately, with attenuated authority and total budgets. A model can propose another step but cannot admit its own larger mandate. Bidding/negotiation is omitted initially; deterministic capability/availability routing plus bounded comparative assessment suffices unless evidence shows otherwise.

S1 selects one transactional logical authority per overlapping consequence scope, including grants, reservations, conflict claims and mutable prerequisite epochs. Distinct resources retain distinct units and restrictions. Domains provide source facts and competent determinations; internal departments do not run independently issued spend authorities by default. A partition cannot create another copy of usable authority. Physically separate servers are permissible only with a demonstrated common order and fenced writer generations.

ConflictClaim keys identify the actual entitlement, audience allocation, environment or shared consequence independent of case/operation IDs. InteractionDetermination binds applicable entity, relationship, population, purpose and shared-dependency constraints. Quantified ceilings, qualitative prohibitions and professional prerequisites remain separate. Unknown material interactions narrow or block the affected effect while ordinary independent work continues. Discovery of new interaction classes is owned labor, not an assumption that the catalog is complete.

Before release, independently persist the RecoveryEnvelope: exact recoverable executable bytes, identities, conflict set, grants/policy/configuration versions, holds, evidence contract and potential new obligations. Zero acknowledged released records may be lost under the declared primary-host-and-backup failure. Current release state, valid evidence, disclosure contract, parameter authority and time bounds are checked in the ordered release transaction. Only controlled egress can consume its resulting attempt right. This is an internal authorization cutoff, not an atomic transaction with an external bank, publisher or supplier.

DECISION (F6A-04, 2026-09-14) — a standing pre-authorisation does not dispense with the ordered release transaction for C2; it performs it once, at grant. What a model call consumes per turn is the attempt right that transaction already produced, gated by projection conformance — so the five checks above are checks on the **standing DisclosureContract (its current release state, evidence validity, parameter authority and time bounds, which that contract carries as its expiry and cumulative constraints), not checks that a model call skips. Three consequences are the substance of the decision. An expired or revoked standing contract leaves no attempt right to consume, so the call is refused rather than defaulted. A per-call projection that fails conformance is not a release C04 declined but an attempt right never acquired. And C04 remains the only releaser**: this is where the ordered transaction was performed, not an exemption from it — which is why [specification/05-work-agents-skills.md](specification/05-work-agents-skills.md) §11 refuses the “model calls are exempt” branch by name, and why amending the contract is a C5 protected control change. Read narrowly, and this is the part F6A-04 was right about: [specification/02-authority-recovery.md](specification/02-authority-recovery.md) §8.2's two admissible constructions govern what bytes may be built for a destination and are silent on who releases and when. The answer above is therefore read from this paragraph and from the contract's own expiry, not from §8.2; the construction discharges the disclosure element and nothing else.

Technical reassessment R2: a locally committed row or successful status lookup after a lost acknowledgment is insufficient evidence of independent durability. Before any dispatch-authorizing response, establish authoritative independent durability evidence tied to the exact envelope, release decision, generation and required frontier. Failure injection must cover local commit, remote persistence, acknowledgment loss, status lookup and failover. Phase F must name the implementation’s actual proof and reconciliation behavior; “synchronous” as a configuration label does not close this contract.

Revocation before the cutoff prevents release; later revocation leaves a released operation in flight and starts cancellation/reconciliation where available. A remote acceptance window remains a declared consequence requiring an appropriate actual contract. A connector promising stricter suppression needs enforcement at the relevant provider boundary. A lost response, expired worker lease or deduplication window cannot justify blind resend, entitlement reuse or releasing money. Compensation is a new authorized operation with its own failure and remedy state.

Technical reassessment R3: separately bound release-to-first-transport delay, retries and delayed provider acceptance. Grants and operator views must expose the gateway generation, first-send deadline, cancellation/expiry semantics and residual revocation window. A paused gateway cannot retain an indefinitely usable first invocation merely because it has not retried. Missing timing/fencing assurance parks the effect; Phase F must specify the exact transport boundary and test expiry, revocation and restart at each interval.

Consequential parameters come from authoritative selectors: payee from the verified payee source, amount from entitlement/terms, recipient from the relevant relationship and permission record, claims from current acceptance evidence. Outward generation uses either destination/purpose-clean context with approved content forms or trusted deterministic rendering of explicitly permitted fields. Broad sensitive model context cannot produce arbitrary outward text or hidden metadata without separately authorized disclosure of the exact bytes. Provider prompts, search queries, URLs and telemetry are disclosure destinations too. A content scanner supplements this boundary; it does not establish noninterference.

sections.heading: 5. Native meaning, evidence, memory and improvement
sections.html:
5. Native meaning, evidence, memory and improvement

Native accounting, CRM, support, code, design and professional meanings remain authoritative in their domains. Shared meaning covers only actual cross-boundary decisions: identity, principal, obligation, authority, time, units, provenance, uncertainty and stated acceptance relations. A ticket’s closure cannot silently become satisfaction, a CRM stage cannot become settlement, and a domain label cannot decide legal responsibility. Mappings have owners, versions, examples, counterexamples, consumer dependencies and maintenance costs.

Working context is attempt-local. Episodes preserve attributable attempts; semantic claims are scoped derivatives of evidence; procedures/skills are versioned instructions with applicability, exclusions, provenance, test and retirement rules. Start with record queries and permission-filtered lexical retrieval. Graph/vector memory can be added only for a named retrieval problem and measured benefit; neither is the organizational source of truth. Raw transcripts are evidence of captured interaction, not validated company knowledge.

The loader captures all effective input lineage, including earlier context and tool metadata. Outputs stage immutably, then become usable only through atomic validity checking and derivative registration. Restriction changes serialize with that publication boundary and consequential release. Live sessions may still contain revoked material but lose publication/release rights; late outputs and native resumptions cannot launder it. Conservative lineage may overrestrict useful work and impose rebuilding cost; that is measured, not waived by a model’s assertion that it ignored a source.

DeletionScope persists restrictions across initial cutoff, late derivatives, in-flight exports, backups and offline custodians. Rejoin occurs in isolation before retrieval, indexing or egress. The account separately reports verified live erasure, restricted backup retention, unresolved vendor copies and justified retained records. Its minimal surviving restriction evidence needs a real retention basis. Deletion can reduce reconstructability; the account declares the resulting gaps rather than retaining everything for convenience.

Acceptance protects the transitive evidence base: capture, source selection, decoders, mappings, metrics, denominators, datasets, build/runtime dependencies and administration. A claim states which shared failure it is intended to survive. Independent sources and separately governed interpretation are required where surviving a production mapping failure is claimed; two models consuming the same bad parser do not supply that independence. Missing or changed semantics suspend acceptance. Original testimony can still be wrong, and independent assessors can still agree incorrectly.

The account distinguishes human-endorsed reasons, executor-reported rationale, observable inputs/actions, reconstructed causal hypotheses and unknown influence. Rationale is testimony about reasoning. It cannot establish cause merely because a transcript and receipt are authentic. Suppressed, rejected, stale, unobserved, unavailable and unresolved evidence remains visible, including denominator changes and missing intervals.

Improvement is another bounded case with original problem evidence, alternatives including removal, exact change, affected contracts, benefit/harm hypothesis, test budget, rollout, independent observation and rollback. Prompt, skill, workflow, retrieval, routing, adapter and UI changes are versioned. Protected identity, grants, evidence, incident classifications, evaluator selection and improvement controls require independently authorized changes across their dependencies. No reward or demonstrated quality expands authority. Rollback includes changed schemas, derivatives and ongoing work; external consequences still require remediation.

The production interfaces below are required capabilities, not future departments. Missing a performer leaves that capability unavailable; it does not remove its function from scope or count as fulfilled work.

Legal, privacy and securityObtain applicable determinations; implement rights intake, scoped access, retention, deletion, licensing, incident response and credential containmentNo guessed sector clearance; actual duties and deadlines determine competent response and external escalation

For example, a valid sale records the exact offer and potential obligations before controlled acceptance. Delivery produces independently observed results; support can reopen the demand or claim evidence without undoing existing duties. A failed venture can cease acquisition while completing refunds, exporting data, canceling renewals and obtaining professional closure determinations. End-to-end acceptance belongs to its sponsor with actual counterparty/discharge rules, not the sum of completed tasks.

The neutral coverage/capability-requirements.json at 10c55bf was used to check this lifecycle and the cross-cutting components, including strategy, pricing, formation, human collaboration and actual fulfillment. Its 46 outcome requirements are a coverage inventory, not 46 agents or a selected ontology. Phase F’s capability map must give each a contract and evidence path; this table makes no implementation-completion claim.

sections.heading: 7. Human operation and failure boundaries
sections.html:
7. Human operation and failure boundaries

The owner receives changed intent, accepted/contested promises, contrary evidence, unknown effects, missing observations, capacity, costs and upcoming decision deadlines. Terminal work preserves conversation, plans, concurrent attempts, shell context, code/diffs/tests, approvals, artifacts and recoverable task switching. Mobile and accessible views offer the same authoritative decisions with observation age; offline state is stale/unknown. Stop requests distinguish requested, release denied, worker stopped, external settlement and remedy completed. There is no dependence on an animated office or transcript-derived success state.

Fixed, transparent participation includes original customer evidence, an independent taste decision, unfamiliar financial interpretation and intervention/recovery practice within owner-selected availability. Independent adverse sampling challenges the account producer’s selection. Practice completion, factual understanding, intervention performance, domain competence evidence and preference remain separate. A material misunderstanding changes the relevant assessment path through competent assistance, narrower action or refusal of new exposure. It does not transfer values authority or create an IQ score. Effective cadence and delayed transfer remain empirical questions.

Complaints have accessible intake independent of product accounts, proportionate verification, accepted custodian/alternate, substantive deadlines, reasons, competent escalation, remedy authority and resources. Noncustomers and complaints against the custodian retain standing through closure. An investigation cannot suspend valid service merely by existing. CF1’s distinct observation, contestation, investigation, expiring containment, justified suspension and direction decisions apply; TF1 bounds repeated processing while preserving genuine-case progress. A shared administrator or unavailable professional cannot satisfy independent escalation through a new role label.

The selected technical fault boundary includes primary-host rollback/loss, delivery duplication/reordering, partitions, stale workers, malicious retrieved/model content, compromised ordinary producers/improvers, and one admitted adapter within its demonstrated native permissions. Control roots, independent continuity records/keys, controlled egress and a separately reachable recovery administrator are assumed to survive as declared. Appropriate acceptance claims also require their specified independent observation/interpretation roots. Compromise of all roots, malicious ultimate administrators, unbounded provider administration and unobserved off-platform promises remain outside guaranteed containment/completeness. Actual exposure must be declared before dependent operation; this design decision grants no founder risk acceptance.

Recovery fences old egress and descendant access, seals the current registry generation, obtains complete channel membership/frontiers, restores holds and restrictions, reconciles effects/obligations, then issues fresh authority for demonstrably disjoint safe scopes. Missing frontier, key, membership, provider history or unfenced old writer contains the affected account/channel and wider principal if needed. A backup cannot certify its own completeness. AccessGraph discovery includes newly minted tokens, sessions, workflows, hooks, forwarding and scheduled execution; rotating one secret is not recovery evidence.

Useful continuity additionally requires accepted competent people/services, access, authority, available time, fee bounds, funding, alternatives and exercises. Test joint owner and provider failure, including shared authorization and subcontractor dependencies. New liabilities stop when capacity fails, but existing duties still need real performance, remedy or legitimate disposition. If the available arrangement predictably strands ordinary customers, S1 has failed its business hypothesis despite correct containment.
