New expenditure, contact, publication, contracts, consequential deployment, changed identity or private-data disclosure needs its specific current grant. FOUNDER CONSTRAINT. Human owner preferences and material exposure remain actual setup/decision inputs; software does not choose them through a profit or risk score.

SPECIFICATION. Outcome sponsorship is assigned before an offer becomes available. The first receiver of necessary orphan work takes temporary protective custody under the intake mandate. It locates the existing promise sponsor, otherwise the service mandate, otherwise the designated maintenance/discovery custodian. A bounded resolver assigns provisional custody when mandates overlap. Only acknowledged transfer moves responsibility; default timer expiry activates the accepted alternate. The resolver assigns ownership, not new grants. Escalation to the founder is reserved for genuinely missing founder authority or unresolved personal ends; ordinary cross-domain diagnosis and coordination consume recorded operational labor.

SPECIFICATION. Goals have a review date, next bounded discriminator, horizon and abandonment authority. The planning horizon extends only as far as current evidence, service commitments and available control support; speculative later stages retain ranges and alternatives. At review time an untouched goal is reaffirmed with evidence, narrowed, parked with a reopening trigger or abandoned with duty disposition. Each investigation’s finite causal allowance and stopping rule prevents persistence from becoming periodic rewording of the same work. Strategic rejection distinguishes inadequate execution from a contradicted value proposition using the experiment evidence, not the producer’s preference for another build.

Superseded 2026-09-13. The sentence "At review time an untouched goal is reaffirmed with evidence, narrowed, parked with a reopening trigger or abandoned with duty disposition" stands verbatim, and names only half of what parking now records. It is an incompleteness rather than a disagreement: this chapter names the reopening trigger, 01-contract-kernel.md names both, and the kernel's or has been decided as a CONJUNCTION. criterion.Case.parked.v1 requires /payload/review_at and /payload/parking_closure_account_ref → ReasonRecord — "the closure account that says what becomes of the surviving duties if that review never happens." Do not read this sentence as the whole rule. **Goal itself is treated separately:** it declares a parked phase and gained no closure-account field on the authority of a contradiction raised about Case; its disposition is recorded under GR-02 in phase-content-gaps.json. Decided in gap-contradiction-parked-review-vs-closure.

sections.heading: The overlap tie-break
sections.html:
The overlap tie-break

DESIGN PROPOSAL. The ordered resolver above decides which kind of mandate takes custody. It does not decide between two mandates of the same kind that both cover the harm, and until that is stated two implementers derive different owners from the same facts. Three candidate rules were available: the broadest covering mandate (custody by seniority), the narrowest covering mandate (custody by least sufficient authority), and founder escalation on every overlap. The third contradicts the paragraph above — escalation is reserved for genuinely missing founder authority — and the first hands a wide mandate authority over work it did not need to act on, which is the accumulation 02 §3 refuses when it says the resolver "cannot grant resources or become a second planner."

DECISION — least authority sufficient, then availability, then acceptance order. On overlap, provisional custody goes to the mandate with the narrowest scope that still covers the whole harm. Where two such mandates are equally narrow, custody goes to the one whose accepted alternate is currently available; where that still ties, to the one whose mandate acceptance is earliest. The reason is that the narrowest sufficient mandate is the one that can act without borrowing authority it was not granted, which keeps this a custody assignment rather than a widening of permission. Each step is deterministic over records the company already holds, so the same facts produce the same owner in two implementations.

DECISION — what the losing mandates and the assignment itself record. The mandates that did not take custody are recorded on the resulting ResponsibilityAssignment as contesting_mandate_refs, so a reader can see that an overlap existed and which alternatives were passed over; an empty list means the resolver found no overlap, which is a different fact from the field being absent. The assignment is provisional until acknowledged transfer or timer expiry, exactly as the paragraph above already requires — expiry activates the accepted alternate through the existing alternate_assignment_ref, deadlines and expires_at payload fields, and needs no new timer. Disputing the assignment does not suspend custody. A contested provisional custody is still custody: the harm keeps an owner while the dispute runs, because the failure this resolver exists to prevent is an unowned queue, and a dispute that suspended custody would recreate it. The guarantee is independent of which mandate wins — custody exists either way, unresolved_scope is required on every ResponsibilityAssignment, and timer expiry activates the accepted alternate.

SPECIFICATION. Fields an implementer must add. ResponsibilityAssignment.payload.contesting_mandate_refs: Ref<Mandate>[] (required, empty-allowed, meaning "no overlap"); payload.custody_basis as a closed enum over {promise_sponsor, service_mandate, maintenance_custodian, provisional_overlap_resolution}, recording which branch of the ordered resolver produced the assignment; and payload.custody_tie_break_reason as a closed enum over {narrowest_sufficient_scope, alternate_available, earliest_acceptance, no_overlap}, recording which of the three steps decided it. The last is what makes two implementations comparable: without it, two resolvers that disagree produce different owners and no evidence of where they diverged. The record registry and record schema are the place those fields are declared; this section states the rule, not the JSON.

Superseded 2026-09-13. The closing sentence — "The record registry and record schema are the place those fields are declared; this section states the rule, not the JSON" — stands verbatim, and the declaration it defers to has happened. All three fields exist on ResponsibilityAssignment with the exact names and the exact closed enums stated above, and a guard compares them: edge.ResponsibilityAssignment.proposed.accepted.v1 — the edge that PRODUCES an assignment, which is where the resolver's answer is recorded — requires custody_basis present, and where contesting_mandate_refs is non-empty requires custody_basis == provisional_overlap_resolution with a custody_tie_break_reason that is not no_overlap. Without that second half the enums would record a value nothing compares, which is how a field becomes decoration. contesting_mandate_refs is deliberately absent from every nonempty_fields list, because empty is a meaning here — "the resolver found no overlap" — and is a different fact from the field being absent. The guard does not require the contest to be resolved: a contested provisional custody is still custody, since the failure the resolver exists to prevent is an unowned queue.

sections.heading: Discovery to an accepted offer
sections.html:
Discovery to an accepted offer

SPECIFICATION. CAP-03/04/05 intake a problem or unexpected signal. The discovery custodian preserves originals and states beneficiary, current alternative, evidence limits and rival explanations. A ResearchPlan records population, sampling frame, recruiting/contact authority, permitted data, protocol, effort and stop rule. Actual customer observations distinguish willingness to speak, stated interest, paid agreement, use and repeat use. Empty or synthetic cohorts never count as real demand. A MarketBrief maintains dated competitor and market observations, source interests and uncertainty; material source change invalidates affected public claims.

SPECIFICATION. CAP-06 compares build, buy, partner, defer and stop. StrategyDecision records why a direction was chosen, opportunity costs, success/stop tests and next review. The owner supplies desired ends and taste; technical and product decisions use accepted mandates. CAP-07 produces a ProductSpec with measurable customer outcomes, excluded promises, dependencies and tests for purchase, onboarding, normal use, failure, support and cancellation. A realistic human/service delivery procedure can be the product; generating software is not assumed necessary.

SPECIFICATION. CAP-08 renders and inspects prototypes, repairs observable defects, and obtains actual user and accessibility evidence. CAP-09 separates stable identity/voice from tone adapted to first contact, ongoing relationship, failure and apology. The actual owner accepts taste and identity. Brand/name/asset-use claims require applicable rights evidence. CAP-13 produces useful material with claims, rights, audience, disclosure and version lineage. “Approved content” is still a draft for outward purposes until exact release authority exists.

SPECIFICATION. CAP-18 evaluates willingness-to-pay and alternatives against delivery, support, acquisition, recurring service, failed-attempt and closure cost. PriceProposal records currency, amount, renewal/cancellation effects, assumptions and authority. Adoption affects new offer versions; existing agreements keep their accepted terms unless legitimately amended. A subsidized purpose can be explicitly endorsed while the negative contribution remains visible.

SPECIFICATION. Price acceptance distinguishes provisional_hypothesis from demand_supported. With unknown demand, CAP-18 can complete an honest internal provisional price and, under a specific current grant, a test-authorized bounded validation offer; it cannot label that price demand-supported or justify scaling. Demand-supported adoption requires actual applicable demand observations and an accepted judgment on the stated commercial criterion. Unknown costs remain explicit in either result. A price draft, an authorized pilot and a supported commercial/scale conclusion are different outputs; none invents a customer or adopts founder exposure preferences.

SPECIFICATION. CAP-10 implements the product/service artifact and its operating procedures. Independent CAP-11 acceptance checks actual utility, process, authorization, original criteria and missing evidence. Passing tests is necessary where appropriate but does not establish customer value. LaunchReadiness assembles actual formation/account/signatory/rights results, available fulfillment/support/continuity, verified claims, price, remedies and resources. CAP-12 requests exact release only after those predicates hold. A local mock can test readiness refusal and success transitions; it cannot supply missing actual professional or physical capability.

SPECIFICATION. CAP-11 may complete its assessment with canonical EvidenceJudgment state inconclusive when evidence cannot decide the subject, or rejected when it establishes failure. proposed means assessment is unfinished; contested means its evidence/judgment is challenged, with “disputed” only a presentation label. A finished assessment does not accept its subject. Launch/product/capacity guards require a current accepted judgment on the exact required subject/version and predicate, with applicable scope and evidence closure; acceptance of a report about uncertainty cannot pass that guard.

SPECIFICATION. Launch composes multiple judgments through LaunchReadiness.acceptance_bindings: JudgmentBinding[]. The current independently admitted requirements manifest resolves each unique requirement ID to its exact subject/version and predicate, including distinct product/artifact, delivery, support and offer-condition subjects as applicable. Each binding supplies exactly that requirement ID, subject ref, predicate ref and current accepted child EvidenceJudgment. Assembly requires a complete join with no missing, duplicate, wrong or stale child; one judgment is reusable only for a truly identical subject and predicate. Producer-selected easier criteria and uncertainty-report substitutions fail. The manifest and children exist before readiness assembly, avoiding any requirement for a readiness record to prove itself. Changed child scope/evidence invalidates the resulting readiness before release.

SPECIFICATION. Before any sale, company.delivery_capacity.verify.v1 accepts proposed DeliveryCapacity, actual performer assignments, service workflow, materials/access evidence, availability window, reservations and continuity arrangement. It verifies actual acknowledged availability and competence, exercises required access/materials and an authorized rehearsal of the service/alternate path, then obtains independent scoped acceptance. It outputs verified or explicitly constrained/unavailable DeliveryCapacity and its EvidenceJudgment. It requires no SalesAgreement and supplies no evidence of a delivered customer order. CAP-12 binds these verified delivery and support capacities before making an offer available; CAP-30 later fulfills an actual agreement. Missing actual resources leave capacity unverified, while unrelated research/preparation can continue.

sections.heading: Customer journey, commerce and repair
sections.html:
Customer journey, commerce and repair

SPECIFICATION. CAP-14 chooses an authorized distribution channel according to audience evidence and a bounded hypothesis. Earned attention is implemented through useful content, permitted relationship/referral work and measured audience response; a channel choice does not authorize sending. Recipients, contact allocations, current suppression, claims and metadata pass the release/disclosure boundary. Actual channel result, meaningful conversation, negative reaction, opt-out and contribution are retained separately from impressions or vanity counts.

SPECIFICATION. CAP-15 qualifies a real opportunity, records objections and negotiates within standing terms. A price/term departure goes to the appropriate signatory; a model cannot create apparent agreement from an unanswered proposal. Controlled acceptance records the exact offer and potential duties independently before acknowledging an order. Payment/credit conditions remain separate. CAP-30 then executes onboarding: verify the customer’s intended recipient and permitted data, provision only entitled access, deliver necessary instructions/material, and check that the customer can actually use the service. Failure creates a support/remedy duty with an update deadline.

SPECIFICATION. Publishing a standing offer itself creates a declared exposure window: capacity and authority must cover the permitted acceptance route and outstanding valid terms. If an actual counterparty acceptance arrives outside the controlled route, capture it immediately and obtain the applicable competent interpretation; a software rejection cannot erase an obligation that already arose. Preserve disputed/possible duties and resolve performance or remedy. Sales marks its complete commercial outcome only after CAP-30's accepted delivery and the specified payment conditions; agreement formation remains separately visible before then.

SPECIFICATION. Fulfillment executes the actual agreed digital, human or physical service through an accepted performer. For each milestone record promised outcome, window, evidence and remaining obligations. Partial receipts do not complete the entire order. Acceptance uses the agreed criteria and counterparty acknowledgment where required; a silent customer does not acquire a new discharge meaning. Recurring service generates individual due occurrences with catch-up rules appropriate to the promise, not a backlog burst of obsolete sends after reconnection.

SPECIFICATION. CAP-16 retains exact communications, relationship owner, purpose restrictions, new promises, corrections and next action. Sensitive negotiation and relationships requiring a person route to a real person; a bot signature cannot impersonate that involvement. CAP-17 retrieves the sold version and actual fault, performs authorized repair/completion/refund and checks the resulting customer condition. Refund conflict identity uses entitlement and prior unknown effects, so sales retention and support cannot pay it twice. Public mistakes create an affected-audience correction proposal, not just new copy; corrections use current authority and preserve earlier consequences.

SPECIFICATION. For a defect spanning offer, implementation, invoices and supplier terms, the outcome sponsor opens one coordinating case with domain work orders and an explicit final criterion: affected bills corrected, actual service repaired or remedied, claims updated and customers appropriately informed. Domains retain native methods. Individually accepted subtasks cannot close a failed journey. Recurrence reopens product, market or supplier assumptions, including an alternative that the offer should end rather than gain more features.

sections.heading: Finance, suppliers, people and institutional work
sections.html:
Finance, suppliers, people and institutional work

SPECIFICATION. CAP-19 imports actual account observations and reconciles balances, outstanding commitments, released unknown effects and restricted reserves. Money, provider allowance, slots and minutes are separate accounts. Each Economics report includes observed and outstanding costs, failed attempts, acquisition, service/refunds, review, maintenance, security, migration and closure. Owner minutes remain minutes unless a legitimate declared valuation is provided. Shared overhead allocation rules are explicit and reproducible; entity/currency totals are not netted without the necessary determinations and authority. Forecast revenue cannot replenish spendable cash.

SPECIFICATION. The catalog's MoneyKnowledge and MinutesKnowledge are tagged values: observed amount with original evidence and coverage, estimate with attributed bounds/assumptions, or unknown with reason and responsible next check. Unknown has no amount field; observed zero requires actual evidence. Observed-revenue/cost fields prohibit the estimate variant. Reports retain known subtotals and missing categories, while early strategy can use explicit estimates or uncertainty. No such report can supply a spend grant or turn an estimated closure target into actual reserved funds; C04 requires bounded canonical authority and current resource evidence.

SPECIFICATION. CAP-20 performs document matching, journals, reconciliation, period review and actual reporting submissions where required. ProfessionalRequest contains the exact question, applicable facts/nexus, source packet, named provider, fee authority, acknowledgment date and due result. CAP-21 obtains an actual scoped conclusion, conditions, uncertainties, expiry and required duties from a competent issuer; changes of activity/provider evidence reopen it. Preparing or delivering the packet does not complete the requested professional work. Missing capacity invokes the accepted alternate before the latest responsible start and remains a material readiness/continuity failure when unavailable.

SPECIFICATION. CAP-24 compares make/buy alternatives including discovery, contracting, evidence access, inspection, minimums, renewals, termination and replacement costs. Actual accepted engagement states deliverable, competent provider, capacity window, price ceiling, dependencies, acceptance and backup. Verify changed payee details through an independent authorized route. CAP-25 maintains reciprocal partnership terms, opportunity attribution, relationship owner, conflicts and real joint performance. CAP-26 predeclares competence/availability and assessment criteria, obtains proportionate work evidence, accounts for applicant effort and has a contestable consequential human decision. Engagement, onboarding and access are separate from selection. CAP-27’s actual person mandate is specified in human operation.

SPECIFICATION. CAP-40 establishes the actual principal, relevant location/activity facts, signatory, account access, name/asset rights and required registrations/professional results before transacting. Each prerequisite records dependency, estimated lead-time range and its evidence, earliest/latest possible completion, due date and responsible performer. The software can prepare before revenue but cannot defer a prerequisite required before the first payment. It asserts no universal jurisdiction, legal form, licensing threshold or setup duration. The setup packet is resolved through actual authorized action, not sample values.

sections.heading: Incidents, knowledge, growth and responsible ending
sections.html:
Incidents, knowledge, growth and responsible ending

SPECIFICATION. CAP-22’s processing inventory binds people, purpose, source fields, permitted recipients, applicable basis/retention, rights route and deletion obligations. CF1/TF1’s continuing deletion scope applies to late copies and isolated rejoin. CAP-23/31 receive actual evidence, distinguish allegation/inquiry/expiring containment/justified suspension, name command and update responsibility, protect valid service, investigate and repair. Effective access discovery includes newly created sessions, scheduled code, hooks, forwarding and delegation. A disabled credential is not a completed refund or restored service.

SPECIFICATION. CAP-28 computes versioned metric series with raw denominators, exclusions, missed intervals and cohort outcomes. CAP-29 predeclares hypothesis, controls/treatment, authority, resources, stop and analysis rules and retains failed/inconclusive results. CAP-32’s scoped knowledge and CAP-34’s learning proposals preserve original sources, disagreements and causal limits. Transfer between ventures requires current purpose/recipient authority and compatible meaning; a common owner is not permission to share personal data or infer the same market. CAP-33’s governance decisions change only through the legitimate authority. CAP-46 tests and promotes system changes independently; complete execution/evaluator/deployment machinery remains assigned to the later tracks.

SPECIFICATION. CAP-35 tests growth against actual delivered outcomes, due-service and closure capacity, semantic labor and owner load. The 1×/2×/4× comparison retains S1’s baseline and adverse cases. New admissions shrink before mandated review or existing-duty progress is starved. Stage-specific success differs: discovery asks whether a question was usefully resolved; validation requires real need; delivery requires fulfilled promises; maintenance requires service and sustainable carrying cost. A green organization-wide metric cannot hide a harmed person or losing venture.

SPECIFICATION. CAP-36 pause withdraws specified new-work authority, cancels avoidable renewals, and retains active support, data, payment and reporting duties. Resume requires current provider rights, artifacts, contexts, people, reserves and stale assumptions to be reconciled. CAP-37 follows independently durable recovery/frontier and current authority checks, including delayed first-send and unknown-effect handling. CAP-38 pivot preserves old purpose/reasons and legitimately changes future work while existing promises survive.

SPECIFICATION. A RecoveryPacket retains frontier_evidence_refs to attributed Observations whose captured artifact preserves the exact historical signed frontier response and its request/nonce/time. RecoveryFrontier itself is the authority contract's fresh signed query response, not a stored record addressed by Ref. Historical evidence supports reconstruction only. CAP-37 obtains and verifies a new current nonce-bound response through C08 before authority-dependent recovery; a saved response or old valid signature cannot satisfy current admission.

SPECIFICATION. CAP-41 succession has accepted scope, actual authority/competence/access, a usable original-evidence package and rehearsal of unfamiliar duties. The old custodian does not disappear on packet transmission. Fence old/new write authority at cutover; joint owner/provider loss must not depend on the absent owner to appoint or pay the substitute. CAP-39 closure inventories accepted and potential promises, refunds, service, workers/suppliers, renewals, filings, records/data and grievance resources; performs each real disposition; and records surviving unresolved scope. closed-with-residuals has actual custodian, funding and review dates. It cannot be advertised as no remaining responsibility.

SPECIFICATION. CAP-42 provides noncustomer-inclusive intake without unnecessary product access, proportionate identity checks, reasons, deadlines, actual competent escalation and funded remedy. A complaint about the current custodian routes outside the disputed decision/incentive dependency. Repeated processing may be clustered, but each person’s standing, deadline, evidence and alternate survive. After product closure the reachable intake and competent residual custodian continue as long as required duties remain. Issuer limits bound a delegate’s release power, not the person’s rights or a professional adjudication.

Superseded 2026-09-13. The sentence "A complaint about the current custodian routes outside the disputed decision/incentive dependency" stands verbatim and is a guard now, not a statement. edge.GrievanceCase.received.triaged.v1 READS /payload/disputed_custodian — a field required on the record and read by 0 of 2255 predicates until this repair — and where it is true requires neq(independent_escalation_assignment_ref, custodian_assignment_ref). The reviewer's counterexample, the implicated custodian named in both fields with disputed_custodian true and every guard from received to closed passing, now fails at triaged. Two details are load-bearing: the disjunction's first arm is deliberate, so where the complaint is NOT about the current custodian the ordered resolver applies and this clause says nothing; and the test is not(eq(..., true)) rather than a bare negation, so an absent disputed_custodian is unresolved and denies, instead of reading as "not disputed."

sections.heading: CAP-42 grievance case lifecycle
sections.html:
CAP-42 grievance case lifecycle

SPECIFICATION. GrievanceCase has ten registered phases in the record registry. Six of them were named in no chapter of this specification, which left the record's source_contract pointing at a candidate repair file rather than at a contract. This subsection is that contract. Each row states what must be true to be in the phase and what the phase must not be mistaken for. It adds no phase, no edge and no predicate; the registry remains the authority for which transitions exist.

PhaseWhat must be true to be in itWhat it must not be mistaken for
receivedAn actual challenge has been captured at the accessible intake with its arrival time, the requested outcome and the originals preserved. Standing does not require an account or product accessAcknowledgement of merit. A receipt is not a determination, and the company's response deadline starts running here rather than at triage
triagedThe case has a named competent recipient outside the disputed decision and incentive dependency, a stated deadline and a route; the person's individual standing is recognizedAn assessment of the complaint. Triage assigns and schedules; it decides nothing. Clustering repeated processing is permitted and cannot erase this person's standing, deadline, evidence or alternate
investigatingThe assigned custodian is examining actual evidence against the stated challenge within a finite recorded allowanceA remedy in progress. Investigation consumes recorded operational labor, and its existence is not a reason to suspend unrelated legitimate service to this or any person
awaiting_evidenceThe investigation is blocked on a named item from a named source, with a due date and a stated consequence if it does not arriveA stopped clock. The deadline and the duty both continue; the complainant's silence is not withdrawal, and the company's silence is not a disposition
remedy_authorizedA competent authority has decided a specific remedy, its funding is actually reserved, and a performer and due date existA performed remedy or a made payment. An authorization without funded capacity and a named performer is an unowned promise, not this phase
remedy_performingThe authorized remedy is being performed by the accepted performer within the recorded scopeA completed remedy or a satisfied person. Partial or failed performance keeps or returns the case here, and no timer advances it
disposition_issuedA reasoned outcome has been communicated to the person in terms they can act on, naming the reasons relied on, the surviving duties and the route to contestClosure, or agreement. A disposition can be issued and immediately contested, and issuing one to an unreachable address does not discharge the duty to communicate
contestedThe person has challenged the disposition or the remedy, and the challenge is routed outside the disputed dependencyA fresh start or an admission. Prior reasons, deadlines and evidence survive, and contesting does not suspend an already authorized or performing remedy
closed_with_residualsEvery disposition that can be made has been made, and at least one duty, unknown effect or unpaid remedy survives — each with an actual custodian, funding and review dateclosed, or an absence of remaining responsibility. It may not be advertised as one, and the reachable intake and competent residual custodian continue while it stands
closedNo residual duty, unknown effect or unfunded remedy remains against this caseProof that the person was satisfied, or a bar to a further grievance. closed → contested is a registered edge

Superseded 2026-09-13. The remedy_authorized row above stands verbatim, and the words "its funding is actually reserved" are checked now rather than asserted. criterion.GrievanceCase.remedy_authorized.v1 requires remedy_reservation_refs non-empty AND every entry resolving to a Reservation currently held or partly_consumed — a Reservation's live states — plus the deciding response decision, the requested remedy, the due date and an accepted custodian. Why it was prose until now: the kind-level remedy_authorized spec reached for resource_equation, which CCR-03 restricted to ResourceAccount, so on GrievanceCase the funding conjunct dropped out entirely and nothing in the registry read CAP-42's funded remedy. The criterion's meaning names the shape that was passing: "an empty reservation list is the shape that made CAP-42's funded remedy prose."

sections.html:
Registry phase meanings for company records

SPECIFICATION. The phases below are registered for records this chapter owns through the capability catalog and were named in no chapter before 2026-09-13. Same rule as above: meanings for states that already exist, adding nothing to the machines.

Record · phaseWhat must be true to be in itWhat it must not be mistaken for
CandidateAssessment.invitedAn actual candidate has been invited into a predeclared assessment whose criteria and expected effort were stated before any work was requestedA selection, a shortlist position or an offer. The effort already requested counts as candidate_burden from this phase onward
CandidateAssessment.assessingJob-relevant work samples are being judged by a competent person against the predeclared criteriaA decision. No IQ, personality or profile surrogate may stand in for the sample, and the candidate's challenge access is open throughout
CandidateAssessment.retained-restrictedThe assessment is decided and the record is retained under an explicit restricted purpose, such as contest or auditA live candidacy, or a reusable evaluation for a different role. The restriction is the reason the record still exists
Defect.verified_repairedThe originally failing predicate has been re-checked against independent evidence and now holds within the recorded scopeThe end of repairing, or a closed defect. A rerun by the repairer alone does not reach this phase
Defect.accepted_residualThe defect is still real and a competent authority has accepted it with its scope and consequence recordedA repair, or a closure. Acceptance is an authority act; it is never produced by triage, by expiry or by nobody objecting
Experiment.analyzedThe predeclared analysis has been run over the data the predeclared stopping rule producedA supported conclusion. An analyzed experiment can be inconclusive, and an analysis over a changed denominator is a different experiment
FormationReadiness.preparingPrerequisites for the actual principal, signatories, accounts, rights and activity-specific professional results are being obtained, each with its own evidence and lead-time rangeReadiness, or authority to transact. Preparation is permitted before revenue; a prerequisite required before the first payment cannot be deferred from here
FormationReadiness.conditionally-readyEvery prerequisite is verified for this scope except named conditions, each recorded with its owner. Permits preparation onlyready. It does not authorize a first payment, a sale or a public offer, and the named conditions are not warnings
Fulfillment.delivering"The agreed service is being performed by a currently accepted performer, with the milestone steps, the service window and the obligations still outstanding all recorded""Being in delivery asserts nothing about delivery: no receipt, no counterparty acknowledgment and no independent observation is required here, and none of them would be sufficient to leave this phase either"
Fulfillment.delivered"Delivery is established by an independently observed result correlated to the delivery adapter's own native object, by the receipts the milestones require and by a current accepted judgment on THIS criterion""Correlation is against the delivery, never against the payment: a settled charge is evidence about money and says nothing about whether the service arrived. Partial receipts do not complete the order and a silent customer acquires no new discharge meaning"
Fulfillment.failed"The delivery did not happen and the failure is owned rather than closed: the service window and the receipts actually obtained are recorded, the remaining obligations survive on the record, and no observation correlates a delivery""Failure creates a support/remedy duty with an update deadline; it does not discharge the order, and it is not a route to delivered by another name"
Fulfillment.refundedRegistered gap — no meaning is stated here because none is derivable. criterion.Fulfillment.refunded.v1 reads "Per-phase content unspecified; see gap-Fulfillment-refunded". The corpus says what a refund is and says it about the SupportCase that performs one; it nowhere says what a Fulfillment in refunded must showA phase with no content. The phase and its edges exist and are reachable; what is absent is the per-phase requirement, and inventing one here would close the gap by assertion. See gap-Fulfillment-refunded in phase-content-gaps.json
InteractionDetermination.unknown_materialInvestigation by a competent owner established that a cross-entity, population, purpose or shared-failure interaction may be material and could not be resolveddetermined with no interaction found. Unknown materiality narrows dependent effects; absence of evidence is not evidence of no interaction
Opportunity.advancedThe observed problem and the current alternative support a next bounded discriminator, and that step has an owner and a causal allowanceProven demand, a validated market or authority to sell. Advancing an idea never implies authority to sell
ResponseDecision.containment_authorizedA competent authority authorized a bounded containment on its own stated materiality basis, with an explicit expirySuspension, or a finding of fault. It lapses at expiry rather than persisting by default, and ordinary legitimate service and true complaints survive it
ResponseDecision.suspension_authorizedA competent authority authorized suspension of a named service or party on a stated materiality basis, with expiry and a review ownerContainment, which is narrower, or termination, which is not a ResponseDecision at all. It is never a substitute for a grievance disposition
ResponseDecision.direction_authorizedA competent authority issued a binding direction to act, with scope and expiryAn observation or an investigation result. A direction changes what must be done, not what is known
SalesAgreement.partially-performedBuyer acceptance of the exact terms is captured and some — not all — substantive fulfillment has occurredperformed. Partial receipts do not complete the order; the full remaining duty is carried in this phase
SalesAgreement.terminatedForward performance has ended under the agreement's own terms or by a legitimate actA discharge of duties already owed. Refunds, remedies and disputes survive termination, and termination is not disputed
SalesAgreement.terminated_with_residuals"As terminated — forward performance has ended — except that the transitive due set is NOT empty. Every surviving obligation, claim, reservation, descendant and pending operation is carried on the record with an accepted custodian for each, its funding and its review interval""terminated. This phase asserts that duties survive; terminated asserts that none do, and the difference is the whole point of having both"
SecurityCase.suspectedAn actual signal exists that authority or data may have been misused, and the allegation is recorded and routedA confirmed breach, or authority to suspend a service. A suspicion supports investigation; consequence needs its own ResponseDecision
SecurityCase.recovery-pendingContainment has been tested and shown which authority and data path was actually removed, and named residual paths or due communications remain openresolved. A disabled credential is not a restored service, a completed notification or a refund
SupportCase.assessingThe reported problem is being reproduced or diagnosed against the sold version, with the update deadline runningA remedy, or a determination of entitlement. Entitlement is consumed at remedy, not here
SupportCase.remedy-pendingThe disposition is decided and the remedy is owed but undelivered, with the entitlement named and a due date setresolved. A drafted reply is not a remedy, and the customer's update deadline continues to run

Superseded 2026-09-13. The SalesAgreement.terminated row above stands verbatim and no longer describes the only terminal a termination can reach. Its clause "Refunds, remedies and disputes survive termination" was true of the phase and unchecked by anything: all four SalesAgreement:*→terminated guards passed with an arbitrary due set. They now carry due_preserved(target_state: "terminated") and the continuation_ref argument it reads, matching every other closure edge in the registry — Commitment made→ended, Offer *→withdrawn, Case *→abandoned, Obligation *→discharged, Fulfillment *→superseded. due_preserved computes the transitive due set at the witnessed frontier and requires each residual discharged, not_arisen, or transferred with an accepted custodian, so **terminated now asserts that nothing is owed.** Where something is owed, the new terminal terminated_with_residuals — reached from all four sources and leaving to terminated when the residuals are discharged — is the phase that says so, and its row is in the table above. The residuals requirement is a kind-level PHASE_SPECS entry rather than a SalesAgreement override: terminated is a closure event wherever it appears. Decided as AD-014 (G2-02).

SPECIFICATION. These are unexecuted implementation acceptance cases. Each must inspect actual effect/delivery evidence or a fixture explicitly marked synthetic. A production acceptance cannot cite a synthetic professional, willing customer or bank balance as if real.

SPECIFICATION. Trace these cases to the risk register, version a6598d3: especially RISK-10–14 and RISK-17 for owner capacity, intent, institutional capacity, redress, business/human burden and interacting ventures. The catalog links affected risk IDs; this adds specification obligations without closing any risk or reproducing its likelihood claims.

  1. Successful ordinary business: research an actual authorized need, produce/test the complete experience, establish actual readiness, publish within grant, accept a sale, complete onboarding/delivery, handle a legitimate support issue, reconcile books and retain required service duties. Fail if any handoff alone is counted as fulfilled work.
  2. Unsponsored combined defect: introduce a correct local ticket closure, incorrect invoice and misleading offer. With founder absent, protective custody and sponsorship resolution produce actual cross-domain correction within existing mandates; record all human coordination.
  3. Noisy complaint and urgent true defect: preserve individual rights, bounded investigation and continuing legitimate service across repeated capacity resets. False blanket rejection, unexplained broad freeze or due-service starvation fails.
  4. Actual ending: stop a losing venture during unknown refund effect, supplier departure and noncustomer privacy complaint. Require evidence of performance or competent legitimate disposition, usable successor package and continuing funded redress. A truthful list of incapacity is a failed operating outcome, not false completion.
  5. Business value and shifted burden: run an operationally successful losing case and a profitable case with excessive customer/applicant/contractor coordination. Report distinct economic, usefulness and individual-burden failures; no combined score rescues them.

SPECIFICATION. Specification version: HUMAN-1.0.1 — patch, recording the F2 join only · architecture: S1.1 · base: 6a2487a · 2026-09-12; patched at ca80355, 2026-09-13 for the F2 selection record §12.2. The competence mechanism of this chapter is FIXED and no part of it changes here. The F2 round declares exactly two deltas against it (R-G03), both stated below and both additive; any further delta is a decision packet, not an edit. Status: Phase F authoring; no UI, study, authentication deployment or operating arrangement is implemented or approved by this document. This owns S06 and the human interfaces for CAP-01/02/16/21/25/26/27/33/41/42/43/44. Company capabilities and capabilities.json define substantive outcomes; execution, full context/evaluation schemas and deployment remain separate tracks.

Statement kinds (directive §6). Every substantive statement in this chapter carries one of: SPECIFICATION — our normative design, true by our decision and falsifiable only by our own tests; SOURCE CLAIM — attributed to a dated observation already registered in this package; INFERENCE — our reading of a source claim or of another contract in this package; DESIGN PROPOSAL — a construction offered for review, not yet decided; FOUNDER CONSTRAINT — a limit set outside this document that it may not relax; UNKNOWN — a value or behavior this package does not establish, which constrains the dependent effect and never defaults to the permissive branch. A paragraph's opening label governs the whole paragraph unless a later clause carries its own; unlabelled prose inside a table cell inherits its row's kind. Nothing here is a runtime result.

SPECIFICATION. The selected architecture, CF1, TF1, and D2 reassessments require actual control, finite attention and domain-specific competent response. SOURCE CLAIM. L09 supplies bounded human-factors findings and operator precedents. UNKNOWN: Its studies do not establish a universally effective cadence, maximum decision count or competence score. DESIGN PROPOSAL. All timing and interaction defaults below are proposed product acceptance targets, not observed latency, external service promises or inferred founder preferences.

sections.heading: Operator jobs and authority
sections.html:
Operator jobs and authority

SPECIFICATION. The operator must be able to answer: what changed, what remains owed, what useful work actually happened, what is unknown, which decision truly needs me, what happens if I do nothing, and how can I stop or correct it? The same contracts support a founder, a second owner, a bounded collaborator, a professional, a continuity substitute and an affected person. Each sees only their authorized scope. People remain actual parties with identity, competence and accepted standing; an application role is not corporate office or professional qualification.

SPECIFICATION. ActorBinding is a permission-filtered human projection with exact identity_binding_ref:Ref<IdentityBinding>, principal_ref:Ref<Principal> and mandate_ref:Ref<Mandate>; it is not a second identity authority. Party is the company label for canonical Principal, and PersonMandate is a human payload extension/view of canonical Mandate. The projection displays verified identity evidence, authentication method, principal, role/decision domains, scoped grants, accepted responsibility assignments, expiry and revocation from those sources. The client never supplies its own trusted actor, role, grant or professional status. Identity recovery is a separate authorized procedure with independent evidence; possession of a restored session or device does not reauthorize an actor. The kernel owns authentication/grants and provider-specific revocation; this document defines their human meaning.

SPECIFICATION. An AuthorityMatrix records each decision domain, legitimate deciding party or required combination, consulted parties, veto/consent conditions, competent assessor, alternate and absence behavior. It can grant routine product, technical, accounting or customer-remedy decisions within existing bounds. FOUNDER CONSTRAINT. Personal intent, values, taste and new material exposure remain with their actual owner. A second person can contribute facts, perform work or possess specialist authority without acquiring founder identity. A faster answer, majority of model votes, employment title or successful history never determines authority.

SPECIFICATION. Shared decisions use the declared rule: an exact proposal gathers the required endorsements for one revision, then the kernel validates current authority. If one required party changes or withdraws before authorization, it remains pending or conflicted. A domain with no valid rule cannot accept new consequential work needing one. Independent authorized work continues; the dispute packet preserves positions and latest responsible time. No synthetic arbitration persona chooses between equally defensible personal ends.

SPECIFICATION. Double submission returns the original stable command result; stale revisions return conflict with changed refs. accepted requires the kernel's committed and independently witnessed transition; durability_pending means witness completion is unresolved and requires lookup under the same command ID. The UI reloads and requests a new deliberate decision for materially changed bytes, recipient, terms, uncertainty, expiry or capacity. It never auto-replays approval against a new revision. Draft text can be kept locally under an appropriate retention policy; approval, revocation, release or acceptance cannot queue offline and later execute invisibly. Transport loss produces “request outcome unknown” until command lookup resolves it.

sections.heading: Decision timing and no-answer behavior
sections.html:
Decision timing and no-answer behavior

SPECIFICATION. Generate a packet only when a current mandate cannot resolve a real decision without that person. Before interrupting, test whether the decision has already been answered within the same purpose, scope, consequence and validity interval. Reuse explicit rules; do not infer permission from repeated similar approvals. Factual questions go to competent evidence gathering; bounded implementation choices stay with their authorized owner. A genuinely missing personal intention gets one exact question with independent work continuing.

SPECIFICATION. latest_decision_at is the earliest time needed to preserve a feasible option: due obligation minus supported performance, review, transfer and contingency intervals. expires_at also respects grant/evidence/offer validity. Packet readiness requires exact effects, alternatives, significant uncertainty, resource/counterparty consequences and no-answer behavior. If preparation cannot establish these before the latest time, escalate the lack of readiness as the issue; do not pressure a hurried signature.

SPECIFICATION. The no-answer rule is explicit by case: refuse new purchase/publication/commitment; continue an already authorized procedure; invoke accepted substitute; or carry out preauthorized bounded preservation. Expiry never means consent. For due work requiring unavailable judgment, activate continuity and retain responsibility/service loss rather than calling refusal successful fulfillment. Known mandatory safety controls under standing policy act without waiting for a person where waiting would defeat them; an urgent allegation itself supplies no such authority.

SPECIFICATION. An answer that reveals a material misunderstanding triggers the domain-assessment path before the affected effect can rely on informed competent review. An honest preference for another design or a deliberate changed value remains a valid preference, not a factual deficit. Independently authorized work continues throughout. Decision history preserves chosen option, endorsed reasons, contrary evidence, uncertainty, original authority and what later changed; a stranger can reconstruct its bounded meaning without pretending to know every causal influence.

sections.heading: Surfaces derived from operator jobs
sections.html:
Surfaces derived from operator jobs

SPECIFICATION. S1-C09 serves read projections from authoritative components; its controls submit commands to those components. Route names below are a specification of jobs and information architecture, not a selected frontend framework. Each surface uses the projection envelope, current permission filtering before retrieval and a plainly visible principal/venture/account context. A withheld confidential record exposes only an authorized indication of omission; no secret title, count or cross-tenant existence is leaked to an actor without that permission.

DESIGN PROPOSAL. Latency profiles are acceptance targets on the later declared reference workload: L, committed local state visible within 2 seconds while connected; N, local projection refreshed within 5 seconds but native truth limited by each feed’s visible watermark; D, durable static artifact/version retrieval with a loading state and timeout surfaced after 10 seconds. Target misses produce stale/loading/error states, not claims of fulfilled service. No model-generated summary blocks first display of authoritative duties, effects or stop controls. UNKNOWN: The deployment/evaluation track must establish the supported load and measurement evidence before making a real responsiveness promise.

sections.heading: Complete terminal and coding interaction
sections.html:
Complete terminal and coding interaction

SPECIFICATION. The terminal workspace is a projection of a real WorkOrder and environment, not a disconnected conversation. It displays company/principal, venture, workspace path/revision, execution identity, actual provider/billing attestation, allowed tools/network destinations, loaded context manifest, artifact state, active leases, remaining causal allowance and current stop state. A task switch preserves all of these with an exact continuation reference; conversational recency cannot select a different account or grant.

SPECIFICATION. Conversation entries distinguish authenticated direction, user correction, source content, model proposal, tool invocation, captured output, decision and independently observed result. Source text and tool stdout retain disclosure/trust restrictions; untrusted instructions cannot become commands. Show the actual command/arguments, working directory, environment identity, redacted secret names, bounded permissions, start/end times and exit/timeout state. Neither exit zero nor a native model’s completion message establishes tests, deployment or customer fulfillment. Environment variables and outputs reaching a provider must satisfy the data-recipient contract; masking secrets in a transcript does not repair an unauthorized underlying disclosure.

SPECIFICATION. Coding work includes navigable source/diffs, base and head revisions, conflicts, generated artifacts, test commands/results/denominators, failed/skipped tests, static checks, integration/evaluation results and actual release proposals. A patch is staged and reviewed before authoritative application. Concurrent workers show separate work scope, branch/workspace, lineage, checkpoints, resource consumption and acceptance owner; adding workers cannot multiply shared grants or allowance. Merge conflicts and stale artifacts become explicit work, never a silent last-writer choice.

SPECIFICATION. Shell interaction is available only through the admitted execution boundary and task-scoped environment; company consequences continue through the release service. Native provider authentication is distinct from company action authority. The external integration track specifies supported native launch/clean-context/tool mediation modes. No tool, helper hook, nested shell, browser or local extension acquires production credentials because it appears inside this terminal. Activity outside the managed observation boundary is declared unavailable evidence and reconciled when discovered, not included in a complete-account claim.

SPECIFICATION. Interruption records completed/partial work, exact next action, evidence/unknowns/disagreements, artifacts, authority/validity versions, pending effects and causal consumption. Reopening a saved native session requires a compatible permitted route and current complete context restrictions; otherwise create a fresh session from the portable packet and label the context loss. The terminal never silently purchases metered capacity or invokes another account to avoid exhaustion. Resumption is a new attributable attempt when generation restarts. Existing captured results remain evidence with their original model/provider identity.

SPECIFICATION. Stop displays five separate facts: command received; future release denied; worker cessation observed; released/external effects reconciled; required remedy completed. Technical R3’s first-transport deadline and already-released revocation window are shown when material. A lost acknowledgment offers a status lookup using the same command ID, not a fresh stop or resume with invented success. Resume is blocked until current restrictions, unknown effects, evidence and actual authority permit it. An old UI tab cannot revive a released attempt or obsolete lease.

sections.heading: Attention and practiced competence
sections.html:
Attention and practiced competence

SPECIFICATION. ParticipationPlan is owner-endorsed setup data: availability windows/timezone, maximum decision-batch minutes, interrupt limit, practice allocation, incident reserve, permitted assessment data, sampling policy and review date. An empty plan means no asserted attention/competence capacity for dependent promises. It does not prevent internal software development or force a questionnaire now. The interface offers understandable defaults at operating setup, but silence cannot adopt them.

DESIGN PROPOSAL. The fixed default policy offered for adoption uses one cycle per five declared operating days, within the chosen minutes. It offers four short encounters: original customer material, an independent taste decision before advice, an unusual financial/obligation explanation, and an intervention or recovery rehearsal. Customer material alternates ordinary and adverse/abandoned/underserved cases; the financial/obligation slot includes an adverse sample each cycle. Source eligibility is determined by access and the sampling frame; selection uses a recorded reproducible random seed within strata, outside the account producer’s write authority. Empty strata and unavailable originals are recorded, not replaced by flattering examples. UNKNOWN: This is a proposed schedule to test, not a proven human-learning dose.

SPECIFICATION. Owner-requested examples supplement rather than silently replace the required sampling record. Decline, interruption and noncompletion remain visible coverage limits; they do not establish incompetence. Revisions to the policy are explicit and owner-contestable. The system does not track unrelated browsing, covertly infer personality/health, rank general intelligence, or optimize agreement with its recommendations. Collect only relevant authorized operational and consented assessment data under a retention rule.

SPECIFICATION. For learning encounters, optionally capture a brief factual explanation/prediction or manual intervention before advice; record independent feedback afterward. A taste judgment is preserved as taste. At the next applicable cycle, present an unfamiliar transfer case with a different context; periodically test delayed transfer after an interval predeclared in the study protocol. Compare unaided recognition, intervention quality, false-positive assessments, owner time and reported emotional burden separately. Familiar task success cannot establish general competence. Consented longitudinal comparison, including absence and closure, is required before claiming preservation.

SPECIFICATION. On material domain misunderstanding, a competent assessor states the exact factual proposition/intervention, evidence and limits. The owner can contest it or request a second assessment. The relevant effect then obtains competent assistance, a narrower action, a rehearsal or a wait under the predeclared competence prerequisite. Lawful approval does not manufacture specialist qualification; a model cannot strip values authority. Unrelated work continues. If assistance is unavailable, new dependent exposure stops and existing duties invoke accepted continuity. This is an observable changed path, not another warning dismissed by a generic “approve anyway” button.

SPECIFICATION — F2 DELTA 2 of 2 (R-G03). Every founder return that reports a checker's detection rate reports the checker's clean-case refusal rate beside it, from the same session, and both numbers are reported or neither is. A checker with no clean-case rate resolves **unresolved, never pass** ([06-knowledge-evidence-evaluation.md](06-knowledge-evidence-evaluation.md) §6). The reason is that a detection rate alone cannot distinguish a checker that finds defects from one that refuses everything, and the founder is the reader who would act on the difference.

SPECIFICATION — the inheritance, stated because no F2 candidate cited it. [05-work-agents-skills.md](05-work-agents-skills.md) inherits this chapter's founder-competence mechanism by name: ParticipationPlan, ParticipationEncounter, DomainAssessment, AuthorityMatrix, DecisionPacket and GrievanceCase. All four encounter kinds are adopted — original customer material, an independent taste decision before advice, an unfamiliar financial or obligation interpretation, and an intervention or recovery rehearsal — on this chapter's fixed cycle, not only after an absence. That mechanism is the company's only error source uncorrelated with the model family's, which is why it is a fixed boundary rather than a preference; and this chapter's own sentence governs the rest — attendance, confidence and agreement with the model are explicitly not competence. **And the one construction 05 schedules on this chapter's cycle rides an existing kind rather than adding one:** its refusal-sample (05 §7) is drawn into the adverse stratum of the original-customer-material encounter, which already alternates ordinary with adverse, abandoned and underserved cases. It takes places in that stratum rather than adding places, sets no cadence, and adds no row to the attention admission below. It is therefore not a third delta: the two deltas above remain the whole of what the F2 round changes here (F6A-03). Acceptance sampling at the economic/contractual class is likewise governed there and not here: [05](05-work-agents-skills.md) §2 states which half of that acceptance is unsampleable and which is drawn to fill the batch minutes this chapter declares, and it sets no cadence, no encounter and no attention row in this chapter (F6B-05). The two properties that disposition leans on are restated here as SPECIFICATION, rather than left standing only in the proposed schedule above (F6V-04, 2026-09-14). First: the original-customer-material encounter carries an adverse/abandoned/underserved stratum — it alternates ordinary cases with adverse, abandoned and underserved ones — and that stratum exists whatever cycle length or encounter count the schedule is later given. Second: selection within strata uses a recorded reproducible random seed drawn outside the producing path, outside the account producer's write authority, and empty strata and unavailable originals are recorded rather than replaced by flattering examples. What remains DESIGN PROPOSAL in the paragraph above is the dose — the cycle length, the number of encounters per cycle and the minutes — and a revision of that proposal does not remove the two properties above. That is what keeps [05](05-work-agents-skills.md) §7's refusal-sample riding an existing stratum rather than becoming a third delta, and it is what **05 §7's refusal-sample paragraph* cites — named by paragraph rather than pinned to a line, deliberately (F6W-06). Amended 2026-09-14 (F6W-06): this read “it is what §192 of that chapter cites”. Line 192 of [05-work-agents-skills.md](05-work-agents-skills.md) is empty at the subject commit and the paragraph meant sits lower: the pin was correct at d8cf96e and went stale at a457be1 the same day, when the F6A-02 world-change sweep was inserted into §7 above it. The clause is the hinge of F6V-04's disposition — it asserts that the chapter relying on these properties cites them — so a reader following it landed on nothing and could not confirm the reliance. A corrected line number would rot on the next insertion above it, which is the conclusion this package has already reached about pinned line numbers in prose; the convention itself is sound and resolves elsewhere, since 05's pins to this chapter's §105 and §107 both land where they say.*

SPECIFICATION. Attention admission counts planned decisions, observed handling duration, interrupts, direct relationships, practice, recovery and duty-review time. Estimates remain estimates and are checked against actual minutes. The scheduler groups equivalent decision needs without merging distinct entitlements, reserves actual availability, and reduces new commitments before overload. When a batch reaches the chosen limit, remaining nonurgent decisions defer to the next declared window; their latest responsible times trigger substitute/continuity, never automatic approval. The number of decisions is not itself a universal limit: one complex material choice can consume the batch.

sections.heading: Collaboration, absence, succession and departure
sections.html:
Collaboration, absence, succession and departure

SPECIFICATION. Onboarding supplies original purpose/taste, protected exclusions, current domain responsibilities, actual access, routine procedures, unresolved disputes, evidence limits, imminent deadlines, reporting and stop paths. The newcomer acknowledges scope and performs a bounded access/understanding check. “Do not reopen” constraints identify their actual issuer and amendment route; newly discovered factual contradictions can still be reported without silently rewriting a settled personal value.

SPECIFICATION. A handoff includes original evidence and its permitted use, exact pending decisions, accepted duties, partial artifacts, unknown effects, deadlines, conditions for resumption, remaining resources and proposed next actions. Recipient acknowledgment of receipt differs from acceptance of responsibility. Responsibility transfers only after authority, competence and access checks and explicit scope acceptance. If rejected, the existing custodian or accepted alternate remains responsible. The requester sees the reason and continued service plan rather than hunting the next person.

SPECIFICATION. Absence mode is declared by authorized person or activated by a predeclared missed-contact/availability rule. Missing responsiveness cannot diagnose incapacity; it can trigger the already authorized operational fallback. The returning owner sees the difference from their last acknowledged position: direction changes, promises, actions/effects, decisions resolved/waiting, contradictory evidence, expenditures, source gaps, remaining duties and actual capacity. F2 DELTA 1 of 2 (R-G03). The re-entry brief additionally carries what was omitted and what was contested — not only what was decided. A brief reporting decisions alone reproduces, for the human, the hidden-profile failure in which agents do not surface information contradicting a consensus, and the omissions section is rendered from the record rather than narrated (see the typed founder-facing transfer in [05-work-agents-skills.md](05-work-agents-skills.md) §5, which requires a ConstraintSet on the founder-facing brief in the same schema as every machine transfer). Reading the recap does not reauthorize stale work. A staged month-long absence tests whether real due service, refunds, professional tasks and grievances were fulfilled or legitimately disposed of.

SPECIFICATION. Temporary substitution, departure, sale and succession have different actual authority and continuity arrangements. Departure stops new assignments, inventories and revokes effective native access including descendants, transfers duties with accepted acknowledgment, settles fees/worker duties, restricts retained records and provides permitted exports. A record cannot be erased to evade a claim; retaining a role indefinitely cannot justify indefinite personal-data retention. Full takeover requires actual lawful standing, capable human/service resources, keys/access, evidence and exercised operation. A one-person company is viable only within demonstrated capacity; missing complementary judgment is a limitation, not an agent role to invent.

sections.heading: Accessibility, faults, evaluation and source trace
sections.html:
Accessibility, faults, evaluation and source trace

SPECIFICATION. All surfaces require keyboard-operable inspection and commands, logical focus order, visible focus, meaningful labels, structured headings, screen-reader announcements for state changes, text equivalents for status/color, zoom/reflow without losing consequences, and alternatives to dragging or hover-only controls. Reduced motion is respected. Errors identify the field or failed contract and preserve entered safe text; they do not expose another party’s data. Critical controls remain reachable with large targets and deliberate confirmation of exact consequential terms, without relying on timed interaction or muscle-memory placement.

SPECIFICATION. Mobile starts with current scope, due consequences, uncertainty and available intervention. It never compresses away recipient, amount, first-send window, changed terms or unknown outcome. Complex packets persist as handoffs to a larger surface when required detail cannot be inspected usefully; they are not approved through a summary-only shortcut. Loss of connectivity distinguishes cached evidence from live authority; cached stop state stays “last observed” until independently confirmed.

SPECIFICATION. Conformance cases include: stale phone approving changed terms; duplicate response after lost acknowledgment; actor-switch or cross-company access attempt; interrupted terminal task restored on another permitted provider; unknown stop/released first-send window; unavailable original after deletion; a missing native source hidden by a fluent summary; joint owner/provider absence; a departing custodian’s unresolved grievance; limited owner batch with a true urgent duty; and a material competence misunderstanding with ample lawful authority. Each requires expected command/state/evidence outcomes and ordinary successful controls. Test accessibility with keyboard and assistive workflows, and actual human usability under authorized conditions; machine checks alone do not establish usefulness under stress.

sections.heading: Work, temporary agents and reusable procedures
sections.html:
Work, temporary agents and reusable procedures

SPECIFICATION. Contract: WORK-1.1 · architecture: S1.1 · authoring base: ca80355 · 2026-09-13; amends WORK-1.0 / S1.0 (cb1eac4, 2026-09-12). Status: Phase F specification, unimplemented and awaiting independent review. This amendment answers the F2 round for the work / agents / authority / tools / skills / context / shared-state / routing / task-state layer by adopting the five-layer synthesis of the F2 selection record §1, whose §12.1 is the section-by-section brief this revision implements. Six founder packets carry the (d)-class findings open against this layer; the count is of packets, not of findings, and they subsume nine consolidation findings between them. DECISION (founder, 2026-09-14, Q-017) — none of the six is closed entire and one is narrowed: MD-02's staffing question is answered, and AC-M4-02 closes with it — the consolidation's own required repair for AC-M4-02 was to "mark H9 a declared exception with the parking behaviour stated as the consequence", which is what the answer does, and §12 states the behaviour. Amended 2026-09-14 (F6Z-01): this read "they subsume ten consolidation findings between them. None is closed here and every one is a founder decision". True at authoring and falsified the same day by the founder's answer. The packet count does not move, because AC-M3-02's counting half and AC-M4-01's sampling limb survive the answer; §12 states what each still needs. Every packet is a founder decision: MD-01 (AC-M1-02 · AC-M5-02), MD-02 (AC-M3-02 · AC-M4-01 — AC-M4-02 closed 2026-09-14), MD-03 (AC-M1-01), MD-04 (AC-M4-03), MD-07 (AT-M3-03 · AE-M4-01 — whose holder-veto half is decided in §12, a stated minimum is evidence and not consent, while its stated-decider half is what the packet carries) and MD-08 (AE-M2-01). The ids beside each packet are the attack consolidation's; the packets are listed in the selection record §5.3 and written in its §6.5. One consolidation finding is in no packet and is closed by no passage, and it is recorded here as dissolved rather than left unlisted: AT-M5-03 (MD-24 in the consolidation's numbering, dimensions W2/W8) is dissolved by non-adoption**** — layer 3 adopts StandingInterest generically and does not adopt the semantic-conflict merge interest the finding was against, which is the same dissolution MD-20 takes; the interests this chapter names are credit-setting, refusal-sample, grievance and the pool interest. *Its residue is named rather than dropped: §6's pre-existing S1.0 sentence "C02 detects new overlap" for semantic — non-path — conflicts states no mechanism, and §9 conformance case 2 depends on it (F6A-05, added 2026-09-14; the header previously said neither that the finding dissolved nor why). Superseded 2026-09-14: this read “Five (d)-class findings remain open … AT-M3-03 (packet MD-07), AC-M1-01 (MD-03), AC-M1-02 (MD-01), AC-M4-02 (MD-02) and AE-M2-01 (MD-08) … A sixth packet, MD-04, carries no open (d).” It cited one id per packet where the consolidation merges two or three, so three (d)s on founder attention — AC-M3-02, AC-M4-01 and AC-M4-03 — appeared nowhere, MD-04's own (d) was denied, and “five” could be read neither as a count of findings nor as a count of packets. The ambiguity ran in the flattering direction, which is why the mapping is written out rather than counted (F6B-06).* Where this chapter states a rule whose value is one of those decisions, the rule's shape is written and the value is marked founder parameter, no default with its packet id. Per the F2 acceptance protocol §8 the layer is therefore not accepted: this is a scoped planning disposition of specified behaviour checked offline, not a runtime result, and it does not lift the founder's hold on building. This owns S02's 161 questions; the machine contract records each substantive answer, decision, evidence, uncertainty and planned module. It does not authorize operating resources or complete the later integration, deployment, improvement and unified-schema tracks.

Statement kinds (directive §6). Every substantive statement in this chapter carries one of: SPECIFICATION — our normative design, true by our decision and falsifiable only by our own tests; SOURCE CLAIM — attributed to a dated observation already registered in this package; DESIGN PROPOSAL — a construction offered for review, not yet decided; IMPLEMENTATION DISCOVERY — a fact learned by building, not decided in advance; UNKNOWN — a value or behavior this package does not establish, which constrains the dependent effect and never defaults to the permissive branch; DEFERRED — a question deliberately left open, with what would reopen it. A paragraph's opening label governs the whole paragraph unless a later clause carries its own; unlabelled prose inside a table cell inherits its row's kind. Nothing here is a runtime result.

SPECIFICATION. The kernel, authority/recovery, company procedures, human operation, capability catalog, and knowledge/evaluation contract form one specification. The frozen G protocol remains unchanged. SOURCE CLAIM. L04 and L08 support separating durable work from replaceable executors; UNKNOWN: their reported demonstrations do not establish our throughput or business value.

sections.heading: 1. Boundary, identity and responsibilities
sections.html:
1. Boundary, identity and responsibilities

SPECIFICATION. S1-C01 owns endorsed ends, responsibility and legitimate deciding domains. C02 owns admitted Cases, executable WorkOrders, scheduling, workflow cursors, delegated scope and total causal allowance. C03 produces staged artifacts and attributable reports. C05 supplies permitted context and current validity; C06 independently accepts the specified outcome. C04 alone controls consequences, and C08 owns independent recovery. C07 provides actual competent human/service performance; C09 presents current permission-filtered state. A workflow, skill, model or temporary worker cannot acquire any of these authorities by containing instructions to do so.

SPECIFICATION. All records use canonical RecordEnvelope, exact Ref, UTC timestamps, Position, resource quantities and kernel command results. accepted requires a committed, independently witnessed transition. It is distinct from output acceptance, effect observation, customer acceptance and duty discharge. Witness outage permits only existing admitted local computation within its surviving lease/context/allowance and the kernel's explicitly local StageRef save/export route. A StageRef is not a Ref, and importing it revalidates current restrictions. This document does not create another durability or receipt protocol.

SPECIFICATION. The machine file distinguishes canonical extensions, domain records and derived projections. Task is canonical WorkOrder; agent output is AttemptReport; Handoff uses Continuation plus accepted responsibility transfer; artifacts, claims, decisions and grants retain their canonical types. The prose labels “worker done,” “step done,” and “project complete” must always resolve to a named acceptance scope. No writable aggregate flag may override its underlying judgments or surviving obligations.

DESIGN PROPOSAL. Planned implementation is in the existing modular Node/TypeScript application, with protected PostgreSQL command/timer/inbox/outbox transactions. Proposed paths in the machine file are a build map, not existing modules. C03 executors remain outside protected credentials and writable registry state. Routine methods can share code and process boundaries where the kernel permits; there is no roster of permanent domain personas. *Amended 2026-09-15 (F6D-05): the grant-stripping probe result and the grant-inertness flag are written by the enforcement point that runs the probe and never by the skill record's producer — declared_tool_grant_effect, grant_stripping_probe_result, grant_stripping_probe_ref and content_hash_rechecked_at_use each carry owner: "S1-C04" on SkillVersion in [contracts/record-registry.json](contracts/record-registry.json), pinned as the producer_unauthorable_fields table in [contracts/pinned-conjuncts.json](contracts/pinned-conjuncts.json) — so this sentence and SkillVersion.owner_component: S1-C03 govern different things and stop contradicting each other: the record has a producing owner while the control fields over that producer do not.*

SPECIFICATION — the layer contract, and it is new in WORK-1.1. This chapter's rules are organised in five layers, each deciding a different question, with a fixed precedence: the lower-numbered layer governs when two disagree (selection record §1 and §5.1, rules R-L1…R-L5). L1 · consequence class decides who may act; L2 · a declared procedure decides how the work runs and what each step may see; L3 · typed standing interests decide when work becomes due; **L4 · an ExistenceJustification decides whether a worker may be created at all; L5 · a standing holder is the one party that exists for a duty outliving the case carrying it. Precedence is operative, not decorative: class may raise what a procedure permits and never lower it; an interest may arm but never admit above its effect class; an existence record may refuse a worker the class would permit but never create one the class forbids; and a holder may hold but never act. §11 states L1 and this precedence normatively; §12 states L5; §§2–8 carry L2, L3 and L4 in the sections that already own their subject matter. No fixed boundary of [02-architecture-selection.md](../02-architecture-selection.md) §3 is reopened, no seventh routing class is added and no record is renamed** — that is why the architecture version moves S1.0 → S1.1 rather than S2.0.

SPECIFICATION. The consequence class of an action is computed from records the acting party cannot author: the resolved parameters, the destination and egress identity, the selector closure over conflict claims / deletion scopes / open obligations, and the owning capability contract's declared floor. The derivation returns the set of routing classes the action reaches, and every reached class's gates apply. This restates [02-authority-recovery.md](02-authority-recovery.md) §4 — "Routing classes are predicates, not a total privilege rank" and "An action may satisfy multiple classes and must meet all their gates" — and changes nothing in it. No total rank, ordering or severity score is computed from the set (R-D22, closing AT-M4-02, which observed that a rank drops C2's human requirement on an action that is both C2 and C3). A tool's self-description and the text of a command are not inputs to the derivation; a boundary is real only if what is checked at the effect is what was granted (R4 F1, carried as R-X01's premise).
