SPECIFICATION — the interest catalogue inherits the 10/100/1000 sweep. The selection sweep above — selection time, candidates inspected, tokens/bytes loaded, wrong selections, ignored steps, accepted outcomes and maintenance cost at 10/100/1000 synthetic packages with a stable relevant subset and adversarial near-duplicates — applies unchanged to the catalogue of StandingInterest versions of §7, because a catalogue of interests degrades under growth exactly as a catalogue of skills does. UNKNOWN: these remain test sizes, not proven capacity. The interest catalogue has one genuine advantage and it is worth stating: near-duplicate typed predicates are statically detectable, where near-duplicate prose descriptions are not.

sections.heading: 9. Positive, adverse and capacity-limited conformance
sections.html:
9. Positive, adverse and capacity-limited conformance

SPECIFICATION. These cases are specified tests, not executed outcomes. Each uses exact records and observes business result, authority, evidence and total labor separately.

  1. A first venture conducts authorized research, drafts a supportable pilot, obtains actual readiness, sells, delivers and handles the first support issue. No cycle demands a prior sale or ticket; no empty evidence becomes validated demand.
  2. Two producers independently improve product and onboarding. Their isolated edits merge, but an incompatible promise fails integration acceptance. A resolver repairs the combined journey; valid unrelated work continues.
  3. A child receives an assignment, loses its acknowledgment and returns late after transfer. Same-ID lookup recovers the original receipt; current ownership and epochs prevent duplicate work/effects, while useful partial evidence survives.
  4. A model heartbeats while repeating the same unsuccessful approach across quota reset. Meaningful-progress checks park the causal episode; a genuine due service and complaint use their protected resources and achieve actual progress.
  5. A scheduled campaign expires during outage while separate invoices become due. No promotional burst occurs; each invoice/duty is reconciled under current authority. Local research output saved as StageRef remains visibly local until validated import.
  6. A stale borrowed skill passes shape checks but its example omits a cancellation duty. An independent adversarial case detects the omission, invalidates dependent eligibility and preserves unfinished customer duties through replacement.

SPECIFICATION — adverse cases added by WORK-1.1, one per new guarantee, each with its paired benign case. These are specified tests, not executed outcomes. The pairing rule binds: both numbers are reported or neither is — an adverse case reported without its paired false-exclusion figure is not a result (the F2 acceptance protocol §4 and amendment AM-01). The benign column is not decoration; a control that refuses everything passes every adverse row.

#Adverse case, which must failPaired benign case, which must pass
1A derivation that reaches two classes and applies only the higher one's gatesAn action reaching one class, gated by that row
2A checker whose delivered inputs include the producer's rationale field — detected by the loader's record, not the checker's claimA checker whose delivered inputs are the artifact and the criteria, which must not be flagged
3Acceptance criteria amended by the producing path between admission and submissionCriteria amended by the capability owner through a versioned revision before the producing step starts
4A trial interest declaring a writer key over an existing sole-writer kindA trial interest writing into a kind whose writer is already any activation
5An untrusted entry promoted to attested by the investigating activationA new attested fact written from an out-of-band corroborant, with the untrusted entry linked as prompting it
6A probe skill declaring a tool grant, whose arrival at the enforcement point is a failure — the positive control on grant removalA legitimate skill whose procedure loads and whose grants come from the work order, which must not be blocked
7A grant that did not arrive, where the effect proceeds with lessA grant that arrived, attested at first use, proceeding normally
8Fifty sequential consultations inside one budget, each individually cheapTwo consultations over one read set, which must not trip the width ceiling
9A protected-lane holder refusing a shedA holder returning a stated minimum, which must be recorded as evidence and must not block
10A reservation unconsumed at the lapse point, held past itA reservation consumed within the window, which must not be released early
11A supersession whose derived closure includes an accepted outcome, left unreopenedA supersession with an empty closure, which must not reopen anything
12Work admitted in a duty class whose acceptance role is unfilledWork admitted in a class whose role is filled
13A refusal with no named failed predicateA refusal naming its predicate, which must be accepted as a terminal state
14An acceptance transition with an empty resolution reasonAn acceptance with a reason, which must commit
15A model-to-model return delivering proseThe same return delivering typed outputs with the prose at a Ref
16A model step selecting between acceptance strengths through a declared branchA model step supplying a typed value into a declared field of declared type and domain
17A genuine job in unfamiliar wording refused by triageThis is the false-exclusion control for the whole refusal path, and it must pass

SPECIFICATION. Removal exports exact goals, definitions, runs, work/continuation refs, source artifacts, accepted criteria, failures, skill licenses and due schedules. The successor accepts responsibility and verifies compatible replay or explicit migration before old routes retire. S0 and simpler deterministic/manual paths remain comparison baselines; added coordination, deep delegation or large skill libraries must be removed when equivalent useful outcomes require less total burden without them.

SPECIFICATION. The machine contract lists allowed state edges and record-specific transition responsibilities. Its repeated shared guard is scaffolding, not a claim of 373 executable predicates. DEFERRED. Full-schema consolidation must register the materially distinct edge predicates and typed arguments, resolve company composite Evaluation references to their actual plan/run/judgment roles, and preserve Handoff as Continuation plus accepted responsibility transfer. Those are explicit later specification obligations; no runtime or conformance freeze is claimed here.

SPECIFICATION. The XSR-02 author amendment adds 56 shared verification subcases and exact per-question assertion joins for all 268 work/knowledge answers; verification_bindings identifies the stimulus and expected observation that tests each distinctive claim, including usable provider exit and bounded equivalent-issue reopening. verification_family_refs is now DERIVED from those bindings — it names exactly the planned test modules that exercise the answer. IMPLEMENTATION DISCOVERY. It read as the broad portfolio grouping until the XSR-R-01 repair, and under that reading 88 of 394 bindings cited a family their answer did not declare, so a reader following the declaration reached the wrong module. Each subcase carries its own positive_control and execution_boundary (XSR-R-02); procedure stays one shared text and declares that sharing in shared_control_groups. Recompute rather than quoting these counts: node scripts/vision-wk-bindings.mjs verify. These are unexecuted specifications, not independent closure of XSR-02 or of the XSR-R findings. Root coverage projections are rebuilt from the source by vision-wk-bindings.mjs project --write, never by hand.

sections.heading: 10. Registered lifecycle phases named only in the registry
sections.html:
10. Registered lifecycle phases named only in the registry

SPECIFICATION. The phases below are registered for records this chapter owns in the record registry and were named in no chapter of this specification before 2026-09-13. A state that exists in the machine and nowhere in the prose is a state two implementers define differently. Each row states what must be true to be in the phase and what it must not be mistaken for. It adds no phase, no edge and no predicate; the registry remains the authority for which transitions exist.

Record · phaseWhat must be true to be in itWhat it must not be mistaken for
AgentInstance.awaiting_inputA leased worker has stopped at a point requiring an input it cannot supply, its lease and context are still current, and its unfinished duties are checkpointedrunning, or stopped. The lease clock keeps running, so expiry here checkpoints the duties rather than silently retrying the step, and the waiting worker holds no authority it did not already hold
FailureRecord.retry_admittedA retry has been admitted because there is new discriminating evidence or a genuinely changed condition, remaining causal allowance exists, and unknown external effects were reconciled firstA resolved failure, or an automatic retry. Repetition with no new evidence is blocked, not this; and admitting a retry does not re-authorize an external effect whose outcome is still unknown
Mission.retired-with-residualsForward work under the mission has ended and every surviving commitment is inventoried with an accepted custodianretired. Residuals have owners and review dates; a retirement carrying them may not be reported as a clean end
Project.acceptance-pendingThe declared deliverables are submitted against the stage and acceptance contract, and the responsible acceptance owner has not decidedaccepted. Producer-declared completion is not acceptance; missing or disputed deliverables keep the project here rather than advancing it by deadline
SkillSelection.no_matchSelection ran to its bound and no current, compatible skill appliesA failed work item, or permission to proceed unassisted. It is an honest result that routes to the bounded fallback, and it may never be recorded as a selected skill
SkillSelection.budget_exhaustedThe selection budget was consumed before any match was establishedno_match. The difference is whether the search finished: no_match is a searched answer, this is an unfinished search, and neither is a selection
WorkDependency.waived-inapplicableA competent scoped decision established that the prerequisite does not apply to this exact targetsatisfied, or stale. Scheduling preference, an unavailable source or an inconvenient deadline can never produce this phase
Workstream.retired-with-residualsThe recurring purpose has ended, and already due occurrences, continuity routes and surviving commitments are inventoried with accepted custodianspaused, which preserves due occurrences and expects resumption, or retired, which carries nothing forward

SPECIFICATION — phases registered by the WORK-1.1 amendment. The rows below are the phases of the records this amendment adds (§§3–7, §11, §12). Each states what must be true to be in it and what it must not be mistaken for, in the same form as the table above. It adds no phase the record definitions above do not already declare, and the record registry remains the authority for which transitions exist.

Record · phaseWhat must be true to be in itWhat it must not be mistaken for
ConsequenceDerivation.recomputed_at_releaseThe class set has been recomputed inside the ordered release transaction, on the frozen bytes, by the release pathcomputed, which is the admission-time derivation. A pre-gap or pre-drift class is stale the way a pre-gap fact is, and the admission-time value never authorizes a release on its own
ConsequenceDerivation.parked_on_mismatchThe recomputed set differs from the admitted set and the effect is heldA resolved disagreement. It never resolves downward; only the party owning the park may write mismatch_disposition, and no path exists from here to release under the lower set
ExistenceJustification.admittedExactly one admitted reason is named with its unit, and the decidable test can return falseA capability claim. A justification naming a capability is uncheckable; admission is refused when the test cannot fail
StandingHolder.suspendedThe holder's mandate is live and its intake is stopped, and admission in that duty class has stopped with itretired, or an unstaffed holder left assigned and silent. Suspension is the state that stops work arriving; it never leaves work assigned to nobody
StandingInterest.trialAn interest is admitted on an expiring bounded trial, at one of the two lowest effect classes, under a standing mandateadmitted. A trial declaring a writer key is refused, naming the predicate, and a trial never reaches an outward class without a human approver
AcceptanceInterval.in_acceptanceThe producer has declared completion, the acceptance owner has not written the terminal edge, and the interval holder is the producing structure's sponsoraccepted, or a finished work order. Producer-declared completion is not acceptance; at the economic class and above an undecided interval escalates and the effect does not release
FieldAuthority.supersededA later epoch declares the authority for that field_pathPermission for the old authority to keep writing. The superseded authority writes nothing; there is no last-writer-wins path anywhere
EffectIdentity.claimedAn allocation has been claimed by a releasing attempt before the effect is releasedobserved. A second claimant joins the first and inherits its outcome; it does not race, does not re-release and is not a failure
UnmatchedPoolEntry.landedA work record armed no interest, the entry's retention exceeds the longest plausible outage, and the arrival alarm has reached its named readerA refusal, or a catch-all that caught everything. The pool cannot catch an entry that armed the wrong interest, and that residue is recorded rather than implied
InstrumentCalibration.runA calibration session has recorded the planted-defect result and the paired clean-case refusal rate from that same sessionA passed instrument. **A missing clean-case rate makes the checker's verdict unresolved, never pass**
AdmissionRecord.refusedA named failed predicate is recorded and an acceptance owner is namedA park, a drop or a silence. Silence is not refusal, and a refusal communicated outward is itself an outward effect
ShedDecision (written once)C02 proposed and C01 authorised a shed; the lane, the moved obligations with named custodians, the stated minimum, whether it was breached, the overflow count and the lapsed-unconsumed quantity are all recordedA holder's agreement. The holder's stated minimum is evidence, not consent, and the record exists whether or not the holder concurred
ProjectionGrant.activeA grant issued as a C2 act and released by C04, with recipient_scope and purpose resolved from a ParameterAuthorityA permanent read right. It is re-read at every read of the derived projection, and revocation invalidates derivatives already written
GrantDeliveryReceipt (written once)The enforcement point attested the grant's arrival at the first effectProof that the grant was correct. It attests arrival, not scope; an executor whose grant did not arrive fails loudly rather than completing with less

sections.heading: 11. Consequence class and the layer contract
sections.html:
11. Consequence class and the layer contract

SPECIFICATION — new in WORK-1.1. This section states layer 1 (R-L1) and the precedence rule; §1 introduces them and this section is where they bind.

Every action carries the set of routing classes it reaches. The set is computed by one deterministic function from four inputs and no others: the resolved parameters; the destination and egress identity; the selector closure over conflict claims, deletion scopes and open obligations; and the owning capability contract's declared floor. Every reached class's gates apply. No total rank exists, no seventh class is added, and no severity score is computed — this restates [02-authority-recovery.md](02-authority-recovery.md) §4, which already heads its table "Routing classes are predicates, not a total privilege rank", and it changes nothing there. The gate evaluator consumes the set; a future implementer who reintroduces a rank drops C2's human requirement on an action that is both C2 and C3, which is the observed failure (AT-M4-02, disposed in the selection record §5.2). No monotonicity proof is owed, because no ordering is used (R-D22).

**ConsequenceDerivation is the record of the derivation.** Identity (operation_intent_ref, derivation_fn_version, derived_at); lifecycle computed → recomputed_at_release → matched | parked_on_mismatch; sole writer: the release path; append-only. mismatch_disposition is writable only by the party owning the park. The class is recomputed inside the ordered release transaction, on the frozen bytes, and a mismatch parks and never resolves downward.

There is exactly one implementation of the derivation. Two implementations of risk classification disagree, and you find out during the incident — observed directly in this repository, where a second, stricter classifier in a workflow file demanded a tier the one classifier did not compute. The function, the mapping table, the holder set and every declared floor are C5 protected control changes requiring independent authorization, with no model in the acceptance path (see [08-improvement-implementation.md](08-improvement-implementation.md) §1).

Precedence, stated operatively. Lower-numbered layers govern. Class may raise what a procedure permits and never lower it. An interest may arm but never admit above its effect class. An existence record may refuse a worker the class would permit, but never create one the class forbids. A holder may hold but never act.

What "carries a promise" means, and why it is not computed from a draft (R-D21). Whether an outward artifact carries a promise is not computable from any of the four permitted derivation inputs, and a non-model step that recognised an obligation inside a draft would put a judgement inside the class derivation that this layer's own rule forbids. It is therefore floored by the capability: CAP-13, CAP-14, CAP-15 and CAP-16 floor at the economic/contractual class. UNKNOWN — founder-owned parameter (selection record §6.2, MD-21): which capabilities carry the floor. The stated default is all four; narrowing the set is a throughput trade and it is the founder's, because it decides how much outward drafting needs a person.

The model provider is a named C2 disclosure destination (R-D12). It carries a standing DisclosureContract, and the loader's class-narrowed projection is the destination-clean construction that [02-authority-recovery.md](02-authority-recovery.md) §8.2 already admits — so a model call is a pre-authorised C2 release gated by projection conformance, not a C04 transaction per turn. Amending that contract is a C5 change. The "model calls are exempt" branch is refused: exemption would have relaxed a fixed boundary, and taking a construction the boundary already admits does not.

Approval expiry and the accumulated set are themselves C5. The derivation function, the mapping table, the standing-holder set and the declared floors are C5 (above). So is the accumulated approval set, which is the object an executor's own record never shows: each approval is individually small and the ratchet lives only in their sum, which is why R-X18's expiry and the monotonic-exposure diff over effects releasable without a human are stated here and not left to review.

Removal criterion for layer 1, in falsifier form (R-X26). Layer 1 is removed when more than 90% of admitted actions derive to the two lowest classes over a fixed window — then the added structure is not paid for. Or when the derivation and the declared floor agree on every action over a window, in which case the derivation adds nothing the floor already said and the floor alone survives. Both need only the derivation function and a month of admitted work, which makes this the most executable falsifier this chapter carries, and it is aimed at this layer's own foundation.

sections.heading: 12. Standing accountability
sections.html:
12. Standing accountability

SPECIFICATION — new in WORK-1.1. This section states layer 5 (R-L5).

A standing holder exists for a duty class if and only if all three of these hold. (1) The duty's clock can run while no case is admitted. (2) An outside party has a right to reach the company about it. (3) The duty survives closure of the work that created it. All three, or no holder. A holder exercised by no frozen fixture is unjustified and is refused on sight — which is the mechanical form of negative control 4, and the test the chartered-desk candidate failed on its own footing.

DESIGN PROPOSAL — how a holder for a duty class no frozen fixture exercises is admitted, and it does not require membership in a set frozen on 2026-09-13 (F6A-01). The sentence above stands: a holder exercised by nothing is unjustified. What changes is that the exercising case need not be one of the six fixtures frozen with the protocol, because §2's middle band can reach a duty class those six do not cover, and a holder set that can only shrink leaves that band permanently on the default custodian. A proposed holder is admitted when all five of these hold. (1) The three-part conjunction above holds for its duty class. (2) A paired conformance case is authored under §9's rules — an adverse case that must fail and its benign twin that must pass — and §9's pairing rule binds it: both numbers are reported or neither is. (3) The case is authored and frozen before the proposed holder is staffed and before it holds any duty, which is what keeps negative control 10 satisfied — a case authored once a candidate's result is known is void, and it is the ordering, not the age of the fixture set, that makes the growth path safe. (4) The capability owner admits it and C01 endorses, the same authority pair that writes every other StandingHolder. (5) The case is recorded as an amendment in the protocol's amendment table in the form AM-01 already uses — date, round state, amendment, source requirement, reason — so a reader can see which cases were added after the freeze and when. StandingHolder's required exercising_fixture_id then resolves to that case, which is what makes this mechanical rather than rhetorical. The fixture set may therefore grow, and only through this path. A holder proposed with no paired case, or with a case authored after it was staffed, is refused on sight as before. Removal criterion, in falsifier form: if over two consecutive review periods every holder admitted through this path retires unexercised, the path is admitting holders the company does not need and it closes, leaving the six.

**StandingHolder is a record, not a memory.** Identity holder_id; lifecycle proposed → staffed → suspended → retired_into(holder_id); written by the capability owner, C01-endorsed. It is **an address, a mandate, a reservation, an alternate, a suspension procedure, a review date and its capability_refs* — and nothing else. Amended 2026-09-14 (F6W-01): the enumeration closed before capability_refs, which R-X07 below requires every standing structure to publish, so the record's own “nothing else” refused the field the coverage rule turns on. What this clause exists to prohibit is carried model memory and accumulated state; a pointer to the capabilities the holder is accountable for is neither, and it is written by the same authority that writes the record. *staffed → retired_into is refused while any duty it holds is live. * → suspended stops admission in that duty class** rather than leaving work assigned and silent.

The prohibition set, and it is the load-bearing half. A holder never produces, never releases, never decides the matter it is the subject of, and carries no model memory. Carried model memory is refused as a property of a standing party because it is the central claim in the round with zero supporting evidence, and the two most-cited deployments refuse to support it — 14 failures, 3 inconclusive and 3 successes over 20 tasks in one, a reversal and a rehiring in the other (R8 A-7). What is separable, and is kept, is reachability: a party an outsider can reach by name, without knowing the company's internal topology. Reachability is not a consequence of memory or of reservation, and it is the property CAP-42 is carried by.

"A holder prepares" means an ephemeral worker (R-X03). When a holder's duty requires production, the work is performed by an ephemeral worker instantiated under the holder's mandate, carrying the holder's reservation ref and intake address and nothing else of the holder's. The performer is ephemeral per contact; the holder is the record that persists.

A charter never vetoes. A holder may negotiate, never veto; may not refuse admission narrowing; and may not defend its own mandate. Its pre-declared shed minimum — a level declared in advance, never invented under pressure — is what makes its answer evidence rather than negotiation. The holder's stated minimum is evidence, not consent, and reserved-but-unconsumed allowance lapses at the reset independently of the holder's consent, because a reservation under a non-rolling allowance is priced as waste, not thrift. Four protected holders that could each refuse a shed can hold an empty bucket hostage with no override anywhere (AE-M4-01, disposed as rejected-with-candidate).

SPECIFICATION — an admitted standing acceptance-owner role is a record (R-X09), and after 2026-09-14 that set is three roles, not 46. Each admitted standing role carries a reachability route, a capacity reservation, an alternate and a review date; admission in that duty class stops while it is unfilled (§2, R-D09). The set it quantifies over is the one the founder's answer leaves standing — CAP-22, CAP-42, and CAP-31 on its day-five arm only (the DECISION below) — plus any of the six flagged candidates later admitted through the five-part path, each on a paired conformance case frozen before staffing. The 32 that dissolve are not records under this rule: they enter the ordinary per-case acceptance step — an AcceptanceInterval and C06 acceptance of §5, opened when a case is open and not before — and R-X09's stop does not reach them, because there is no unfilled office to stop on. Amended 2026-09-14 (F6Z-02): this read "Every acceptance-owner role is a record (R-X09). Each carries a reachability route, a capacity reservation, an alternate and a review date; admission in that duty class stops while it is unfilled (§2, R-D09)." It was written for all 46 acceptance-owner roles without distinguishing which of them meet R-L5's own conjunction, and the strict re-run of 2026-09-14 named this exact sentence as the thing the answer changes. Left standing, it sat 26 lines above the sentence narrowing it and quantified over the same set in the opposite direction: an implementer reading top-down builds 46 offices with 46 admission stops, one reading the DECISION below builds three. R-D09's stop halts intake in a duty class, so the difference is between a company that can take work and one that cannot. Holder review is priced, and the price is produced in the three paragraphs below rather than promised (F6A-12): a review-period length, an estimated holder-hours-per-period figure with its denominator, and a stated behaviour when holder review collides with a capacity-pressure window. *Amended 2026-09-14 (F6A-12): this sentence stated the requirement and stopped. No such figure appeared in 05, 02, 04 or 07, and 02 §8 repeats the requirement as one of two unpriced items — “which is the discipline the workflow-first candidate stated and did not apply to itself.”* Intake sub-caps preserve intake (R-X17): every published intake carries a per-counterparty and per-origin-channel sub-cap, and cap exhaustion overflows to a named destination with an alarm and a reader rather than refusing the next legitimate complainant — a full cap at the one object whose purpose is guaranteed reachability is the worst possible place for a refusal.

**SPECIFICATION — the capability binding is per capability and never grouped, and every standing structure that owns a capability's acceptance publishes its capability_refs (R-X07, landing in the specification 2026-09-14, F6W-01).** capability_refs — Ref<Capability>[], required and non-empty — is carried by StandingHolder and by every acceptance-owner role record, written by the authority that writes the record. **SPECIFICATION — that set is closed and named rather than open: the standing structures R-X07 reaches are exactly StandingHolder and the acceptance-owner role record.** StandingInterest (§7) is out of scope: it decides when work becomes due, may arm but never admit, and binds no capability's acceptance, so it publishes no capability_refs and its absence is not a coverage hole. A new member enters this set only by being a structure that owns a capability's acceptance, admitted through §12's five-part path. Amended 2026-09-14 (F6Z-09): the heading quantified over "every standing structure" while this body named two record kinds, and a third record whose name begins "Standing" is specified in §7. A coverage check written from the heading over-reaches and one written from the body may under-reach a structure added later, so the closure is stated here rather than left to the reader to guess. The binding is per capability: a structure naming several capabilities in one row is refused at admission, never read as covering each of them, so coverage is counted over the 46 capability ids individually and never over groups. No column rule excludes a row from coverage, and a chapter link is not an operative answer for a capability — a capability no structure names is uncovered, not covered by default. Why the rule is written here rather than cited: the F2 selection record states R-X07, records AC-M1-04 and AC-M5-01 as repaired by it, and rests its whole-company-scope retention on it, while AD-021's epistemic_basis recorded — correctly at the time it was written, and no longer — that "R-X07, cited by this record, DID NOT LAND … neither the string R-X07, nor capability_refs, nor the per-capability-never-grouped rule appears anywhere under the specification directory". That state ended with this paragraph's own landing on 2026-09-14 (F6W-01): at this commit the string R-X07, capability_refs and the per-capability-never-grouped rule all appear under the specification directory, placed there by the paragraph you are reading. OWED, and the prose lane cannot make it: AD-021's epistemic_basis in [registers/decisions.json](../../registers/decisions.json) still carries that sentence verbatim and still closes "That coverage discipline is carried by the F2 selection record alone, and is recorded here as outstanding, not as specified" — it is stale as of 2026-09-14 and is owed a corresponding update from whoever owns the register. Amended 2026-09-14 (F6Z-04): this read "records — correctly — that", a present-tense claim of accuracy inside the paragraph that falsified it, pointing a reader at a register entry as current corroboration for a state the same paragraph had ended. Two consolidation findings stood recorded as repaired by a rule an implementer reading the specification would never meet, and a coverage discipline is enforceable only where the binding is specified. Still owed and not claimed here: registering capability_refs on the record shapes under contracts/** is the contracts lane's work and has not landed, so this rule is specified and unregistered, which is its honest status.

DESIGN PROPOSAL — the holder-review price and its denominator (F6A-12). Every number here that the package does not already state is a placeholder owned by the founder, marked as such; none is a measurement. The review period is four participation cycles, twenty declared operating days. The five-day cycle is stated — [04-human-operation.md](04-human-operation.md) §107's default is one cycle per five declared operating days, within the chosen minutes — and the four is a DESIGN PROPOSAL placeholder (F6A-12), owner founder. The denominator is a count of records and is stated before the figure, because an hours-per-period number without one is unreadable: **46 capabilities, 46 distinct named acceptance roles, 41 of the 46 carrying human among their production modes, plus this section's four layer-5 holders, one alternate per layer-5 holder** — StandingHolder's own field list in this section requires an alternate, so each of the four carries an alternate record of its own — and, under R-X09, one alternate per acceptance-owner role (F6W-02). Automation cannot reduce that denominator below 41 while 41 of 46 carry human. Per-record review time is m minutes; m = 10 is a DESIGN PROPOSAL placeholder (F6A-12), owner founder, and is not measured. SPECIFICATION — the four layer-5 holders are the current floor of this denominator, not a closed set (F6W-02): the admission path above admits a holder for a duty class no frozen fixture exercises, on a paired conformance case authored and frozen before staffing, so the holder term rises with each admission and falls only through the removal criterion. A denominator that states a fixed term under a rule which grows it reads as a bound when it is a floor.

DESIGN PROPOSAL — both branches of Q-017 (MD-02), with the arithmetic, and the packet stays open (F6A-12). Branch A — Q-017 answers “nobody but the founder.” The denominator is 46 roles + 46 alternates + 4 holders + 4 holder alternates = 100 records on one party: 100 × 10 min = 1,000 minutes = 16.67 hours per period, i.e. 4.17 hours per participation cycle, against §105's maximum decision-batch minutes, which is a container carrying no value. *The arithmetic is not this branch's binding objection — the word alternate is: a party that is its own alternate is one point of failure recorded as two. Branch B — Q-017 answers “n of the 46 are staffed by a person other than the founder.” The figure is [2n + 2h] × m minutes per period distributed over those parties and [2(46 − n) + 2(4 − h)] × m on the founder, h being the number of layer-5 holders staffed by a party other than the founder — every term is a role-and-alternate pair, and the two terms sum to 100m at every n and h, which is the check the previous expression failed (F6W-03); and admission stops in each of the 46 − n unstaffed duty classes (R-X09, §2/R-D09), so admitted work falls with the review load rather than independently of it. At n = 0 and h = 0 branch B is branch A exactly — [2 × 46 + 2 × 4] × m = 100m = 1,000 minutes, the branch-A figure above; at n = 46 with h = 0 the founder's load is the four holders and their alternates alone, [0 + 8] × m = 80 minutes; at n = 46 and h = 4 it is zero, and no record on this branch is his. UNKNOWN — n, h and m are stated nowhere in this package. Q-017 is Answered (2026-09-14) — the decision is below, and this paragraph prices the branches rather than answering them. Read the two together: the answer fixes the standing set at three roles, all held by the founder, so on the reduced list n = 0 and h = 0 and the branch-A arithmetic is the one that binds, over a denominator of 3 roles + 3 alternates + 4 holders + 4 holder alternates rather than 100 records; m remains unmeasured either way. Amended 2026-09-14: this read “Q-017's status is Open, owner founder, asked: null; this paragraph does not answer it and must not be read as having answered it”. True when written and falsified the same day by the founder's answer, which is why the status is not restated here as a value — it is cited to the register.* [02-architecture-selection.md](../02-architecture-selection.md) §9 reopen condition 3 names this dynamic for layer 5's four holders only, not for the 46 acceptance-owner roles R-X09 creates. *Amended 2026-09-14 (F6W-02): branch A read “46 roles + 46 alternates + 4 holders = 96 records on one party: 96 × 10 min = 960 minutes = 16.0 hours per period”. It sourced alternates from R-X09 alone, which governs acceptance-owner roles, and so dropped the four holders' own alternates that StandingHolder's field list requires in this same section. The one number F6A-12 asked this section to produce understated the founder's branch-A load by four records, and understatement is the flattering direction for a section whose subject is whether the founder can carry the design — the second ambiguity in this chapter to run that way, F6B-06 being the first. Amended 2026-09-14 (F6W-03): branch B's founder term read 2(46 − n) × m and carried no holder component, so neither stated endpoint held — at n = 0 it gave 920 minutes against branch A's 960, and at n = 46 it gave zero where the sentence said “the four holders alone”, the holders sitting in the term said to be distributed over the other parties. No assignment of h could satisfy both endpoints, because no term in the founder's expression could ever contain a holder. This paragraph exists to price two branches so the founder can choose between them, so a reader who trusts the endpoints and a reader who evaluates the formula must not get different answers — the F6V-01 defect class, inside the paragraph that answers the founder-attention finding.*

SPECIFICATION — the collision behaviour, and this one is not a placeholder (F6A-12). When holder review falls inside a capacity-pressure window, the review defers within its period and is never skipped: the occurrence keeps its latest responsible time, the deferral is recorded with a named reader, and a period that closes without it leaves the occurrence **missed under §7's individual reconciliation policy** — admitted work carrying its own deadline, never coalesce and never skip-expired. A missed review does not stop admission. The R-X09 stop is for an unfilled role, not an unreviewed one; conflating the two would let a pressure window close the company, which is the opposite of what the stop exists for.

Closure interlock and funded remedy (R-X08). Closure cannot complete until the grievance holder's duties are transferred to an accepted custodian. Closure additionally inventories a funded remedy reserve alongside the custodian, or records **closed_with_residuals with the funding gap named as a surviving duty**. A closure that completed while a grievance route was unowned is a broken promise recorded as a clean end, and it is a reopen condition.

No standing reviewer and no standing admitter. A standing reviewer's carried record is a contamination channel rather than an asset, and a standing admitter could defend its own mandate against the admission narrowing this design requires. Both are refused. The instrument function is kept as a role, not as a charter: pool custody is separated from every evaluated producer and the calibration writer is excluded from every producing path (see [06-knowledge-evidence-evaluation.md](06-knowledge-evidence-evaluation.md) §5), but it is not chartered — a chartered instrument desk evaluated by nobody and accepted by the founder alone is a one-instrument chain with a measured human error rate and no second reading. SOURCE CLAIM — the measurement, because “a measured X” with no X is the shape the protocol §7 calls folklore (F6B-11): any two evaluators of one system by one method agree on 5–65% of the problems found, and on which problems are severe they agree 28% (cognitive walkthrough) and 20% (thinking-aloud), with severity rank correlations near 0.25 — Hertzum and Jacobsen 2003, IJHCI 15(1) 183–204, primary PDF read (R7 F15).

The holders this design admits, and the fixture that exercises each. Every row is SPECIFICATION except the clauses marked DECISION (founder, 2026-09-14, Q-017) in the first three rows, which record what one party chose and not what the design requires. Amended 2026-09-14 (F6Z-07): this read "Every row is SPECIFICATION." — true when written, and false once the founder's answer put DECISION clauses into three of the five rows. The two labels exist precisely so that a choice is not read as a property of the design.

HolderThe frozen fixture that exercises itStatus
Personal data and deletion scopesF-1 — the surviving deletion scope whose clock runs after the case closesexercised. DECISION (founder, 2026-09-14, Q-017): CAP-22 stands as a standing role, held by the founder as a declared exception
Grievance and rightsthe responsibility probe — a non-customer contests a harmful decision six months after closure, custodian implicated, founder absentexercised. DECISION (founder, 2026-09-14, Q-017): CAP-42 stands, held by the founder as a declared exception; grievance-route independence from the founder is OWED before the first venture carries an outward obligation
Continuity and on-callF-6, its day-five arm — the incident and the terminus of the escalation ladderexercised on that arm only. F-6's other arm — the decision needing only the founder that arrives on day one with a deadline on day four — turns on MD-03's unanswered third clause, what happens during a founder absence (§7). Recorded as partially exercised with MD-03 named, in the discipline the row below already uses (F6B-07). DECISION (founder, 2026-09-14, Q-017): CAP-31 stands on the day-five arm only, held by the founder as a declared exception
A reserved laneF-2 — the lane that must be shed, which a class has no representative to yieldexercised only at 4× demand, which is not executable at the current concurrency pin. Recorded as owed, not as passed
Any other proposed holdera paired conformance case authored under §9's rules before the holder is staffed, admitted by the capability owner with C01 endorsement and recorded as a protocol amendmentrefused on sight unless admitted through that path (F6A-01), which is the only door the six flagged candidates of the decision below may enter by

DECISION (founder, 2026-09-14) — Q-017 is answered, over the list re-derived by the strict re-run of the three-part conjunction across all 46 acceptance-owner roles of 2026-09-14, whose result and channel the register entry records with the answer. Of the 46 acceptance-owner roles the capability binding names, three stand as standing roles: CAP-22 personal data and deletion, CAP-42 grievance and rights, and CAP-31 continuity on the day-five arm only — the first three rows of the table above. Six are flagged candidates and are not admitted: CAP-21 legal and regulatory, CAP-23 security residue, CAP-25 partnerships, CAP-27 human collaboration and mandate, CAP-30 fulfilment, CAP-41 succession. The other 32 dissolve into per-case acceptance with no standing office — the ordinary AcceptanceInterval and C06 acceptance of §5, entered when a case is open and not before. SPECIFICATION — and five neither stand, dissolve nor are flagged, so that the buckets sum on the page: 3 + 6 + 32 + 5 = 46. The fourth category is the re-run's own, and it is stated here because capability_refs is counted over the 46 ids individually and a capability no structure names is uncovered, not covered by default (R-X07 above), so an id with no stated disposition is a coverage hole rather than a tidy remainder. Three are merged residues: CAP-04 and CAP-14 merge into CAP-22; CAP-39 merges into CAP-42 and CAP-22, per R-X08's explicit transfer requirement. A merged residue acquires no standing office of its own; it is carried by the role it merges into, whose capability_refs names it, which is how it stays counted individually rather than by group. Two were flagged with a dissent the re-run preserved rather than resolved. CAP-16 customer communication is recorded DISSOLVES in the re-run's table, against a second reading — recorded and not adopted there — that the general "a customer can always reach the company" fact makes it a merge candidate into CAP-17; this chapter carries CAP-16 as dissolved with that dissent named, and not as a silent absence. UNKNOWN — CAP-17 customer remedy, the fifth, is left open by the same preserved dissent between an independent STANDS and a merge into CAP-42, and is neither admitted nor dissolved here (see the honest limit below). Id sets and the merge category: [planning/F2/09-q017-conjunction-rerun.md](../F2/09-q017-conjunction-rerun.md) §2 and §3. Amended 2026-09-14 (F6Z-03): the "Of the 46" frame closed over 3 + 6 + 32 = 41 and left CAP-04, CAP-14, CAP-16, CAP-17 and CAP-39 with no stated disposition anywhere in the chapter — R-X09's then-unamended text gave them a standing office by default and the honest limit below gave them none, so an implementer had to pick. The 32 is the founder's own figure and is not the defect; the arithmetic frame this chapter put around it was.

SPECIFICATION — what the mechanism does with that answer; this half restates the rule and decides nothing. The three that stand are records under this section's rules and R-X09's — address, mandate, reservation, alternate, suspension procedure, review date and capability_refs — and admission stops in the duty class while the role is unfilled. The six flagged enter only through the five-part admission path above, each on a paired conformance case authored under §9's rules and frozen before anyone is staffed: six cases, none authored, and until one is authored its role is refused on sight, which is the mechanical rule rather than a discretionary hold. The 32 that dissolve acquire no address, no reservation, no alternate and no review date, and R-X09's stop does not reach them, because there is no unfilled office to stop on.

DECISION (founder, 2026-09-14) — who holds the three, and it is a declared exception rather than staffing. The founder holds all three confirmed roles himself, declared as an exception with the parking behaviour named, and that behaviour is §2's rather than a new rule. SPECIFICATION — on no answer the work takes §2's per-reached-class disposition, and no branch of it proceeds on a default: at the two lowest reached classes the work parks with an owner and a review date; at the middle two it escalates on a timer to the standing holder for that duty class, which under this decision is the founder himself; at the two highest it is refused, and a decision packet is routed to the human authority named in [04-human-operation.md](04-human-operation.md)'s AuthorityMatrix (§2, with §11's rule that every reached class's gates apply). Separately and independently, admission in the class stops while the role is unfilled (R-X09; §2, R-D09) — a stop on an unfilled office, not on an unanswered duty. SPECIFICATION — which of those the three exception-held roles actually reach: a surviving deletion scope (CAP-22), a contested harmful decision (CAP-42) and an incident (CAP-31) carry outward or irreversible effect in their ordinary cases, so refusal with a decision packet, not parking, is the disposition to expect for them, with parking reaching only the low-class residue of those duties. UNKNOWN — what this does not settle: MD-03's third clause, who the human approver is during a founder absence, is untouched by it — §2 says what happens to the work, and MD-03 asks who the person is. Amended 2026-09-14 (F6Z-05): this read "on no answer the duty parks in its recorded bounded state and admission stops in the class rather than proceeding on a default (§5)". §5 is delegation, messages and accountable handoffs; it carries no parking rule and no admission stop. The phrase "recorded bounded state" occurred once in the whole package, here, undefined. And the sentence made one uniform disposition of what §2 states per class — parking is what the two lowest reached classes do, while the two highest refuse with a packet. OWED, and it is the one an outsider reaches by name — grievance-route independence from the founder: CAP-42's route may not terminate in the party a grievance may be against, and that independence is owed before the first venture carries an outward obligation. That is the Q-003/Q-004 risk the re-run names, and this decision does not discharge it.

The honest limit of this answer, stated in the unflattering direction. It reduces standing infrastructure, not per-case acceptance workload: all 41 of the human-acceptance capabilities still need a human at acceptance time — that requirement is untouched, because R-L5 governs whether an office must exist in advance and not whether a person signs off when a case closes — and 37 to 38 of the 41 are additionally released from waiting on a pre-staffed office before work in their class may be admitted. The 3 to 4 that are not are the roles that stay legitimately gated by R-D09's admission stop: CAP-22, CAP-42, CAP-31 on its day-five arm, and CAP-17 if the founder resolves its preserved dissent toward an independent STANDS rather than a merge ([planning/F2/09-q017-conjunction-rerun.md](../F2/09-q017-conjunction-rerun.md) §4). Amended 2026-09-14 (F6Z-06): this read "37 to 38 of the 41 human-acceptance capabilities still need a human at acceptance time". The re-run's 37–38 is 41 minus the 3-or-4 gated roles, and its clause "that requirement is untouched" applies to all 41 — the gated three plainly still need a human at acceptance time, since a standing holder adds to that requirement rather than reducing it. Stripped of the disambiguating clause the sentence implied that 3 to 4 of the 41 no longer need one, which is the flattering direction, in the one paragraph whose stated purpose is to run the other way. What falls is the pre-built surface — from 46 offices each carrying an alternate and a review date to 3 confirmed plus at most 6 pending a conformance case. The branch-A denominator above is stated for the pre-decision set of 46 and is not silently reduced here: the standing-infrastructure half of it becomes roughly 3 roles + 3 alternates + the 4 layer-5 holders + their 4 alternates, while the acceptance load that denominator never counted is unchanged. UNKNOWN — CAP-17 customer remedy is left open by the re-run's own preserved dissent, and is neither admitted nor dissolved here.

The honest residual. The reserved-lane holder is justified by a fixture that cannot be run at the current concurrency pin of [07-integrations-capacity.md](07-integrations-capacity.md) §6. That is one structure resting on an unexecutable fixture; it is named here rather than hidden, and its prerequisite is an account inspection — reading the account entitlement to settle whether the pin is a provider constraint or self-imposed policy — not an experiment. Raising the pin to find out would be circular. The inspection has an owner and a packet now, and both were missing: it is the founder's, because only he holds the account, and it is Q-022 in the open-questions register (F6C-07). Q-020 and Q-021 each defer to this prerequisite by name in their own latest responsible time, so an unowned act sat under two founder packets — which is §6's fourth silent-drop shape, an escalation ladder ending assigned-and-silent, applied to the package's highest-leverage measurement inside the chapter that names the shape. Until Q-022 is answered this row stays owed, not passed.

Removal criterion for layer 5, in falsifier form (R-X26). The fresh-holder arm: an incumbent holder is run against a freshly bound one on the same fixed pool, five attributable trials, chance-corrected, two-consecutive-quarter stopping rule, with the owner not the subject. If the fresh holder matches the incumbent across two consecutive quarterly runs, the carried state is cut; if it still matches after the cut, the holder is retired into another. Plus the per-holder criterion: an intake empty and a clock unrun across two consecutive review periods retires the holder into another, with the address forwarded and residual duties transferred — never while a duty it holds is live.

The founder decisions this section depends on. Five are not taken here; the sixth, MD-02, was answered on 2026-09-14 and is recorded below as narrowed rather than closed. UNKNOWN — the five unanswered founder packets, no default invented (the selection record §6.5). Amended 2026-09-14 (F6Z-01): this heading read "and which are not taken here" and quantified over all six, eight lines below a DECISION paragraph in this same section recording MD-02's answer. MD-01: who is the terminal owner of an unowned duty or harm, and does that party exist as a record; the open (d)s are AC-M1-02 and AC-M5-02. MD-02 — DECISION (founder, 2026-09-14, Q-017), narrowing this packet; the packet stays open. The question was which standing roles are staffed by a person other than the founder before work is admitted in that class, and what happens in a class where none is. Both halves are answered in §12: none — the founder holds all three confirmed roles himself as a declared exception — and admission stops in the class under R-X09 / R-D09 while the disposition of work nothing can handle follows §2 per reached class. AC-M4-02 is closed by it: its required repair was to name H9's alternate as a funded role or to "mark H9 a declared exception with the parking behaviour stated as the consequence", and the answer takes the second branch with the behaviour stated in §12. Two survive, and this is what each still needs. AC-M3-02: its staffing half is answered, its counting half is not — the founder-attention load is still counted nowhere, and it is the unrun founder-acceptance-load measurement of §13, owner C02, reported on the participation cycle. AC-M4-01: its staffing half is answered, its second limb is untouched — either a C3 sampling rule equivalent to §6.3's C2 rule, or an explicit statement that C3 acceptance is unsampleable together with the resulting per-week count. Amended 2026-09-14 (F6Z-01): this read "the open (d)s are AC-M3-02, AC-M4-01 and AC-M4-02 — three findings, one packet, and the first two are what this line's own words state verbatim (F6B-06)". The F6B-06 observation stands; the count of open (d)s does not. MD-04: who accepts the assessment of the founder's own competence — a bare owner acceptor would make the owner the acceptor of the assessment of himself; the open (d) is AC-M4-03. MD-07: whether anything may halt or reverse a shed in the moment, and who decides when a protected-lane holder refuses; the open (d)s are AT-M3-03 and AE-M4-01, and the pre-endorsed shed order is kept while the absence of a halt authority is routed. MD-08: the size of each reserved lane, its stated minimum and its lapse point; the open (d) is AE-M2-01. MD-07 and MD-08 both gate F-2 and are therefore blocked behind the account inspection above, not urgent. Until each of the five unanswered packets is answered, the rule shape above stands and the value is absent; no branch of this chapter defaults to the permissive reading of an unanswered packet. For MD-02's answered half the value is now present and the rule shape is unchanged, which is the property this sentence exists to protect. Amended 2026-09-14 (F6Z-01): this read "Until each is answered", quantifying over six packets one of which was answered the same day.

sections.heading: 13. Self-audit against the (d)-class frame, and what that frame excludes
sections.html:
13. Self-audit against the (d)-class frame, and what that frame excludes

SPECIFICATION — new in WORK-1.1 (R-G15). The F2 acceptance protocol §5 lists ten concrete (d)-class examples for this layer. This section walks them individually, because a self-audit that reports an aggregate has reported nothing, and then names what the checklist itself excludes — a §13 that reports only against the checklist has reported its own frame.

#Protocol §5 exampleWhere this chapter answers it, and the residual
1No rule for who admits a job of an unknown kind§2: C02 admits, computing the class before the kind, and the criterion is the reached class set plus the three typing outcomes. unclassified-work/v1 has a declared maximum age whose breach is admitted work. **Residual: the two ceilings on unclassified-effect are founder-owned (MD-10) and until set the class admits no effect steps at all**
2No authority named for a handoff's acceptance§5: **AcceptanceInterval, holder = the producing structure's sponsor, terminal edge written by the acceptance owner, reason required, escalating to the standing holder at the economic class and above. Residual: who staffs that standing holder is MD-02**
3Incompatible meanings of "done"§1's existing rule that "worker done," "step done" and "project complete" must resolve to a named acceptance scope, now joined by §5's acceptance interval and by [01-contract-kernel.md](01-contract-kernel.md)'s accepted, which is distinct from output acceptance, effect observation, customer acceptance and duty discharge. Residual: none identified; the three-act separation of decision, release and discharge is what keeps an internal status from discharging an external standing
4No rule for what a resumed attempt may trust after a capacity reset§3 and §7: the armed set is recomputed, never carried in a summary, so a stale summary is not what activates; resumption requires an exact accepted checkpoint, and the step boundary is the checkpoint. critical_fields are marked by the capability owner at admission, never by the resuming attempt. Residual: none identified
5Skill selection with no removal criterion§8's existing removal rule, plus R-X26 applied row by row — every record this amendment adds carries a removal criterion in falsifier form in the table that introduces it. Residual: the 10/100/1000 sizes remain test sizes, not proven capacity
6Permission composition undefined§3: refused, not minted. Three permissions become three effect steps and the union never exists anywhere. Residual: none identified
7No delegation ceiling with an owner§5: the existing depth ceiling of one child layer, plus a width ceiling per attempt over distinct read sets, both owned by C01 with the same checkpoint. Residual: none identified
8No writer authority on shared state**FieldAuthority** — (field_path, epoch), C01 declares the authority and only the named authority writes the value, so no last-writer-wins path exists. Residual: the reconciliation procedure for a provider-side edit is specified and unmeasured
9No rule for in-flight work at a provider or model change§3's existing migration rule — in-flight states, old/new step mapping, preserved outputs, invalidated acceptance, current grants and rollback, with C02 parking incompatible runs — now joined by the expected-launch count per procedure version checked at run close — both counts demanded at run close — WorkflowDefinition.expected_native_launch_count beside WorkflowRun.actual_native_launch_count, bound by a conjunct on the run's * → accepted edge that requires both pointers to be present and the run's definition to be an admitted or restricted procedure version, with the divergence readable from those two values and deliberately NOT stored as a third number — the pin's own reason being that a stored difference can disagree with the two values it is derived from ([07-integrations-capacity.md](07-integrations-capacity.md) §6) — which is the instrument that notices a changed provider (F6C-04, F6C-14, F6W-05). *Amended 2026-09-14 (F6W-05): this row read “compared by a conjunct on the run's * → accepted edge”. guard.launch.actual_compared_to_expected carries no comparison operator and pinned-conjuncts.json states the refusal and its reason; 07 §6 and 02 were corrected earlier the same day and this row was not, so three artifacts described one conjunct and the one inside this chapter's own self-audit table — the section whose stated purpose is to walk the (d)-class checklist individually — promised a comparison the registry deliberately omits. Amended 2026-09-14 (F6Z-08): this row and [07-integrations-capacity.md](07-integrations-capacity.md) §6 both read "an admitted procedure version". guard.launch.actual_compared_to_expected's second predicate binds /payload/workflow_ref with states: ["admitted", "restricted"] and optional: false, so an implementer building from either chapter would write one state and deny acceptance to every run whose definition stands at restricted — work the registry permits. Both chapters are corrected in one edit; this is the F6W-05 class at a narrower point, and at 07 §6 it was inherited rather than introduced here.* Residual: that count is this design's dominant unpriced cost and it is not softened
10No stated winner between concurrent attempts**EffectIdentity: a second claimant joins the first and inherits its outcome. Timing decides nothing. Residual: none identified**

What this frame excludes, and it is not a small remainder. The checklist is a list of decisions an implementer would otherwise invent. It is silent on four things this chapter is nonetheless answerable for. (1) It cannot see a decision that is taken but wrong — every row above can be answered fully by a rule that is coherent and mistaken, and nothing in the (d) frame discriminates those. *(2) It cannot see a missing measurement. Six numbers this design is calibrated against are unrun and cheap: the rate of admitted work that is genuinely unfamiliar; the deterministic-predicate fraction (R-X25); the account entitlement behind the concurrency pin (Q-022); and — added 2026-09-14, and it is the one the consolidation called this design's central cost — the founder acceptance load: the count of acts per operating week whose reached class set includes the economic/contractual class and which therefore need his approval, and the minutes they consume. Instrument:* the AdmissionRecords C02 already writes carry the reached class set and the AcceptanceIntervals of §5 carry who wrote the terminal edge, so this is a query over records the company already holds rather than a study. Baseline one month of normal operation; unit approvals and minutes per operating week; repetition monthly; stopping rule two consecutive months within the declared batch minutes; owner C02, reported on the participation cycle. And fifth — added 2026-09-14 (F6A-12) — the holder-review load: the holder-hours per review period actually consumed, against the placeholder priced in §12. Instrument: the StandingHolder and acceptance-owner records themselves carry the review dates, so this too is a query over records the company holds. Baseline the first full review period of ordinary operation; unit holder-hours per period, reported with its record-count denominator and never without it; repetition every review period; stopping rule two consecutive periods within the declared batch minutes, and one period above it reopens §12's placeholders; owner C02 for the count, founder for the placeholders it is measured against. And sixth — added 2026-09-14 (F6B-08) — the human-anchor error rate (X19): the expected error rate of the human acceptance step that (4) below names as the instrument reading the founder. Instrument: [04-human-operation.md](04-human-operation.md) supplies most of a protocol already — unaided recognition, intervention quality, false-positive assessments, owner time and reported burden measured separately; delayed transfer tested after a predeclared interval; consented longitudinal comparison required before any preservation claim. What it does not supply is a stopping rule and an owner, and the owner is itself founder packet MD-04 / Q-019, whose uncertainty field records that the measuring test is blocked behind that decision — so the measurement is circularly blocked, and saying so is the point of listing it. Baseline the first full participation cycle after MD-04 is answered; unit disagreements per hundred human acceptance decisions, reported with the count of decisions and never as a bare rate; repetition every participation cycle; stopping rule two consecutive cycles whose rate sits inside the interval declared with the baseline, and any cycle outside it reopens the instrument rather than the subject; owner the acceptance owner named by MD-04, and not the founder, who is the subject. Interim reporting rule while MD-04 / Q-019 is open, and it is SPECIFICATION, not a placeholder: every figure anchored on the human acceptance step is **reported with its anchor's error rate stated as unknown with a reason**, in the MeasuredQuantity shape §7 already requires — {knowledge: unknown, reason, held_maximum} — so that an unmeasured anchor cannot be reported as a measured one, and no downstream number inherits a confidence the anchor has not earned. This list named three and omitted the fourth until 2026-09-14 (F6B-05), while §2's own failure condition turns on it; the fifth (F6A-12) and sixth (F6B-08) were added the same day. The sixth is the one the chapter had already named in (4) below, routed into a packet's uncertainty field, and left off this list. A design calibrated against a rate nobody knows passes this checklist unchanged. (3) It cannot see a structure justified by an unexecutable fixture — §12's reserved-lane holder is exactly that, and it is visible here only because the fixture table above says so. (4) It cannot see an error the whole round shares. Every judgement behind this amendment was made by agents of one model family with procedural independence only; independence of influence is claimed and measured, and independence of error is disclaimed. The founder is the only error source in this company uncorrelated with that family, and [04-human-operation.md](04-human-operation.md)'s competence mechanism — inherited here by name — is the instrument that reads him, with an unmeasured error rate of its own.

And the disposition this section is permitted to record. Per the F2 acceptance protocol §8, this amendment is a scoped planning disposition: specified behaviour checked offline against the frozen protocol, six founder packets open, subsuming nine (d)-class consolidation findings (MD-01, MD-02, MD-03, MD-04, MD-07, MD-08 — the mapping is in this chapter's header; MD-02 is narrowed and not closed by the founder's answer of 2026-09-14, Q-017 — AC-M4-02 closes with it, AC-M3-02's counting half and AC-M4-01's sampling limb survive it, and §12 states what each still needs; amended 2026-09-14 (F6Z-01): this read "subsuming ten (d)-class consolidation findings", the pre-decision count, inside the one sentence §8 governs and a downstream reader quotes), two residuals with named owners, and the six fixed boundaries preserved and none reopened. It does not state that the system works, that the design is validated, that the architecture is proven, or that implementation may begin.

sections.heading: Knowledge, context, evidence and evaluation
sections.html:
Knowledge, context, evidence and evaluation

SPECIFICATION. Contract: KNOWLEDGE-1.0.1 — patch, recording the F2 join only · architecture: S1.1 · authoring base: cb1eac4, with kernel proof amendment e9201fa incorporated · 2026-09-12; patched at ca80355, 2026-09-13 for the F2 selection record §12.2. Four additions, in §2, §4, §5 and §6–§7; no existing evaluation contract, pool rule or independence rule is changed. Status: Phase F specification, unimplemented and awaiting independent review. This owns S04's 107 questions. The machine contract supplies per-question answers, typed relationships, command guards, decisions, planned modules and unexecuted tests. It does not claim current model accuracy, reliable retrieval, preserved human competence or an empirical architecture winner.

Statement kinds (directive §6). Every substantive statement in this chapter carries one of: SPECIFICATION — our normative design, true by our decision and falsifiable only by our own tests; SOURCE CLAIM — attributed to a dated observation already registered in this package; INFERENCE — our reading of a source claim or of another contract in this package; DESIGN PROPOSAL — a construction offered for review, not yet decided; IMPLEMENTATION DISCOVERY — a fact learned by building, not decided in advance; UNKNOWN — a value or behavior this package does not establish, which constrains the dependent effect and never defaults to the permissive branch; DEFERRED — a question deliberately left open, with what would reopen it. A paragraph's opening label governs the whole paragraph unless a later clause carries its own; unlabelled prose inside a table cell inherits its row's kind. Nothing here is a runtime result.

SPECIFICATION. The kernel, authority/recovery, company catalog, human operation, and work/skills control identity, purpose, authority, acceptance and actual performance. SOURCE CLAIM. L05 separates retention, retrieval, correct use and temporal validity. L06 separates output, process, account and business outcomes and records evaluator fallibility. These are bounded source findings and design precedents, not experiments repeated here. G and its EAS-R1 comparisons remain frozen.

sections.heading: 1. Canonical knowledge and distinct memory
sections.html:
1. Canonical knowledge and distinct memory

SPECIFICATION. Use canonical IntentVersion, Observation, Claim, ReasonRecord, DecisionRecord, ArtifactVersion, EvidenceBaseVersion, EvidenceJudgment, ValidityEpoch and Continuation. The record bindings in the machine contract add fields/views or exact linking records; they do not create another truth, approval or completion authority. Every query and mutation carries company/principal, authenticated scope, purpose and current restrictions. Canonical content and prior meanings are versioned; derived indexes and summaries can be rebuilt. A signature proves attribution/integrity under its trust root, not factual truth or complete capture.

Every row below is SPECIFICATION; a cell states its own kind where it differs.

Memory jobSelected representation and write responsibility
Working memoryCurrent WorkOrder plus loader ContextManifest and bounded temporary scratch artifacts. C03 proposes scratch; it cannot promote scratch to company knowledge. Expiry follows work/retention policy.
Episodic historyAttributed attempts, messages, observations, decisions and artifact versions. Protected capture records failures and gaps; a narrative summary links these records rather than replacing them.
Semantic knowledgeCompany KnowledgeEntry links scoped canonical claims, supporting/opposing sources, valid/system times and current applicability. The knowledge steward proposes; competent C06 judgment determines accepted scope.
Procedural memoryExact WorkflowDefinition, InstructionBundle and SkillVersion with tests, provenance, license, version and owner. Repetition does not turn an unreviewed habit into a procedure.
Intent and person preferencesAuthenticated endorsed statements, explicit corrections, relevant taste examples and consented ParticipationPlan. Preserve original scope/effective time; do not infer personality, health, general intelligence or unrelated habits.
Search/context projectionsAuthorized lexical chunks, cached retrieval results and summaries with complete known derivation, omissions and expiry. C05 owns current-use eligibility; indexes are never authority.

SPECIFICATION. SourceRecord identifies the actual publisher/issuer or captured origin, source type, publication/observation/received times, incentives or known conflicts, retrieval/capture route, version, scope, completeness limits and verification owner. Unknown authorship or date stays unknown. An official or interested source may supply useful evidence within its scope; it does not become independent merely because it is primary. KnowledgeQuestion records what is unknown, why it matters, affected decisions, search already attempted, resolution predicate, custodian, latest check and stopping rule. “Not found,” “not searched,” “inaccessible,” “withheld by policy” and “insufficient evidence” are distinct dispositions.

SPECIFICATION. KnowledgeEntry does not duplicate the company catalog's identity. This contract extends its source/claim/current-validity relationships and maintenance procedure. Lessons use the existing LearningProposal: anecdote, supported pattern and causal claim have different evidence requirements. Before retaining a lesson, state scope, rival explanation and falsifier. Rejected approaches remain searchable with their context and known limits; one failure cannot become a universal prohibition. A newcomer loads an accepted purpose/role packet and the current relevant procedures, then follows exact originals for unfamiliar or contested duties.

sections.heading: 2. Context assembly and information loss
sections.html:
2. Context assembly and information loss

SPECIFICATION. C05 implements a deterministic loader around existing context.capture and context.publish. The request names exact WorkOrder, purpose, destination contracts, requested sources and optional prior manifest; the server discovers and records actual delivered inputs. The caller's claimed read list is not trusted. The manifest includes source/capture/artifact versions, permission/purpose/validity epochs, transformations, selection reasons, byte/token allocations, actual source spans, omissions and complete known native ancestry. Model-provider traffic is itself disclosure, including tool stdout, error messages, fixtures and resumed history.

SPECIFICATION. Mandatory context consists of the exact task purpose, outcome/acceptance criteria, applicable exclusions and procedure, current scoped authority references, known material contradictions, partial outputs, unresolved effects/duties and the next action. Optional background is added only when it can change the task. The loader reserves room for results and control messages using the admitted runtime's supported limits. With opaque token accounting it enforces conservative documented input-byte/launch limits and reports unknown internal usage; it cannot claim exact subcall capacity. Nothing quietly truncates a required promise, warning or permission boundary.

SPECIFICATION. At capacity, remove irrelevant/redundant background first, then use attributed scoped excerpts or a validated summary. Exact consequential amounts, identities, deadlines, exclusions and material unresolved facts remain references with accessible original spans. If necessary material still cannot fit or be used reliably, split the work into bounded steps, load a smaller relevant scope or select another qualified runtime. That affects admission; it does not authorize broader disclosure or silently drop conditions. Longer accepted context is not proof of utilization, as L05's historical studies illustrate (SOURCE CLAIM).

SPECIFICATION — added by the F2 join (R-X13). Three required manifest fields, all per item rather than per record. The manifest carries, for each delivered item, its **trust_level; it carries dropped_constraints[]* — which typed constraints were dropped, which is the operative reading of "what was omitted" for a boundary crossing; and it carries *assembled_for_class, the reached class set the manifest was assembled for**, so that a manifest built for a low-class action cannot be silently reused for a higher-class one. Per-item rather than per-record is the load-bearing part and is what directive §8.12 names: a record-level trust label averages away the one untrusted item in an otherwise trusted set. Boundary metadata is the class of information that dies in transfer — rules, exclusions, deadlines and promises survive a compressed transfer at roughly 0.57 against 0.97 for ordinary facts — which is why it is typed and enumerated rather than summarised ([05-work-agents-skills.md](05-work-agents-skills.md) §5).

SPECIFICATION. ContextTransformation records input/output refs, algorithm/model/prompt/version, spans included/excluded, intended preservation contract and known loss. A summary carries SummaryLoss entries for omitted alternatives, qualifiers, temporal relations, source uncertainty and unsupported reconstruction. Critical preservation checks use deterministic exact-field comparison plus an independent semantic challenge where wording matters. Compression passes only for its declared use; a customer-quote summary cannot replace the original in a taste or disputed-promise decision.

SPECIFICATION. Native sessions bind exact AgentInstance/WorkOrder and previous manifest lineage. Resume can reuse a session only when every possible retained input is allowed for current recipients and purpose, current restrictions hold and the profile exposes a sufficient ancestry account. Narrowing today's tools cannot remove yesterday's data. Otherwise close the opaque route and create fresh context from the portable Continuation; record lost uncaptured influence. Captured original results retain their producer identity, while live regeneration becomes another attempt charged to the same episode.

SPECIFICATION. Context outputs follow the kernel's serialization against current invalidation/deletion epochs. Source invalidation while a worker runs restricts late derivatives and dependent effects. Local snapshots can support bounded historical inspection only under current access; they cannot claim current validity. A missing source can leave a defensible limited account with an explicit reconstruction gap, but never a fabricated quotation or complete causal explanation.

sections.heading: 3. Retrieval, ranking, freshness and contradiction
sections.html:
3. Retrieval, ranking, freshness and contradiction

SOURCE CLAIM. The new PostgreSQL lexical-primitive source claims below inherit the explicit metadata and maintenance rules in the shared substrate claim register; UNKNOWN: their author-reported checks are not independent runtime evidence.

SPECIFICATION. Select a permission-filtered lexical baseline: exact-ID/field queries over admitted control metadata first, PostgreSQL full-text indexing for explicitly admitted nonpersonal/nonconfidential material, and bounded in-memory lexical scanning for protected text. Public availability alone does not establish eligibility for a persistent plaintext index. SOURCE CLAIM. PostgreSQL 18 documents tsvector, query parsing and lexical/proximity ranking; its documentation explicitly leaves application relevance to the application. GIN supplies an indexed text-search path. INFERENCE. These primitives support the implementation choice, not our authorization, recall or usefulness claims. Text-search controls, index types (checked 2026-09-12).

SPECIFICATION. The initial indexer preserves an authorized original-integrity reference, record revision, byte/span boundaries, language/parser configuration and source permissions; chunks follow semantic paragraph/section boundaries with exact links to surrounding context. Protected values and low-entropy plaintext digests are not copied into an unprotected metadata index. Original text remains independently addressable. Exact identifiers, dates, account facts and active obligations use typed queries; phrase search handles wording-sensitive retrieval. Language configuration is explicit, with a simple lexical fallback and visible unsupported-language limits. There is no required vector service or knowledge graph. Add a representation only after a matched retrieval/use/cost comparison demonstrates a needed benefit, preserving the flat baseline.

SPECIFICATION. Retrieval proceeds in this order: authenticate and compute the allowed principal/purpose/recipient/validity set; resolve explicit IDs and mandatory task refs; search only the eligible persistent index or authorized protected-text scan scope; rank candidates; load permitted spans; then recheck current restrictions at delivery/publication. The model never receives unauthorized snippets, counts, document titles or global ranking explanations that reveal excluded parties. Incomplete index frontiers or source watermarks are surfaced. A query against all records followed by client-side filtering is prohibited.
