SPECIFICATION. Rank by exact subject/identifier match, task-applicable record class, lexical relevance and source/time applicability within that class. Include linked corrections and material contrary claims even when ordinary lexical rank is low. Freshness is a use predicate or explicit warning, not a popularity bonus; repeated retrieval never renews verification. The retrieval profile pins configuration/weights/tie-breaking, initially record ID for otherwise equal candidates. Numeric relevance is a candidate-ordering aid, not probability of truth or a universal company priority score.

DESIGN PROPOSAL. The initial budget inspects at most 20 candidate metadata records and loads at most eight source chunks per retrieval step, with bytes and elapsed time charged to the WorkOrder. Mandatory exact references are resolved separately and still consume context capacity. UNKNOWN: These are bounded starting policies to test, not measured recall limits. Exhaustion records the query, eligible scope, examined candidates, selected refs, omitted candidates and unresolved question; a further search requires a named expected information gain within the same causal allowance. The query may widen legitimately, but cannot repeatedly relabel the same search as new work.

SPECIFICATION. Current-product, market, external-rule or uncertain niche facts require appropriate fresh source work when relevant; stable admitted arithmetic and exact existing records do not need web search. External search uses an authorized query/destination and the integration disclosure contract. Private context cannot supply arbitrary search terms through a “read-only” tool. Retrieval text stays attributed source content, separate from authenticated instruction. Citation checking resolves the exact source and tests claim support; a plausible URL or another model repeating a claim does not suffice.

SPECIFICATION. Contradictions first compare entity, time, conditions, units, source authority and interpretation. Different scopes may both be valid; an authenticated correction can supersede a designated field through its legitimate update route. Otherwise retain a ContradictionSet and scoped competing claims. A competent assessor records settlement, qualification or continued uncertainty with reasons. New contradictory evidence or missed validity review invalidates dependent current judgments where required; it does not declare the historical source false. Protected due service proceeds on unaffected valid facts while the relevant inference waits or narrows.

sections.heading: 4. Maintenance, corrections and deliberate forgetting
sections.html:
4. Maintenance, corrections and deliberate forgetting

SPECIFICATION. Storage follows sensitivity and deletion scope, never field size. All unrestricted human/model/source text is protected by default, including titles, reasons, queries, scope descriptions and errors. Numeric, enum and relationship values can also disclose salary, health, identity or confidential business information. Each field and derived combination needs a versioned C05 storage classification, C07 retention/duty determination where required, purpose and descendant-copy inventory. A closed type or opaque ID is not proof of harmlessness. Only a field-specific admitted control-metadata allowlist may remain plaintext; unclassified fields use the protected path. An automated classifier cannot grant an exception.

SPECIFICATION. Domain schemas describe the authorized decoded payload. Use the kernel's existing encrypted durable-blob option for sensitive canonical record bytes, including short values: validate inside the trusted current-access process, encrypt under the applicable deletion/retention scope before persistent serialization, and put the exact encrypted-blob reference and ciphertext digest in GroupBody. Record postimages, JSONB projections, event payloads, statement/error logs, tracing, WAL, indexes and backups must not receive a second plaintext copy. A plaintext digest of a guessable value is itself protected; integrity references outside the scope cover ciphertext. This is a storage binding of the same canonical record, not another authority record or a reason to accept unvalidated ciphertext. Atomic reference/durability and key recovery remain the kernel/C08 contracts.

SPECIFICATION. Some kernel joins and proof metadata necessarily expose stable identifiers, relationships, counts or timing. Their admitted allowlist must state which information persists, its exact physical copies and retention/deletion scope. If any necessary plaintext projection contains personal/confidential information, its WAL, replicas, indexes and backups remain covered descendants. Restrict access immediately, record the residual, and keep the corresponding deletion obligation incomplete until demonstrated purge or authorized expiry of every required copy. Crypto-erasure of a content key cannot claim to erase surviving plaintext linkage. If the requested operation's deletion commitment cannot tolerate that retention, do not admit the operation; resolve the actual duty/retention conflict without inventing sector law.

SPECIFICATION. Persistent PostgreSQL lexical terms/snippets are permitted only for the admitted nonprotected class. C05 decrypts protected material only after current principal/purpose/recipient filtering and performs bounded lexical scanning or an ephemeral in-memory index. No plaintext protected query cache, term index, temporary database table or disk spill is allowed. Exact permitted metadata narrows the corpus first. Scan byte/time/memory bounds and unexamined sources are explicit; reaching them produces an incomplete search or a smaller next query, not an assertion that no relevant source exists. UNKNOWN: The profile's measured recall/use and operator cost determine whether this baseline is viable for the actual corpus.

SPECIFICATION. Runtime admission must account for process memory, crash dumps, swap, diagnostic output, worker stdout, export and live key holders. Unknown persistent-copy behavior disqualifies that runtime for protected material. Structural logs contain approved codes and minimum scoped identifiers; sensitive diagnostic detail uses the encrypted capture path. Deletion fences further loads and publication, retires cached/ephemeral representations and closes or reauthorizes affected processes under C08. Claims of physical erasure or key destruction require actual evidence; merely requesting shutdown or restarting an application does not establish it. Offline exports and resumed native contexts retain their existing continuing deletion obligations.

SPECIFICATION. The knowledge custodian owns bounded semantic maintenance: expiring prerequisites, source/schema changes, failed searches, newly discovered classes, unsupported repetition and correction propagation. Refresh by consequence, volatility and dependency use, not by re-reading all history on a fixed timer. A material active prerequisite receives a review deadline and actual responsible provider; overdue unverified evidence loses current eligibility for its dependent use. Low-stakes historical material can remain attributed and qualified. Time passing alone cannot renew a claim.

SPECIFICATION. Forgetting has distinct operations: exclude from routine retrieval, supersede current meaning, archive, redact, or erase according to the actual retention/determination policy. ForgetRequest links the legitimate instruction or DeletionScope, exact sources/purpose, known derivative closure, cutoff, owner and verification. C05/ C08 enforce the continuing restriction epoch and isolated rejoin rules; the domain request cannot weaken them. Late summaries, exports, offline copies and restored indexes remain within the continuing scope. Unknown provider-held copies are recorded and follow the actual available rights/retention route; the software cannot certify erasure it cannot observe.

SPECIFICATION. Promotion into durable knowledge requires a stated reusable need, source rights, scope, expiry/review and owner. Scratch remains scratch unless accepted. Memory size is controlled by compact indexes, purposeful retention, retired duplicate procedures and scoped views; deletion is not a hidden performance optimization that removes accountability. Historical evidence needed for a lawful duty and a current deletion demand requires an actual competent determination, narrow restriction and recorded residual obligation. No universal retention duration is inferred here.

SPECIFICATION. Corrections preserve original words and effective time, classify changed intent versus corrected fact, and identify dependent procedures, claims, summaries and current work. An understanding check uses a new bounded case or a direct critical-field check; storing the correction alone is insufficient. Test that a later worker uses the corrected value, rejects an obsolete permissive snapshot and still reconstructs the older decision's limited context. A newcomer or affected person can open a knowledge challenge without inheriting authority to suspend the company or reopen settled personal values.

SPECIFICATION — added by the F2 join (R-G06). A supersession walks the transitive closure. Superseding an entry **arms a standing interest over the transitive closure of derived entries naming the superseded value** ([05-work-agents-skills.md](05-work-agents-skills.md) §7), and **each reopened AcceptanceState in that closure is re-decided or flagged — never left standing on a value that no longer holds. The closure is walked, not sampled, and the traversal frontier rule of §5 applies to it: a delayed background traversal cannot be the sole admission guard. A supersession with an empty closure reopens nothing, and that case must not be reported as work. UNKNOWN:* the size* of a typical closure is unmeasured, and the sizing measurement is owed (AS-M3-03, carried in the selection record §5.2 as a named residual with an owner). A closure large enough to exceed a review window would change the cost of every correction, and nothing here establishes that it does not.

sections.heading: 5. Protected evidence and account reconstruction
sections.html:
5. Protected evidence and account reconstruction

SPECIFICATION. RawCapture preserves the declared observed bytes/media/digest, source/endpoint/account identity, capture interval, sequence, omissions and access/retention. Transport credentials are excluded through structural capture rules and referenced by generation; that exclusion is itself recorded. Never describe a redacted capture as every original wire byte. The integration IntegrationObservation points to capture, exact adapter/connection/invocation, parsed Observation refs, native IDs/cursors, transport result and gaps. Native status and parser output remain attributed observations until independent reconciliation supports the relevant outcome.

SPECIFICATION. The protected evidence closure covers capture adapter, transport/parser/schema, normalization, source/semantic mappings, sample selection, test fixture, metric definition, denominator, evaluator code/model/prompt, labels and acceptance rule. EvidenceBaseVersion pins these transitive refs and common trust roots. C06's capture and selection paths are outside the evaluated producer's write authority. A producer cannot choose all adverse samples, delete failed attempts, alter expected answers or activate its new evaluator. Merely using a second model or service account does not establish independence when its evidence and incentives share roots.

SPECIFICATION — added by the F2 join (R-X14). The calibration writer is excluded from every producing path. InstrumentCalibration has identity (checker_id, rubric_version, run_date) and lifecycle scheduled → run → superseded. Its sole writer is C06 or a dedicated instrument custodian excluded from every producing path, and a calibration write is a C5 protected change. It stores the planted-defect result and the paired clean-case refusal rate from the same session. Every instrument reading carries its own paired clean case and a deterministic reproduction path, so that founder acceptance of a reading is the check of a computation rather than the acceptance of a judgement — a one-instrument chain accepted by one person with a measured human error rate and no second reading is the shape this rule exists to avoid. SOURCE CLAIM — the rate, stated rather than invoked by adjective (F6B-11): any two evaluators of one system by one method agree on 5–65% of the problems found, and on which problems are severe they agree 28% (cognitive walkthrough) and 20% (thinking-aloud) — Hertzum and Jacobsen 2003, IJHCI 15(1) 183–204, primary PDF read (R7 F15). Read with §7's union rule: a panel may aggregate findings by union and may not aggregate verdicts by vote or by mean. The pool-custody separation of the paragraph above is kept as a role with a named writer and a protected-change class, and deliberately not as a chartered standing desk ([05-work-agents-skills.md](05-work-agents-skills.md) §12).

SPECIFICATION. Changed/corrupted dependencies trigger C05 invalidation and mark affected judgments stale/contested before their next consequential use. The graph stores reverse dependencies and a verified complete traversal/index frontier; a delayed background traversal cannot be the sole admission guard. Missing closure stops the dependent acceptance, while raw unaffected evidence and ordinary permitted work remain available. Revalidation uses current competent ownership and new independent evidence, not the old confident summary. Tests corrupt an extractor, denominator, label set and shared parser while keeping the producer artifact unchanged.

SPECIFICATION. AccountReconstruction is a derived, permission-filtered view of an explicit prior witnessed Position and source coverage. Its current view binds canonical BusinessAccount fields, including inline source watermarks and omissions. It reconstructs original intent/decision, admitted work, attempts, actual observations, partial outputs, independent judgments, effects, costs and surviving duties. Captured sequence does not establish complete causation. ReasonRecord keeps endorsed reason, executor report, causal hypothesis and unknown influence distinct; hidden model reasoning is neither demanded nor claimed available.

SPECIFICATION. Separate reproducibility promises: record reconstruction from surviving artifacts; captured-response replay with external effects simulated; live rerun under new current grants; distribution replication across controlled stochastic trials. A replay never resends a past payment/contact or overrides current deletion restrictions. Pin controllable model/runtime/configuration/tool/skill/context/dataset/evaluator versions, input state, allocation, attempts and actual observations. Unknown provider internals and unavailable versions remain limits. A reproducible false measurement is still false.

SPECIFICATION. Accounts include refused, abandoned, timed-out, unobserved and failed work, plus known missing inputs/intervals. Independent ingress/work/resource counts challenge the export denominator. A gap is not inactivity. Human-facing summaries preserve critical differences and expose originals within access limits. Evaluate reconstruction using an investigator unfamiliar with the run, including deleted content and planted unobserved influences; success is a correct bounded account with honest limits, not a fluent full story.

sections.heading: 6. Evaluation contracts at every level
sections.html:
6. Evaluation contracts at every level

SPECIFICATION. EvaluationPlan is registered before seeing treatment results: subject/version, requirement/claim, unit/population, intended use, outcome and process criteria, forbidden outcomes, comparison, selection/assignment, resources, evaluator/labels, independence roots, trial/reset rules, stopping/analysis and reopening. EvaluationRun records every selected unit and attempt, including noncompletion, raw observations, cost/latency and protocol deviations. Review links a competent reviewer's attributable findings and limitations. Canonical EvidenceJudgment owns accepted scope; EvaluationRun or Review has no independent release authority. Its proposed state is unfinished assessment; inconclusive is a completed assessment that cannot establish its subject predicate; rejected is an adverse judgment; contested means disputed evidence, not automatic rejection. Later reassessment creates a witnessed revision with historical reasons retained. Acceptance of an uncertainty report establishes only that exact report criterion. Product, launch, capacity and effect gates require their exact current accepted subject/version/predicate bindings and complete evidence closure.

Every row below is SPECIFICATION; a cell states its own kind where it differs.

SubjectConcrete evaluation and required separation
Model/runtimeSame scoped tasks/inputs/resources with exact profile; correctness/abstention, useful completion, disclosure and variation. A leaderboard cannot qualify company authority.
Prompt/instructionStable cases plus instruction conflicts and injected source text; test outcomes and actual adherence separately, including a sham wording change.
Tool/adapterValid, malformed, forbidden and ambiguous effects; independently observe destination state, parameters, retries, descendants and disclosure. Syntax success is insufficient.
SkillApplicability selection, correct use, stale examples, source/license obligations, composition and selection overhead. Compare a direct procedure with the same outcome criteria.
Agent instance/templateBounded useful result, honest unsupported facts, depth/allowance, tool/context restrictions and cessation; heartbeat and output volume are not progress.
Handoff/messageA new worker performs unfamiliar next work using exact constraints, partials and unknowns; test lost/duplicate acknowledgment and a harmful omitted qualifier.
Step/run/workflowEnd-to-end result and process, partial failure, replay/migration, resource limits and real compensation; local accepted subtasks cannot hide a failed whole.
ArtifactRequirements, actual usability/fit, errors, rights and source support, using rendered/functional evidence where relevant. Taste uses the legitimate human criterion.
DecisionQuality against available evidence, alternatives, mandate and expressed values at decision time; judge separately from lucky or delayed outcomes.
Project/ventureActual beneficiary use, accepted delivery, rework, stage-specific learning, carrying and closure costs; no mandatory positive revenue for an endorsed subsidy.
Business/serviceComplete discovery-to-closure paths, customer acceptance, contribution, duty progress and shifted human burden; profitable harm and competent losses remain separate failures.
Safety/responsibilityExact invariant/duty behavior under adverse cases, plus ordinary authorized service and genuine rights progress; blanket refusal cannot pass usefulness.
Attention/competenceActual minutes, interrupts, adverse evidence exposure, delayed unfamiliar transfer/intervention and burden under the consented human protocol; attendance/confidence/agreement cannot establish competence.
Evaluator/accountKnown-defect detection, clean-case acceptance, source/denominator completeness, blind/reranked judgments, drift and investigator reconstruction. The checker itself has an independent acceptance owner.

SPECIFICATION. Standards vary with the exact consequence and claim. Deterministic invariant checks always run at their enforcement boundary. Reversible low-impact transformations may use deterministic validation and sampled outcome review under an admitted acceptance policy. Material effect prerequisites, professional determinations and protected changes require their specified competent independent evidence. The producer may supply self-checks and answer factual questions, but cannot become sole independent acceptor by changing role labels.

SPECIFICATION. Review execution records inspected evidence, actual commands/observations, findings, omissions, review duration and deciding identity. An always-pass reviewer must fail the known-defect control. Review findings are not silently overridden; an authorized owner may accept a permitted residual defect through an explicit scoped disposition, preserving dissent and expiry. Nobody can waive an unavailable lawful mandate, required professional result, core invariant or independently witnessed authority by clicking “override.” Legitimate taste disagreement can remain disagreement while the actual taste owner chooses.

sections.heading: 7. Cases, trials, independence and negative controls
sections.html:
7. Cases, trials, independence and negative controls

SPECIFICATION. Maintain four versioned pools: fixed regression cases; fresh eligible production samples; withheld challenge cases; and adversarial sequences. Fixed pool revisions create a new baseline and preserve overlapping old cases for a bridge comparison. Production sampling selects from eligible intake before outcome is known, records denominator/exclusions and retains abandoned/unobservable units. Cases requiring private data obey the same purpose/recipient rules; synthetic cases remain labeled and cannot establish actual customers, professional availability or fulfillment.

SPECIFICATION. Each plan states whether variation is acceptable. Deterministic contracts expect exact semantic results under the declared inputs; creative output can vary while meeting use/taste constraints; consequence bytes and grants never vary after authorization. Initial stochastic diagnostics use five attributable trials per selected case when the authorized budget permits, with reset/seed recorded where actually supported. UNKNOWN: This is a defect-discovery default, not a reliability certificate. If fewer run, report the shortfall. Qualification or improvement claims predeclare a sample plan matched to effect size/uncertainty and actual task strata; a budget too small for the claim leaves it unresolved.

SPECIFICATION. Retain all trials, not best-of-many. Distinguish any-success, all-success, per-attempt, per-request and per-fulfilled-duty rates. Pair comparable candidate/baseline cases and randomize order where feasible; preserve task and period clusters. Report uncertainty per endpoint and stratum. Exact binomial inference is used only when its independence assumptions are justified; correlated sessions, customers or outages require a cluster-aware declared method or descriptive limits. A moving baseline requires bridged common cases and explicit changed populations, not a clean month-to-month percentage without qualification.

SPECIFICATION. Negative controls include a sham change expected not to improve the endpoint, an unaffected outcome, and a negative claim with no supporting evidence. Positive detection controls inject a known defect, fake citation, skipped authorization, omitted failed attempt, changed denominator, poisoned skill or dropped promise. Clean valid controls detect indiscriminate rejection. Counterbalance presentation order and hide irrelevant producer identity from comparative judges when feasible. Where process/rights must be checked, supply that evidence in a separate phase rather than blindly concealing a required fact.

SPECIFICATION. Independent perspective means different relevant evidence, method, measurement or competent human grounding under separate protected authority. First prefer the cheapest observation that can discriminate: actual destination state, a deterministic counterexample, original customer evidence or a scoped professional assessment. A different model family can add a tested viewpoint but is not a proof of independent error. Record shared training/provider, parser, source, rubric, labels, capture owner and incentives where known; unknown roots remain unknown. Measure joint false acceptance on controlled defects before treating panel agreement as extra assurance.

SPECIFICATION. On disagreement, preserve each finding, identify whether scope/value, factual evidence, method or uncertainty differs, and obtain the cheapest discriminating test or legitimate decision. Difficult taste or forecast questions may remain unresolved without implying reviewer failure. The producer cannot select only agreeable judges. A checker drifting toward agreement is challenged with independently held defects, swapped identities/order, original-source review and false-positive controls; invalidated evaluator dependencies withdraw affected acceptance until reassessed.

SPECIFICATION — added by the F2 join. Who authors the acceptance criteria, and that the producing path may not amend them (R-D11, closing AS-X-01). The capability owner authors the acceptance criteria at procedure admission. They are versioned and frozen before the producing step starts. The producing path may neither author nor amend them, and an amendment between admission and submission is refused by a guard, naming the failed predicate. This closes a fourth unblinded channel into the checker. The three channels this package already closes are the producer's rationale, the producer's preferred conclusion and the shared record; the fourth is the criteria themselves, and no research lane in the F2 round named it. Fixture F-4 gains a fourth arm in which the criteria are authored by the producing path, reported beside the existing three. Owner: C06. Until that arm runs, the F2 disposition of this dimension is recorded honestly as sufficient on the three tested channels and unestablished on the fourth, which is narrower than either review said on its own (the selection record §6.3).

SPECIFICATION — a fifth F-4 arm: the same checker run twice over the same context (F6B-04, 2026-09-14). Fixture F-4 gains a fifth arm in which one checker is run twice over the same context, its two verdicts combined exactly as a two-channel panel's are, reported beside the other four rather than in a separate study. It is a negative control in this section's own sense — the arm expected not to improve the endpoint — and it is what excludes “more compute” as the explanation of any separation the independent arms show: a candidate that reports an improvement without this control has not excluded that explanation, and a second prompt, a second name or a second copy of the same context is not independence. Endpoint and unit: joint false acceptance on controlled injected defects, as a rate per controlled defect case, reported with its paired clean-case refusal rate — §6's rule binds here too, both numbers or neither. Floor for “a measurable difference”: an arm counts as different from single review only at ≥10 percentage points on that rate and with the 95% interval excluding zero under the cluster-aware method this section already requires; below the floor the arms are reported as not separated, not as equal. Repetition count: five attributable trials per selected case, the stochastic-diagnostic default above. Stopping rule: the arm stops at 60 controlled defect cases, or when the interval excludes the floor in either direction, whichever comes first; a run that stops for budget reports the shortfall and resolves **unresolved, never pass. DESIGN PROPOSAL placeholders: the 10 points, the 60 cases and the five trials are proposed values, not measurements, and their owner is C06 — the owner of the fourth arm — at the first F-4 execution, whenever a runtime exists. Until this arm runs, agreement between the independent arms is reported and not credited as extra assurance**, which is this section's pre-existing joint-false-acceptance rule now carrying the comparator it lacked.

SPECIFICATION — a check reads only fields the producer could not author, and its tie-break inverts (R-X20). A check interest's precondition reads only fields the producer could not author ([05-work-agents-skills.md](05-work-agents-skills.md) §7). And where several checks are eligible, the tie-break for check interests is strongest sufficient, not narrowest sufficient: for a check, "narrowest sufficient" selects the weakest check, which inverts the purpose of having one. This is the single place in this package where the narrowest-sufficient default is reversed, and the reversal is stated rather than left to be inferred.

**SPECIFICATION — a checker with no clean-case rate resolves unresolved, never pass. A verdict from an instrument whose refusal rate on clean cases is unrecorded is not a passing verdict and is not a failing one**; it is unresolved, and it may not satisfy an acceptance gate. This is the same terminal-value rule the package already applies to unsupported boundary inputs, applied to the instrument itself: a resolver never passes what it could not check. Paired with §7's controls, it means both the detection rate and the clean-case refusal rate are reported, or neither is — and a founder return carries both ([04-human-operation.md](04-human-operation.md)).

sections.heading: 8. Drift, reopening, economics and comparators
sections.html:
8. Drift, reopening, economics and comparators

SPECIFICATION. Reopen on material contrary outcome, changed source/model/prompt/skill/tool/schema, missed expiry, new applicable duty, failed original-source reconstruction, a naive credible challenge, or an alternative that could materially improve the purpose. C05 creates a current validity consequence; C02 assigns bounded investigation; C01/C07 decide only within their actual domains. A newcomer can obtain a reasoned disposition under S1's protected discovery and ordinary challenge rules. This does not introduce C2's compulsory independent inquiry jurisdiction.

SPECIFICATION. At review, distinguish still supported, qualified, obsolete, contradicted and unmeasured. Reaffirming a settled choice requires current reasoning about its premises, not its age or popularity. Values/exclusions deliberately settled by their owner retain the actual amendment route; new factual contradiction remains reportable without silently replacing those ends. Repeated equivalent challenges share investigation work and the same causal allowance while preserving each person's rights/deadlines. Every inquiry has a next discriminator and stopping rule, preventing both calcification and perpetual reconsideration.

SPECIFICATION. Monitor gradual drift on fixed and fresh cases: acceptance error by stratum, omitted constraints, false refusal, selection cost, missing-source rate, correction/forgetting reuse, review minutes and customer outcomes. A metric-owner alert threshold is registered with a baseline and actual response authority before automated intervention. A sudden known invariant breach invalidates the affected scope immediately under policy; a small uncertain trend triggers bounded discrimination, not broad self-directed suspension. Counterfactual evaluator checks can reveal an instrument that stopped responding even while its average score looks stable.

SPECIFICATION. Retain S0 with native tools, competent manual release and comparable external obligations, resources, recovery and owner allowance. Preserve G's four EAS-R1 tests separately: each design's own rights; business effectiveness at matched external obligations/resources/information/service; case versus shared-hypothesis representation with identical C2 rights; and fully adaptive A/S1 with protected discovery plus scheduled cross-domain review but no compulsory independent inquiry jurisdiction. Do not force equal internal deadlines that erase the treatment or score lawful S1 deferral as violation of C2's rule. No ontology, blackboard or agent count receives credit by existing.

SPECIFICATION. Evaluation itself consumes capture, labeling, source investigation, reviewer/professional time, owner attention, compute, maintenance and closure resources. Register the expected information value and budget before running it, then report actual cost and foregone useful work. Protected checks and due service cannot be silently starved to improve scores. If equivalent business outcomes and responsibility can be achieved with less total burden using simpler production, retrieval or review, narrow/remove the extra mechanism through the normal protected change route. Neither an elegant account nor safe permanent refusal rescues unaffordable or ineffective operation.

sections.heading: 9. Implementation boundaries and conformance
sections.html:
9. Implementation boundaries and conformance

DESIGN PROPOSAL. Implement lexical indexing/retrieval, source/knowledge lifecycle, manifest assembly and forgetting under system/packages/context; protected capture/dependency closure, evaluation and accounts under system/packages/evidence; shared validators under system/packages/contracts. C09 surfaces consume witnessed projections with current access. External research/provider adapters remain in the integration track. Exact optional vector/graph systems, additional judge vendors and general model-memory products are not required dependencies of this baseline.

SPECIFICATION. Conformance requires ordinary successful source use, actual useful work and the following adverse variations: same promise under different entities/times; a stale correction ranked first; a false citation repeated by two judges; deletion during late summary publication; a private term in an outward search query; hidden resumed context; a passing artifact with unauthorized process; a corrupted shared parser/denominator; an always-pass checker; a summary dropping an approval-changing exception; missing failed-run exports; and a restored index before current restrictions. Each test specifies exact expected state, evidence and allowed continuing work. Storage tests place short personal strings, a salary, a health enum and identity linkage in fields, errors and corrections; inspect GroupBody/JSONB, WAL, indexes, logs, replicas and restored backups for unintended plaintext. Then revoke the content scope, fence live holders and verify which copies remain. A remaining admitted linkage must keep deletion visibly incomplete; a permitted nonprotected search must still succeed. UNKNOWN: These are required future boundary tests, not results obtained here.

SPECIFICATION. Capacity tests grow eligible/irrelevant/hostile corpora and skill libraries while holding relevant questions fixed, measuring both retrieval and correct use, false exclusion, latency, disclosure, source upkeep and owner work. Historical benchmark results do not determine our pass thresholds. Longitudinal owner/business trials and real unavailable-professional/provider scenarios remain authorized future evaluations with actual admission. DEFERRED. Full-schema consolidation must resolve every field/view binding and executable validator; this specification does not turn the proposed module paths or unexecuted protocols into implemented coverage.

SPECIFICATION. The XSR-02 author amendment adds 56 shared verification subcases and exact per-question assertion joins for all 268 work/knowledge answers; verification_bindings identifies the stimulus and expected observation that tests each distinctive claim, including usable provider exit and bounded equivalent-issue reopening. verification_family_refs is now DERIVED from those bindings — it names exactly the planned test modules that exercise the answer. IMPLEMENTATION DISCOVERY. It read as the broad portfolio grouping until the XSR-R-01 repair, and under that reading 88 of 394 bindings cited a family their answer did not declare, so a reader following the declaration reached the wrong module. Each subcase carries its own positive_control and execution_boundary (XSR-R-02); procedure stays one shared text and declares that sharing in shared_control_groups. Recompute rather than quoting these counts: node scripts/vision-wk-bindings.mjs verify. These are unexecuted specifications, not independent closure of XSR-02 or of the XSR-R findings. Root coverage projections are rebuilt from the source by vision-wk-bindings.mjs project --write, never by hand.

2. Invocation, capture and truthful outcomes

SPECIFICATION. The caller proposes arguments; deterministic code resolves protected account, payee, recipient, amount, target resource, claim form and scope from current authoritative records. User-supplied strings and source text cannot replace these trusted parameters. The resulting exact bytes and interpretation versions enter OperationIntent. C04 reserves money, capacity, potential duties and business conflicts before disclosure or external mutation. Gate expiry applies to the controlled transport event described in 02; neither an HTTP status nor a native exit code proves fulfillment.

SPECIFICATION. RawCapture/v1 is an ArtifactVersion with protected metadata: invocation/attempt identity; direction; endpoint and native account; media type; original length and digest; captured interval; capture sequence and missing ranges; header allowlist; credential generation; encrypted blob refs; retention/access/deletion scope. Authorization headers and cookies are omitted by structural field selection before persistence, with an omission marker; business content is retained under encryption and access policy. Capture occurs before the result is offered to a model. Streaming sequence gaps, truncated output, parser failure and missing final messages remain explicit. Exact request business bytes are reconstructible from the committed envelope; no claim that redacted credential bytes were retained. Free text is protected by default; numeric/enumerated fields and relationship metadata also require field-specific sensitivity/retention classification. Canonical sensitive record bytes use the kernel encrypted durable-blob path; GroupBody/JSONB, WAL, indexes, logs and backups must not retain accidental plaintext duplicates. Persisted full-text indexes are limited to explicitly admitted nonpersonal/nonconfidential material; protected content uses permission-filtered bounded in-memory lexical scanning with no persistent terms/snippets/query cache or spill. Any necessary plaintext relational projection has explicit purge/retention accounting and keeps deletion incomplete while it survives. Parser output is a derived Observation with the raw capture and parser version as dependencies. A hostile HTML page, e-mail, tool response or test log is data, including text that impersonates a system instruction.

SPECIFICATION. Default external attempt: one request, HTTP/1.1, fresh socket, no automatic redirect/retry/pooling, 30-second all-buffer gate window, request ≤1 MiB, response ≤8 MiB, decompressed response ≤8 MiB, depth-limited parse. A profile may set a shorter window or smaller bounds. A larger supported operation must be a separately reviewed profile with explicit reservations and the same gate semantics, never an invisible library default. Read retries: at most three total attempts in the causal episode with backoff 1/4 seconds and deadline check; observed 429 Retry-After defers without exceeding the deadline. Mutations retry only on positive proven-unsent evidence or a provider-specific current idempotency contract. Unknown effects retain holds and reconciliation work; changing tool or provider is not an escape from the business identity.

DESIGN PROPOSAL. Circuit breaker opens after three transport failures in five minutes, probes once after five minutes using a harmless admitted read, and resumes only on valid response/profile. Authentication failure, schema drift, unexpected redirect/destination, charge mode change or capture corruption quarantines immediately. A refusal records the unmet authority/standing/capacity predicate; a provider error records what was attempted; a timeout after possible send is unknown. All consume their actual causal resources. One provider's reported success and another's disagreement form a contested evidence set, not last-writer-wins truth.

Not a generic unconfigured payment tool. Checkout, expiry, refund, idempotency, webhooks.
IC-BOOKS / source statements + hledger 1.52Actual authorized custodian uploads the bank's original camt.053 XML or immutable native CSV/PDF statement through authenticated intake, with account, period, opening/closing balance and source origin. Account-specific versioned mapping produces canonical integer-minor-unit transactions and a generated hledger journal; never execute user-supplied hledger include/rules/commands. hledger --strict validates a generated file; reports export CSV/JSON. Stripe balance transactions reconcile processor clearing separately from bank cash.Duplicate keys include source account, period, native transaction ID and reversal relation. Missing statement period, unmatched amounts, unknown exchange rates and opening-balance disagreement block close. Actual accountant decides applicable books/taxes/filings, signs the exact period and supplies native submission receipt. A balanced journal does not establish tax compliance, cash receipt or professional competence.A full SaaS accounting integration is unnecessary before actual jurisdiction/chart needs exist. Deterministic portable journal plus qualified human close is an actual performance route with an accepted engagement, not a summary packet. hledger manual, ISO 20022 message definitions.
IC-HUMAN / authenticated service portal + Fastmail + actual performancePerformer receives exact scope, authority, materials, fees, deadline, evidence requirements and escalation route. Acceptance binds an identified Principal, Mandate, competence evidence, conflict check, availability and fee reservation. An authenticated acknowledgement starts performance; uploaded work/native receipt and beneficiary response are independently assessed. A phone/physical act is recorded by the responsible human with source receipt/witness and uncertainty.Applies to legal/accounting/professional judgment, research interviews, negotiation, customer support and physical delivery. Due service cannot be closed by a refusal or a packet. Missing performer acceptance means no verified capacity; existing duties trigger an actually accepted alternate, renegotiation or accountable failure/grievance path. Manual provider-console actions are attributed human external acts under standing, not falsely claimed as G-controlled requests.Hiring every discipline as a permanent department is unnecessary; accepted scoped professional contracts and named continuity custodians provide real capacity. Provider/jurisdiction/fee/principal selection is operating admission data and must be completed before the relevant sale or due act.

SPECIFICATION. The Cloudflare free profile uses a stricter admitted envelope than provider maxima: ≤1,000 routine dynamic submissions/day forecast, ≤10,000 stored unimported forms, ≤100 MiB intake data, ≤1 MiB per upload request, ≤20 MiB complete static bundle, ≤10 ms CPU per dynamic request, no background paid bindings. Workers Free has a documented daily hard request quota; D1 has documented daily read/write and storage refusal. These are capacity ceilings, not a promised success rate. Maintain 50% measured ordinary headroom and no operator token permitting automatic plan upgrade. An attacker can still exhaust the free quota and deny service. The independent Fastmail address is printed on every receipt and static grievance page, and is distributed in agreements/offline packets; the recipient need not authenticate into A, know the company schema, or survive an A/Cloudflare outage to reach the custodian. Actual accessible language, screen-reader/keyboard behavior and monitored response deadlines are admission tests. Custom domain and provider subdomain are both recorded; shared DNS/provider failures are disclosed, not called independent merely because URLs differ.

SPECIFICATION. Cloudflare D1 is the provider database product, distinct from the kernel D1 local-staging durability lane. External intake receipts explicitly say external_staged and identify provider retention/coverage; they are never common Ref or witnessed acceptance. Public form envelope encryption uses an admitted standard JWE profile (ECDH-ES with P-256 and A256GCM through the maintained jose implementation, using the JWA algorithm contract), with recipient public key only at the Worker and private key in the protected company recipient boundary. Keys are partitioned by retention cohort; a shared retained cohort key means an individual old provider ciphertext is not cryptographically erased. Provider live rows, backups and exported derivatives remain in DeletionScope until actual deletion/expiry/key destruction conditions are met. Product-specific customer data has its own admitted schema/retention/restore contract and never silently inherits the form intake guarantee.

SPECIFICATION. Public applications are already released continuing programs. Their admitted profile specifies customer data, bounded actions, retention, actor authentication and provider limits; it cannot receive company payment/admin/model credentials. Product-originated payments route to provider-hosted Checkout configured from admitted offers. New product capabilities, secrets, destinations or paid bindings require protected release. Each deployed version is an AccessDescendant with stop/removal/native-status and data-export obligations; G's deployment-request cutoff does not instantly stop a program already running at Cloudflare. Pause sale, disable relevant routes, reconcile continuing sessions and notify affected people under the domain procedure.

sections.heading: 4. Communication and independent continuity
sections.html:
4. Communication and independent continuity

SPECIFICATION. Authority covers exact sender identity, principal, recipients, business purpose, allowed claim/content form, language, time window, volume and disclosure. Destination-clean context prevents some disclosure; it does not prevent an invented guarantee, price, promise or credential claim. Routine automatic replies therefore render deterministic approved content forms with typed slots resolved from current accepted facts and permitted uncertainty statements. Free text is a draft requiring accountable human review or a separately admitted constrained content procedure. The model cannot change protected slots or invent claims through a stylistic field. Meaning-changing translation and attachments receive the same gate. Contradictory evidence disables the affected claim form, not all legitimate replies.

SPECIFICATION. A useful routine example is a received support case: send its receipt number, actual monitored response window and the independent grievance address using a fixed form; later send a verified delivery link from the accepted ArtifactVersion. Neither says a human personally reviewed it. Machine involvement is disclosed whenever the interaction determination requires it and never falsely denied; representation and accountability remain with the identified company/mandate. No claim of guaranteed returns, legal compliance, professional qualification, completed payment, safety certification or customer consent is permitted without its exact current predicate. Company voice is a versioned style policy subordinate to these facts.

SPECIFICATION. Standing grants may authorize these bounded routine messages without per-message human intervention. New audience/offer, discretionary concession, binding promise, sensitive disclosure or changed claim requires the applicable consequence decision. The actual human review time is reserved and measured; exhausting it pauses new discretionary outreach before it crowds out due service. Default planning allocation is at most 20 first-contact messages/day and 100 routine replies/day per company, further constrained by consent, actual provider/account limits and owner allowance; these are design limits, not authorization to contact anyone. Complaint/suppression signals have a separately reserved intake path, and an attacker cannot silently erase a duty by labelling it spam.

SPECIFICATION. IC-HUMAN continuity admission requires a primary custodian and an accepted alternate with independent login/recovery/MFA and an understood mandate. They receive an encrypted, dated continuity export containing due duties, unresolved effects, standing, authoritative source pointers, contacts and offline instructions, but not stale grant permits. Test an actual acknowledgement and a rehearsal of a benign request before declaring the route live. A customer can complain without approval from the actor complained about. Custodian compensation, availability window, response capacity and removal/replacement are explicit resource obligations. No assumed free lawyer, accountant, proxy founder or perpetual on-call volunteer.

sections.heading: 5. Native subscription execution
sections.html:
5. Native subscription execution

SPECIFICATION. Native login-bearing N and untrusted execution X are separate machines and identities. Each job receives a fresh standalone checkout, clean home/context and manifest, cgroup, network peer and expiry. Native CLI authentication remains with the account owner; no customer obtains the login or API-equivalent resale access. Model-assisted internal research, drafting and construction use subscriptions. A customer-facing AI product needs its own permitted commercial route and economics before sale; it cannot inherit the founders' subscriptions.

ProfileIntended exact launch/interfaceAdmission and boundary
N-CLAUDE-SUPPLIED/v1Pin Claude 2.1.269 artifact and effective managed configuration. Launch argv, not a shell: claude -p --safe-mode --restricted --tools "" --disallowedTools "mcp__*" --permission-mode dontAsk --permission-prompts none --output-format json --json-schema [pinned schema] --session-id [job-bound UUID]. Supply only authorized manifest text/input.Primary simple path: native subscription auth plus no tool access; parse structured result and build/test separately in X. Safe mode suppresses normal customization/MCP but managed policy exceptions must be inventoried. --bare is forbidden because it excludes subscription OAuth. No ordinary project startup context is trusted.
N-CLAUDE-MEDIATED/v1claude -p --restricted --tools "" --strict-mcp-config --mcp-config [pinned manifest] --permission-mode dontAsk --permission-prompts none --output-format json --json-schema [schema] --session-id [UUID]; exact admitted MCP tools only.Separate profile, not assumed composable with safe mode. Before admission, test effective startup/context and exact tool set. MCP transport exposes job capabilities to a protected broker; arbitrary code executes only in X. Tool-name allowlisting alone is insufficient: pin server executable/URL, schema, certificate and identity.
N-CODEX-SUPPLIED/v1Pin Codex 0.154.0 artifact/config. codex exec --ignore-user-config --ignore-rules --strict-config --ephemeral --json --output-schema [schema] with supplied prompt; job manifest records any session/thread ID emitted. Managed allowed_permission_profiles forces the selected minimal profile with exact read roots/denies, network disabled for code tools, no legacy --sandbox or sandbox_mode.Require ChatGPT login mode, no inherited API keys, shell environment inherit=none, allow_login_shell=false; disable apps, search, browser, computer use and unadmitted MCP in effective inventory. features.shell_tool=false alone is not proof of no code/file surface. Admit only after the exact installed capability inventory and all-channel tests; until then Claude supplied-input profile is the selected native execution route.

SOURCE CLAIM. These are intended launch contracts grounded in N01, Claude CLI reference, headless operation, Codex noninteractive use and Codex permissions. Documentation/help inspection supports a feasible route; it does not establish that the flag combinations or isolation already pass. Exact parser flags are tested against the pinned binaries before admission; unknown flags or effective configuration differences stop launch. No API-key or credit fallback, automatic provider login change or upgrade download occurs during a job.

SPECIFICATION. Before launch, AuthAttestation is an Observation with actual native auth-status evidence, account/plan identity, permitted usage, expiry, installed/config digest, billing UI/API observations, API-key override absence and approved credit settings. Native status alone cannot establish remaining allowance or disabled extra billing. Claude usage/billing UI observations are supplied through an authenticated custodian; no scraping undocumented quota endpoints. Codex account/read and account/rateLimits/read may provide documented observations through app-server; use only fields actually supplied and distinguish credits from subscription limits. App-server interface, usage limits, Claude API-key precedence. Missing or stale billing evidence stops new launches; observed quota reset never renews the company causal budget.

SPECIFICATION. G enforces N's entire permitted job network window through its job-specific WireGuard peer and the protected time gate, including model, login refresh, telemetry, retry and any non-shell traffic. N cloud/host egress is only the tunnel endpoint; no alternative IPv6, DNS proxy, local service or inherited connection. Provider endpoint changes require profile review; allowed model destinations do not authorize disclosure of arbitrary company content. The ephemeral Codex profile does not promise resumable on-disk sessions: continue from an authorized company Continuation in a fresh invocation. An independently admitted persistent native profile may use claude --resume [exact session ID] or codex exec resume [exact session ID]; --last and ambient session selection are forbidden. Session continuation requires the same or narrower live lineage and current grant, a new job/window/reservation and explicit job-bound session identity. A file/env secret printed to stdout can reach the provider even with command network disabled, so N has no unrelated secrets and X output is quarantined and disclosure-checked before becoming native input. Model login credentials are the explicit N trusted root; code and arbitrary MCP processes cannot inherit them.

DESIGN PROPOSAL. Native job default: one launch, ≤360 s network window, ≤4 vCPU, ≤8 GiB N memory, ≤2 GiB output/scratch combined, ≤16 MiB emitted result/capture per job, ≤1 GiB permitted network bytes measured at G. External process stops use SIGINT, then after 5 s SIGTERM, then after another 5 s SIGKILL of the cgroup. The gate deadline is independent of cooperative process handling. Capture interruption and possible remote work; never assert that provider-side computation stopped. Provider-internal subcalls/retries may be opaque: enforce finite launches, wall/process/output/network budgets and bounded account exposure, report unknown subcall counts honestly. A job requiring exact per-subcall accounting is ineligible for an opaque native profile. Tests must cover partial JSON, successful work with missing terminal output, session leakage, quota interruption and a resumed stale context.

SPECIFICATION — added by the F2 join (R-D20, R-G07). The metered path has an observation point, a cadence, a named reader and a response. The metered affordance — enabling credits or pay-as-you-go alongside a subscription — is one account setting away at both providers and nothing currently observes it. Observation point: the AuthAttestation billing-and-credit fields above, which already record approved credit settings and API-key override absence. Cadence: before every launch and at most every five minutes while active, the same refresh cadence §6 sets for allowance observations; custodian-only billing observations expire after 24 h or immediately on a relevant auth/plan/credit event. Named reader: the current capacity owner and its alternate, the same pair §6's pressure alert names. Response: halt new launches in that class and apply the existing quarantine of §6's uncertain-billing rule — not a new mechanism, and not a warning. This is disclosed as observation, not prevention: it detects the flip after it has happened and cannot stop it, and a design that claimed otherwise would be claiming a boundary it does not hold.

SPECIFICATION — the metered flip is a capacity event, not only a money and policy event (R-G07). Enabling credits drops the prompt-cache lifetime from an hour to five minutes. That drop is a change in how much work one allowance buys, so it is carried in the capacity row that the metered observation writes, alongside the money and policy consequences. Pricing the flip only in money understates it by the amount of cache the company was relying on, and that quantity is not recoverable after the fact. **That row's measure is the registered cache_lifetime** (value-registry.json#/CapacityMeasure) --- named here because F6C-06 found this passage binding to no capacity measure at all: CapacityObservation.payload was expressive enough to carry the drop, and cache_lifetime occurred zero times in any registry, so the instruction was addressed to a future implementer rather than to a row that exists.

sections.heading: 6. Capacity, money and scheduling
sections.html:
6. Capacity, money and scheduling

SPECIFICATION. ResourceAccount and Reservation are kernel records; Budget is their composite, not a new ledger. Reserve each currency/principal separately. Keep subscription entitlement, provider quota buckets, native-job launches, compute, disk, network, paid calls, customer delivery capacity and human attention as separate units. Money cannot be inferred from token estimates, and an included subscription call still uses scarce capacity. Actual owner cap, operating hours and authorized infrastructure/professional spend are required setup data; the $400 subscription baseline is an assumption from L10, not an infrastructure budget or permission to spend.

DESIGN PROPOSAL. Capacity policy CP1 initializes at one native N job and one X job concurrently, with separate reserved service/grievance/recovery work. Increasing concurrency is a reviewed CapacityPlan revision after measured resource and provider allowance evidence. Whether that pin is a provider constraint or a self-imposed policy is not established here and is X14, which the attack consolidation called the round's highest-leverage open question and left without an owner. It is settled by reading the account entitlement — one inspection, not an experiment, since raising the pin to discover the limit would be circular. The read is the founder's, because only he holds the account, and it is registered as Q-022 (F6C-07). [05-work-agents-skills.md](05-work-agents-skills.md) §12's reserved-lane holder and founder packets MD-07 and MD-08 all sit behind it. Dispatch uses earliest real obligation deadline within class, then age; reservations prevent speculative improvement, cold outreach or repeated failed exploration from consuming the protected due-service share. Proposed planning shares are 50% due service/commitments, 20% ordinary creation/research, 15% continuity/security/grievance, 6% maintenance and 4% evaluation — two separate rows summing to the 10% this pair previously shared (R-X11, F6C-05; the split is a DESIGN PROPOSAL placeholder owned by the founder under packet MD-08, and neither number is a measurement) and 5% discretionary exploration; the actual mandate must endorse shares and minimum absolute service capacity before use. Borrowing never removes a due-service minimum or creates authority. A grievance does not need to win a commercial prioritization score to receive the mandated response. *Amended 2026-09-14 (F6C-05): this read “10% maintenance/evaluation”, one bundled row, while R-X11 below requires evaluation to carry its own row and forbids funding it “out of whatever is left”. These enumerated shares are the only table this section has, so the rule was written against a row that did not exist and the only shares that did exist were the bundling it forbids. The branch taken is R-X11's own — split the row — because nothing contradicts it: this section's release precedence and [05-work-agents-skills.md](05-work-agents-skills.md) §7 place maintenance and evaluation at one precedence tier, and sharing a shed tier is not sharing a row.*

SPECIFICATION. Pressure is the maximum of independently observed saturation dimensions, not a blended score that hides exhausted money or attention. Yellow: any reservation ≥70% of its period allowance, disk ≥70% of admitted volume, or queue p95 delay threatens 50% of deadline slack. Stop new discretionary admission at 85%, restore only below 65% for 10 min; protected work continues only within its already reserved envelope. Disk ≥90%, capture loss, witness lag beyond admitted freshness, or uncertain billing quarantines affected launch/release. Alert current owner and alternate with exact exhausted dimension, due duties and available manual/other-provider paths. A provider outage pauses its queue, permits local D1 staging and already admitted computation, and routes suitable work to an independently qualified substitute; it never silently increases spend or authority.

SPECIFICATION. Allowance observations include source, observed_at, valid_until, account, bucket, interval/reset if supplied, remaining or unknown, and usage confidence. Refresh before launch and at most every five minutes while active using supported interfaces; custodian-only billing observations expire after 24 h or immediately on a relevant auth/plan/credit event. If provider has no reliable remaining value, schedule conservatively at one launch and use actual throttling plus finite episode reservations, not invented task capacity. Native model/effort selection records task predicate, evidence requirement, deadline, permitted provider/context, expected effort and escalation trigger. Start with the least expensive qualified profile, increase effort only after a specific deficiency and remaining reservation; provider/model switching requires equivalent task evaluation and compatible disclosure. Neither preference nor model branding establishes quality.

SPECIFICATION. Daily reconciliation compares provider invoices/credits/usage observations, cloud inventory and reservations; weekly review checks resets, due-service shortfalls, provider quality drift and attention use; monthly review compares forecast and actual operating cost. Old resources persist as billable until deletion/release is observed: stopped EC2 still has EBS/IP/snapshots, retired credentials may still renew, and paid subscriptions continue until native cancellation. Currency conversion uses an observed rate and timestamp for presentation only, never merges authority or financial books across currencies.

SPECIFICATION — added by the F2 join (R-X24). The lapse point, and cross-class release precedence. Every Reservation gains **holder_ref, stated_minimum and lapse_point. Reserved-but-unconsumed allowance is destroyed at the reset, so a reservation under this non-rolling allowance is priced as waste, not thrift — the only correct costing of a reservation here, and the opposite of the intuition that reserving is free. At the declared lapse point, unconsumed allowance is released across classes in a stated precedence: due service, then continuity/security/grievance, then maintenance and evaluation, then ordinary creation, then discretionary. The quantity that lapsed unconsumed is recorded per lane per window, so that a lane whose reservation is never consumed becomes visible rather than remaining a silent cost. The release is independent of any holder's consent: a holder may state a minimum and that minimum is evidence, not consent**, and nothing conditions the release on a decline the holder can withhold ([05-work-agents-skills.md](05-work-agents-skills.md) §12). UNKNOWN — founder packet MD-08, no default invented (the selection record §6.5): the size of each reserved lane, its stated minimum and its lapse point. The shares proposed above remain proposals requiring mandate endorsement; this amendment sets no value.

SPECIFICATION — added by the F2 join (R-G01). The exhaustion rule is distinct from the pressure rule. The pressure rule above governs a filling bucket; this one governs an empty one, and they are not the same rule at a higher threshold — fifty percent of an empty bucket is zero is the case this exists for. When the allowance is empty and a due obligation falls due: the named non-model production mode performs it — the manual and other-provider paths this section already admits, **named on the obligation as a required field, Obligation.production_mode, a closed enum over {manual_founder, contracted_professional, other_provider, none}, with production_performer_ref naming the assignment that carries it* — so that named explicitly is a field a predicate reads rather than a sentence a reader trusts (F6C-01). *An obligation in a duty class that can exhaust whose production_mode is none is refused at admission, by a conjunct on its own admission edge: an exhaustible duty with no performer is a promise with nobody behind it, and the moment to discover that is not the moment the bucket empties. A named recipient is alerted with the exhausted dimension, the due duty and the route taken; and the breach-or-perform decision leaves a record naming which was chosen and why — ExhaustionDecision, identity (obligation_ref, window), written once, proposed by C02 and authorised by C01, carrying the branch taken (performed | breached), the route, the alerted recipient and the due obligation (F6C-02). It is deliberately not a variant of ShedDecision**: that record's minimum_breached is a fact about a shed lane under pressure, and this paragraph's whole point is that the exhaustion rule is not the pressure rule — one record carrying both would collapse the distinction it exists to draw. Neither branch is silent, and neither branch is automatic. *Superseded 2026-09-14: this paragraph said the mode was “named explicitly on the obligation” and that the decision “leaves a record”, while production_mode occurred zero times in the registry, the schema, the predicates and the invariants, and no record type was the breach-or-perform record. Both are named above; neither existed when the sentence was written.*

SPECIFICATION — added by the F2 join (R-X11). An evaluation-capacity row, and its collision behaviour. Evaluation consumes capacity in the same units as production and carries its own row among the enumerated planning shares above — evaluation 4%, distinct from maintenance's 6%, both DESIGN PROPOSAL placeholders owned by the founder under MD-08; it is not funded out of whatever is left and not funded out of the maintenance row. When the evaluation cycle collides with a capacity-pressure window, evaluation sheds at the maintenance tier's position in the cross-class release precedence above — a distinct row and a shared shed tier are not in conflict: the row says what evaluation is funded from, the tier says when it yields (F6C-05) — — and a shed evaluation cycle is a recorded instrument gap, never a silent skip. An instrument that quietly stops running during pressure reports its best numbers from the calmest weeks, which is the failure this row prevents.

SPECIFICATION — added by the F2 join (R-X12). An expected-launch count per procedure version, checked at run close. Each admitted procedure version declares an **expected native-launch count — WorkflowDefinition.expected_native_launch_count, required — and both counts are demanded at run close — WorkflowRun.actual_native_launch_count beside the declared expectation, bound by a conjunct on the run's * → accepted edge that requires both pointers to be present and the run's definition to be an admitted or restricted procedure version (F6C-04). The divergence is readable from those two values and is deliberately NOT stored as a third number, which is the pin's own stated reason: “a stored difference can disagree with the two values it is derived from, and this package has paid for that class of mistake more than once.” *Amended 2026-09-14 (F6V-01): this read “by a conjunct on the run's * → accepted edge that records the divergence”. guard.launch.actual_compared_to_expected carries no comparison operator, and no payload field in the registry matches “diverg” — so the chapter promised a recorded value the pin deliberately refuses to store, and a reader here would not have gone looking. Two artifacts describing one conjunct and disagreeing about what it does is the class F6A-07 named, committed in the repair that closed it. Amended 2026-09-14 (F6Z-08): this read "an admitted procedure version". The guard's second predicate binds /payload/workflow_ref with states: ["admitted", "restricted"] and optional: false, so the single state denied acceptance to every run whose definition stands at restricted — work the registry permits. The pair was captured correctly by an earlier review and had not reached either chapter; 05 §13 row 9 is corrected in the same edit.* Without those two fields and that conjunct the comparison is a sentence, and reopen condition 4 of [02-architecture-selection.md](../02-architecture-selection.md) §9 — changed provider terms or semantics — names an instrument that does not exist, so the condition cannot fire (F6C-14). This is the dominant unpriced cost of the step model and it is not softened: a procedure that checkpoints at every step boundary makes more launches than one that does not, and nothing else in this package would notice the difference. The comparison is also the instrument that notices a changed provider property — the launch window, the concurrency pin, the cache lifetime, the metered affordance and the context-editing surface are all provider properties, and a change to any of them moves this cost model. The measurement owed for it is written out with a baseline, a unit, repetition, a stopping rule and an owner; until it runs, the cost of the step model is a stated unknown rather than an estimate.

SPECIFICATION. Customer economics are a separate per-offer statement: price received, tax/payment/FX/refund/dispute costs, direct delivery resources, actual human/professional labor, support/continuity, hosting/data retention, acquisition and allocated fixed overhead, with uncertainty and downside reserve. A provisional pilot price may authorize a bounded experiment only under its explicit acceptance predicate; it does not demonstrate demand, margin or repeatable fulfillment. Verify delivery_capacity.verify.v1 before sale. Do not resell subscription inference or treat founder time as free profit.

7. Deployment economics and comparators

DESIGN PROPOSAL. The priced reference is OP-AWS-LINUX-1: A in eu-central-1, R/G in independent account eu-west-1, N and X ephemeral in eu-central-1. sections.heading: 9. Outbound mail transport, event identity and disclosure
sections.html:
9. Outbound mail transport, event identity and disclosure

Scope. This section makes the IC-MAIL-OUT row of section 3 and the mail half of section 4 concrete: the actual transport boundary, the permitted positive mail path, where suppression is enforced and what each enforcement point can see, inbound provider-event identity and deduplication, the disclosure constraints on outward fields, and this adapter's conformance to T-R3. It adds no authority, changes no contract in the kernel or 02, and weakens nothing in sections 1–8. Where it is stricter than section 3, the stricter statement governs this adapter only.

Statement kinds. Every assertion below is one of: SPECIFICATION — our normative design, true by our decision and falsifiable only by our own tests; SOURCE CLAIM — attributed to a dated primary observation already registered in this package; INFERENCE — our reading of a source claim; ASSUMPTION — held without a source and required to be confirmed; UNKNOWN (admission check) — a value or behavior this package does not establish, which blocks admission of the profile until an actual observation closes it and which never defaults to the permissive branch. Unlabelled prose inside a table cell inherits its row's kind. Nothing here is a runtime result.

Method and retrieval limit of this authoring turn. No account was created, no token issued, no message sent, no webhook received, no provider contacted and no provider page retrieved in this turn — the authoring engine had no permitted retrieval path. Every provider fact below is carried from dated observations already in the package: the narrow orchestrator inspection of 2026-09-12 (Postmark admission details), the independent F-integration-04 source checks of the same date, and the IC-S04/IC-S30/IC-S31 groups of integration-claims.json under SC-POLICY-1. Where the concrete profile needs a value those observations do not contain, the value is an admission check, not a guess. This turn therefore does not refresh source currency; the 2026-10-12 scheduled recheck and every earlier trigger in IC-S30/IC-S31 still stand.

sections.heading: 9.1 The transport boundary, request identity and what the gate can see
sections.html:
9.1 The transport boundary, request identity and what the gate can see

SPECIFICATION. IC-MAIL-OUT is an ordinary consequential HTTP attempt and takes the full P1–P7 path of 02 §6.2. It sits inside the controlled-egress boundary of 02 §7.2: the connector process runs under G, receives frozen request bytes through the protected local pipe, and its packets leave only through G's dedicated per-attempt namespace/interface under the default-deny forward chain with the absolute nftables cutoff. There is no second route: the mail connector has no shell, no model, no DNS of its own, no redirect following, no SDK, no connection pool and no production filesystem. A message that C04 has not released cannot reach the provider, and a message C04 has released reaches exactly one pinned destination.

Profile fieldValue and kind

The token is credential-boundary material: the RecoveryEnvelope stores credential_generation and the deterministic construction rule, never the plaintext (02 §6.2); the header is constructed inside the connector at send time and is excluded from RawCapture by structural field selection (section 2)

If admission establishes an actual documented idempotency contract, it may be added as a profile revision with its own retention and account-scope semantics; until then no implementation may assume one exists

SPECIFICATION — three distinct identities, never conflated. (1) The company attempt identity {operation_ref, attempt_index} in the committed SendClaim, which is what G arms against and what the local durable attempt ledger consumes once. (2) The request identity request_digest over the frozen executable bytes, which is what binds the envelope to what was actually emitted. (3) The provider message identity returned in the response or appearing in later events, which is the provider's own name for its object and has no authority in this company. A join between (1) and (3) is an evidence relation recorded by C06; it is never an equality, and a missing join is an unknown, not an absence of effect.

SPECIFICATION — what the gate can and cannot see. G's nftables hook evaluates a kernel buffer on the attempt interface against destination, protocol, port and absolute time. It cannot see the recipient address, the message body, the stream, the consent basis or any suppression state, because those exist only inside the TLS session it is forwarding. Therefore no recipient-level or consent-level rule may be specified at the gate, and any design that claims one is wrong about this boundary. The gate bounds when and to whom the connection may exist; it does not bound what the message says. That separation is the reason sections 9.2 and 9.5 place their enforcement where they do.

sections.heading: 9.2 Where suppression and eligibility are actually enforced
sections.html:
9.2 Where suppression and eligibility are actually enforced

Architecture selection §4 requires that a connector promising stricter suppression enforce it at the relevant provider boundary. This adapter promises a suppression that is strictly narrower than the provider's, so it has three enforcement points with different visibility, and the promise is discharged only by the conjunction of all three.

PointWhen it runs and what it can seeWhat it decidesWhat it cannot do

This is the only point that can stop a message before it existsSee provider-side suppression changes later than its last admitted read; recall a released message

SPECIFICATION. The decision is the conjunction: a send proceeds only if E1 permits and the current admitted provider-suppression observation does not deny. The provider's permission never widens E1's decision; a deny at either point is a deny, and the refusal records which predicate was unmet. The provider-suppression observation used at P3 must be no older than 300 s and is re-read immediately after any bounce or complaint event for that recipient or after any connection pause/resume; a stale, failed or unparseable observation is a refusal, not a permit. Company Suppression records are authoritative and permanent within their scope and are never removed because the provider's list no longer contains the address.

SPECIFICATION — provider eligibility is a separate predicate from company authorization, and it is checked first. ProviderEligibility is a profile predicate evaluated before P1 over {mail form, message stream, consent basis and its evidence, audience derivation, unsubscribe handling}. SOURCE CLAIM: the provider's terms, effective 2024-12-10, require permission-based lists and restrict unsolicited messages (terms of service, accessed 2026-09-12). INFERENCE (carried from the 2026-09-12 inspection and F-integration-04, not new): exact founder authorization of content and recipients does not by itself make an outreach eligible for this adapter; a campaign whose audience is derived rather than opted in fails ProviderEligibility even when the company grant, the content and the amount are exact. The refusal is recorded as an unmet provider-terms predicate naming the clause relied on, is visible to the owner, and routes the work to IC-HUMAN or to an explicitly admitted alternative route — it is never silently retried on another adapter, and changing tool does not change the business identity (section 2).

UNKNOWN (admission check) — actual account facts that remain unknown and are not invented here: whether an actual account exists or would be approved for a custom API client; the account's monthly allowance and whether charges above it apply automatically; the account's eligible message streams; the applicable law, principal and recipients; the current provider IP ranges used for webhook delivery; and whether any of the terms clauses is modified by an actual agreement. SOURCE CLAIM: the terms address account credential sharing, approved API access, third-party application consent, unsubscribe handling and extra charges above the monthly allowance (terms of service, 2026-09-12); that they address these subjects is what the source supports. What they permit for this company is an account-admission question, and this section states no answer.

A prohibition list is not a route. The adapter is admitted with a closed set of mail forms; a message is sendable if and only if it instantiates exactly one admitted form and satisfies that form's predicate. A form whose predicate holds has an ordinary, refusal-free path to transmission — that is the positive half, and an implementation on which no form can complete has failed this contract as surely as one that sends what it should not.
