sections.heading: 9.4 Inbound provider events: identity, deduplication, retention
sections.html:
9.4 Inbound provider events: identity, deduplication, retention

SOURCE CLAIM (webhook overview, accessed 2026-09-12; publication date not established). The provider documents no HMAC webhook signatures; its recommended protection combines HTTPS Basic Authentication with current provider IP allowlisting, endpoint verification is a separate feature, and the page describes retrying failed processing. UNKNOWN (admission check): the retry count, the retry horizon, whether a retried delivery is byte-identical to the original, and the current IP ranges.

SPECIFICATION — the ingress receiver. Inbound events terminate at the admitted company ingress boundary, never at A's control plane directly. The receiver holds no grant, no company credential and no model; it authenticates, stores and acknowledges, and nothing else. Its acknowledgement means exactly received and durably staged at this boundary — never accepted, understood, believed or acted upon, and never a discharge of any customer duty. It acknowledges only after the raw capture and the deduplication key are durably written; if that write fails it does not acknowledge, and provider redelivery is the recovery path.

OPEN PLACEMENT DECISION, deliberately not taken here. Which admitted boundary hosts the receiver — the Cloudflare Worker of IC-PUBLIC, or a narrow inbound listener under G — is an architecture placement with different exposure, quota and recovery consequences, and it is the orchestrator's to decide. Both candidates must satisfy the constraints in this subsection unchanged. This section specifies the contract, not the host.

SPECIFICATION — origin authentication and its exact limit. A unique high-entropy Basic credential per connection and endpoint, issued from the credential boundary, rotated on any suspicion and on connection revision; the configured endpoint URL and the Authorization header are excluded from logs, captures and artifacts by structural field selection with an omission marker (section 2); TLS terminates at the ingress boundary under our own certificate; the peer address is verified against the current admitted provider range through explicit trusted-proxy handling, with the range maintained as an admitted dependency that expires. INFERENCE: this is a shared-secret claim, so a leaked credential, a stale allowlist or a provider-side compromise forges an event that our checks accept; provider endpoint verification is an availability feature and is not message authenticity. SPECIFICATION, following from that limit: no inbound event may by itself produce a consequential effect. An authenticated event may (a) record an IntegrationObservation, (b) apply or extend a company Suppression, or (c) create a case or duty for qualification. It may never release money, discharge a duty, close a complaint, accept an outcome or widen any permission. Effect (b) is permitted unreconciled because suppression only ever restricts — and the resulting exposure is stated rather than hidden: a forged complaint stream can deny service to a legitimate recipient, which is detected by reconciliation against the admitted provider read route and is an incident, not a silent state.

SPECIFICATION — event identity. The deduplication identity of an inbound event is

EventIdentity = (company_id, connection_ref, provider_server_identity, record_type, event_occurrence_key)

enforced as a unique constraint in the ingress inbox, with these four rules.

  1. Distinct per event kind. record_type is part of the identity, so a delivery, a later bounce and a later complaint for one provider message are three distinct events with three distinct effects. Deduplicating on the provider message identifier alone is prohibited: it would collapse exactly the events that matter most.
  2. Stable under provider retry. event_occurrence_key is taken from the provider's own event-specific identifier for that record type where one exists, and otherwise from a digest over the event's content fields whose invariance under redelivery was positively established at admission. A field whose retry-stability is not established is excluded from the key and retained as observation payload only. UNKNOWN (admission check): the per-record-type field paths and their retry-stability are not established in this package; each is bound and tested at admission, and this section deliberately names no field.
  3. Collisions are contested, never discarded. Two events sharing an identity but differing in content are not a duplicate: both raw captures are retained, the observation is marked contested (section 1), and the meaning is resolved through the admitted provider read route. Silently dropping the second is prohibited.
  4. No identity, no effect. A record type for which no stable per-event identity can be bound at admission is admitted only in reconcile-only mode: its events are hints that schedule a provider read and a SourceCursor reconciliation, and they produce no business effect of their own. Inventing an identifier to make such a type usable is prohibited.

SPECIFICATION — uniqueness scope and retention. The scope is per company, per connection and per provider server, so re-registering an account or admitting a second server creates a new scope and cannot collapse two accounts' events; a connection revision that changes the scoped provider identity invalidates incompatible prepares (section 1). The deduplication key is retained for the longer of: the life of every operation, duty and dispute it bears on, plus their reconciliation; and the observation's own admitted retention. It is explicitly not a sliding window that may expire while the related duty is live, and its retention is accounted in DeletionScope like any other record.

SPECIFICATION — lost responses and expired windows never justify a resend. On the inbound side, a lost acknowledgement means the provider may redeliver; a redelivery meets the unique constraint and receives the same acknowledgement with no second effect. If the deduplication index itself is lost or rebuilt, re-imported events fall back to the recorded business effect for that (provider message, record_type, occurrence) — already-applied is a no-op — and any event whose prior application cannot be established enters reconcile-only mode. On the outbound side, a lost send acknowledgement is unknown_effect under 02 §9 and there is no blind resend and no automatic retry, because this profile has no idempotency contract (9.1). What happens instead: the operation retains its holds and its potential obligations; C04 reconciles by reading the provider's own record for that attempt through the admitted read route, keyed by the opaque per-attempt value carried in the message's metadata or tag (9.5); if that read resolves to exactly one message the effect is determined, and if it does not, the operation stays unknown_effect with an owned reconciliation duty and the owner is told so in those words. UNKNOWN (admission check): whether the provider's read route can resolve an opaque attempt key to at most one message is not established here. If admission shows it cannot, this adapter is admitted only for mail forms whose duplicate is tolerable or whose send requires human confirmation — not for forms whose duplicate creates a second business effect.

sections.heading: 9.5 Outward fields, metadata and hidden disclosure
sections.html:
9.5 Outward fields, metadata and hidden disclosure

Architecture selection §4 is explicit that provider prompts, search queries, URLs and telemetry are disclosure destinations too. Everything this adapter sends to the provider — including fields the recipient never sees — is a disclosure to the provider under the connection's DisclosureContract (02 §8.2).

SPECIFICATION — the outbound object is closed. The renderer emits exactly the fields below and nothing else: the serializer is generated from a closed schema with additionalProperties=false, and a field absent from this table is absent from the request, not defaulted by a library. No SDK, no client default and no model output may add a key. The rendered bytes are frozen before P2, hashed into the envelope, and compared byte-for-byte at release; no business field may be filled after hashing (02 §6.2).

SPECIFICATION. Because tracking is off, open and click event types are admitted as inert: recorded as observations, never producing a business effect. An observed open or click event while tracking is off is configuration drift, not information — it quarantines the connection immediately under section 2 and is an incident to reconcile. Enabling tracking would add a recipient-behaviour disclosure and new consequential event types and is a protected integration change, never a convenience toggle.

SPECIFICATION — metadata cannot become a side channel. The linkage from an opaque metadata value to its operation lives only in A, under the operation's own retention and deletion scope. Metadata values are generated, never derived from business content, so that no reversible or low-entropy encoding of a customer identity reaches the provider. A mail form may not carry more distinct metadata keys than its reconciliation needs, and adding one is a profile revision reviewed as a disclosure change.

UNKNOWN (admission check) — what the provider adds. What the provider appends to the outbound message on our behalf — its own headers, return-path, signing domains, footers or links, and what it retains of the content — is not established in this package. It is a residual disclosure surface, it is read from an actual sent-message inspection at admission before the first real recipient, and no claim is made here about it. SPECIFICATION: the outbound bytes this company froze are the only bytes this company can assert; what a recipient finally receives is an observation, not a guarantee.

sections.heading: 9.6 T-R3 conformance for this adapter
sections.html:
9.6 T-R3 conformance for this adapter

T-R3 requires delayed first transmission, retries and delayed provider acceptance to be bounded separately, and grants and operator views to expose the gateway generation, the first-send deadline, cancellation/expiry semantics and the residual revocation window. This adapter conforms as follows, all of it inherited mechanism rather than new machinery.

T-R3 obligationThis adapter (SPECIFICATION)
Gateway generation fencingThe SendClaim binds gateway_instance_id and gateway_boot_id; a claim from an old boot cannot execute, and the claim is consumed once at the registry and once in G's local durable attempt ledger (02 §6.2)
First-transport deadline30 000 ms from bounded release time, capped by the earliest grant, prerequisite, account and credential expiry; compiled into the absolute nftables cutoff with the clock margin of 02 §7.3
A paused gateway retains no indefinite first invocationThe cutoff is absolute wall-clock at the packet hook, not a process timer. A connector paused before arming, after its userspace check, before the socket write or mid-buffer and resumed past the cutoff is dropped at the hook; bytes admitted before the cutoff may still arrive later and are classified as possibly applied (02 §7.4)
Retries bounded separatelyZero automatic retries for this adapter (9.1), so the retry interval is not an additional exposure. A new attempt requires positive proven-unsent evidence and a newly authorized deadline, never a replayed one
Delayed provider acceptance bounded separately — and honestly unboundedPassing the packet cutoff does not bound when the provider accepts, transmits or delivers. The residual revocation window for a mail effect does not end at the gate cutoff; it ends only at an observed provider outcome or an explicitly declared unknown. No adapter status may say cancelled, never sent or no effect from a timeout (02 §7.4)
Cancellation and expiry semanticsBefore release, cancellation releases only unused holds after D2 confirmation. After release it forbids future claims in the common order and asks G to fence eligible windows; already authorized effects are preserved as possibly applied. A stop is not a recall: an already delivered message cannot be retracted, and suppression prevents only new sends (section 3)
Operator and grant exposureThe operator view for a mail operation shows, as distinct fields: gateway generation and boot, first-send deadline with its absolute cutoff, claim state, cancellation disposition with its effective new-claim cutoff Position, the residual gate window, and the separate provider-side residual — displayed as unbounded-until-observed rather than as a time. A stop request distinguishes requested, release denied, worker stopped, external settlement and remedy completed (02 §9, section 7 of 02)

sections.heading: 9.7 Required tests, admission checks and sources
sections.html:
9.7 Required tests, admission checks and sources

MAIL-T01…08 (SPECIFICATION; all unexecuted). T01 positive path: each admitted mail form completes end to end through P1–P7 with deterministic rendering, a real gate window and a recorded outcome — a build on which no form can send fails this test. T02 eligibility: an owner-approved but provider-ineligible outreach is refused before P1 naming the unmet terms predicate, while an opted-in and a transactional message in the same fixture still pass. T03 origin: forged event with valid Basic credential from a non-admitted address, valid address with wrong credential, stale allowlist, and replayed body — each rejected and captured; and a genuine event accepted. T04 identity: delivery, then bounce, then complaint for one provider message create three distinct effects; a byte-identical redelivery of each creates none; two same-identity different-content events become contested rather than dropped; an unbindable record type stays reconcile-only. T05 lost boundaries: acknowledgement lost after staging, index rebuilt, ingress replaced — no second effect, no blind resend, and a lost send acknowledgement resolves through the read route or remains unknown_effect with an owned duty. T06 disclosure: attempt to place free text, a customer identity or internal state into tag, metadata, headers or HTML; assert the emitted object is byte-identical to the closed rendering and that no extra field was added by any library. T07 suppression: E1 deny with E2 permit, E2 deny with E1 permit, stale provider observation at release, and a suppression arriving between release and transport. T08 T-R3: pause at each of the four points of A-T04 and resume past cutoff; revoke before P3, between P3 and P4, and after P4; assert no late hook admission, no false cancelled claim and an honest unbounded provider residual.

Admission checks that block this profile (all UNKNOWN here). Absolute endpoint URI; authentication header name and token format; returned identity field names and uniqueness scope; existence and semantics of any send idempotency contract; whether the read route resolves an opaque attempt key to at most one message; per-record-type event identifier field paths and their retry-stability; provider retry count and horizon and whether redelivery is byte-identical; current provider webhook IP ranges; provider behaviour when an accepted request targets a suppressed address; what the provider adds to and retains of the outbound message; and every actual-account fact in 9.2 — account existence, approval for a custom API client, monthly allowance, overage behaviour, eligible streams, applicable law and principal. sections.heading: 1. Protected improvement contract
sections.html:
1. Protected improvement contract

SPECIFICATION. Any change to prompt, instruction, skill, workflow, routing, model profile, tool, connection, schema, context policy, memory rule, evaluator, acceptance predicate, agent template, UI meaning, operating policy, infrastructure or architecture is a versioned change to a defined subject. Work artifact revisions within an already admitted procedure remain ordinary work. Being beneficial, small, reversible or generated by an evaluator does not grant system-change authority.

SPECIFICATION — added by the F2 join. Six control objects are named as protected control changes, and a model is never in their acceptance path. A change to the consequence-class derivation function, the class mapping table, the standing-holder set, a declared class floor, the external policy object, or a writer-key assignment is a protected control change requiring independent authorization, and no model may sit in its acceptance path. These are the objects on which every other boundary in the package rests: they decide who may act, who is reachable for a duty, and who may write a record. The reason they are enumerated here rather than left to the general rule above is that each of them reads as configuration rather than as a change — a mapping table looks like data, a floor looks like a number, and a writer key looks like a field. See [05-work-agents-skills.md](05-work-agents-skills.md) §11 and §12 for the objects themselves, and [02-authority-recovery.md](02-authority-recovery.md) §4 for the class C5 they land in.

SPECIFICATION — added 2026-09-14 (F6D-07). Each of the six names a record and an edge, because "is a protected control change" binds nothing until something refuses the transition. The paragraph above was carried by prose alone: ProtectedChange is well built and its baseline_subject_refs is enum-typed over every record type, so a change can name what it touches — but no edge on any of the six required one, and three of the six were not records at all. The mechanism is a **protected_subject_kind enum on ProtectedChange** plus one conjunct, guard.protected.control_object_change_authorized, on each edge below: the transition is refused unless a ProtectedChange naming this exact subject stands at authorized or later, with that subject kind. No new record is created for the three that had none — each is an object the registry already holds, and inventing a parallel record for it would create the second implementation this package refuses everywhere else. Every row is SPECIFICATION.

Control objectThe record that carries itThe edge that requires a current authorized ProtectedChange naming it
The consequence-class derivation functionConfigurationVersion, the pinned artifact ConsequenceDerivation.derivation_fn_version cites — a typed ref, not a free string, and the record's own admission rule already reads "protected changes cannot enter as plain file edits"ConfigurationVersion: draft → admitted
The class mapping tableConfigurationVersion, one closed admitted variant, declaring control_object_kind = class_mapping_tableConfigurationVersion: draft → admitted
The standing-holder setnot a separate object: the set is the StandingHolder records currently in staffed, so a change to the set is a transition into or out of that phaseStandingHolder: proposed → staffed, staffed → suspended, staffed → retired_into
A declared class floorConsequenceClassDefinition, which ConsequenceDerivation.declared_floor_ref already points atConsequenceClassDefinition: proposed → admitted, admitted → restricted, admitted → retired
The external policy objectConfigurationVersion, declaring control_object_kind = external_policy_object — the launcher's effective managed policy of [05-work-agents-skills.md](05-work-agents-skills.md) §8, whose named writer is C04ConfigurationVersion: draft → admitted
A writer-key assignmentFieldAuthority, (field_path, epoch), where C01 declares the authorityFieldAuthority: declared → current, current → superseded

The conjunct is conditional and its benign case is the ordinary one. A ConfigurationVersion with no control_object_kind is an ordinary configuration and its admission requires no protected change; the guard fires only where the field is present, so the paired benign case is an ordinary configuration admitted normally, which must not be refused. **The adverse case is the one the W10 probe walks: a declared class floor changed with no authorized ProtectedChange naming it, which must fail.** Without that pair the guard would be detachable — removable with every check still green — which is the defect class this section is about.

SPECIFICATION — added by the F2 join (R-X26). Every new record carries a removal criterion, in the table that introduces it, in falsifier form. "Every mechanism carries a removal criterion" is an assertion nothing checks; the rule is discharged row by row or not at all. A record introduced without a removal criterion fails the amendment's own lint and is not admitted. The criterion is stated as a falsifier — a condition that, if observed, removes the record — and not as a review date: "we will revisit this in a quarter" is a calendar entry, while "if over a window no second claimant ever arrives for an allocated identity, the allocator is dropped" is a test. This applies to the records the F2 amendment adds in [05-work-agents-skills.md](05-work-agents-skills.md) §§3–7, §11 and §12, and to every record any later amendment adds to this package.

SPECIFICATION. ProtectedChange is the kernel canonical record. This document specifies its payload subtype IB-Proposal/v1 and supporting types, rather than creating a competing promotion state. Exact kernel states are proposed → reviewed → authorized → staged → activated → verified; any preactivation state may become rejected; activated/verified → rollback_required → rolled_back. reviewed requires completed independent assessment; authorized requires the exact current competent decision; staged means the exact manifest is prepared with no activation claim; activated requires native effect evidence; verified requires the declared monitoring/outcome predicates. Inconclusive/contested assessment cannot advance reviewed to authorized. Stop before activation rejects that candidate; stop after activation records rollback_required and reconciles consequences before rolled_back. A subordinate experiment cannot advance the parent state. IB-Proposal requires problem_statement; observed_failure_and_success_refs; baseline_subject_refs; exact_patch_and_manifest_ref; affected_components/contracts/skills/connections/duties/people; intended_benefit; plausible_harms; excluded_claims; authority_and_competence_refs; resource_reservations; predeclared evaluation_plan_ref; migration_plan_ref; rollout_plan_ref; monitoring_plan_ref; rollback_or_compensation_ref; cumulative_change_window; proposer_identity; and independence constraints. The proposer may be an agent, person, incident procedure or periodic review. Each field is typed or an exact ArtifactVersion/record reference; a prose assertion of 'safe' is not an evidence predicate.

SPECIFICATION. Supporting persisted types use RecordEnvelope: ChangeEvaluationPlan/v1 (frozen subject/baseline, task population, selection/denominator, outcomes, critical regressions, sample design, stopping rule, evaluator identities/competence, test suite digests, data lineage, thresholds and resource cap); ChangeTrial/v1 (plan ref, candidate/baseline digest, assignment seed, attempts/captures, omissions, deviations and results refs); ReleaseManifest/v1 (source tree, artifact digests, schema/meaning versions, dependency lock/SBOM, installed profiles, migrations, configuration digests, compatibility interval and approver refs); RolloutPlan/v1 (cohorts, maximum exposure, entry/exit/stop conditions, due obligations and native descendants); ChangeWatch/v1 (release ref, monitored outcomes, observation intervals, missing-data policy, stop owner and next review); MigrationPlan/v1 (old/new representations and meanings, converter digest, pre/post predicates, scope/conflict changes, live readers/writers, data loss, rollback boundary and reconciliation). These are implementation-support records, not a declaration that the later 46-subject catalog is complete.

Command under common /v1/commandsPreconditions and committed result
improvement.propose(problem_refs, subject_refs, proposal_artifact_ref)Authenticated proposer and normal write scope; creates proposed ProtectedChange with no activation authority.
improvement.plan(change_ref, evaluation_plan_ref, migration_plan_ref, rollout_plan_ref)Exact current candidate/baseline and affected obligations; independent plan owner freezes selection and thresholds before candidate outcomes are inspected.
improvement.trial.start(change_ref, plan_ref, reservations, admitted_trial_profile_ref)Nonproduction or exact bounded production trial authority, current evidence and isolation; records trial identity and causal envelope before launch.
improvement.trial.record(trial_ref, capture_refs, deviations)Protected capture path and complete planned denominator; missing attempts remain missing, never silently dropped.
improvement.assess(change_ref, trial_refs, predicate_ref, judgment)Qualified independent assessor with access to full dependencies; uses canonical EvidenceJudgment accepted/rejected/inconclusive/contested. Producing the proposal does not confer assessor standing.
improvement.authorize(change_ref, exact_release_manifest_ref, decision_ref)C04 consequence authority, current accepted predicates, actual competence/owner mandate and no conflicting protected change. Decision is not a grant substitute.
improvement.activate(change_ref, release_manifest_ref, rollout_step)Exact reviewed bytes/configuration, witnessed release and provider-specific effect protocol; activation is recorded only after native version/readback evidence. Unknown deployment remains unknown.
improvement.stop(change_ref, reason, affected_scope)Current standing or already delegated containment authority; freezes new exposure, preserves in-flight duties and evidence, invokes rollback/compensation plan.
improvement.close(change_ref, final_assessment_ref, descendant_and_duty_account)Required observation window and independent assessment complete; residual harms, migrations, descendants, rejected alternatives and next review retained. Closure does not erase failure history.

SPECIFICATION. A dedicated protected registry defines which authority may change each subject. Identity/grant rules, C04 release and conflict rules, R membership/frontiers, clock/gateway controls, audit/capture and evaluator selection, incident/containment rules, founder constraints and improvement safeguards require explicit protected authority and a competent independent assessor. Ordinary improvement agents have no write access to those deployment/configuration roots. A candidate evaluator cannot select its own hidden tests, alter the gate, sign its acceptance or provision the signing key. If independent competence is unavailable, the protected change waits while legitimate operation and containment continue under current rules; the system does not invent a qualified proxy for the founder.

SPECIFICATION. Automatic changes are limited to already approved deterministic adaptations with an exact bounded policy: retry timer within its declared envelope, lexical index rebuild from current authorized sources, queue reordering under the existing schedule, or parameter choice within an admitted workflow. Changes to the envelope, learning rule, evaluator, privacy scope or permitted action are new ProtectedChanges. A learning system's proposal and self-explanation are evidence inputs, not authority.

sections.heading: 2. Improvement evidence, stochastic comparison and drift
sections.html:
2. Improvement evidence, stochastic comparison and drift

SPECIFICATION. Signals come from accepted and failed customer outcomes, due-service failures, grievances, incidents, source contradictions, rejected proposals, capacity/attention pressure, restore exercises and productive successes. Each signal has its population/denominator, source completeness and uncertainty. Incident priority follows actual consequence and due duties; a long list of easy improvements cannot displace a neglected service obligation. Weekly triage prepares bounded proposals; monthly outcome review asks whether accepted customer value, obligation discharge, truth preservation, rights effectiveness, owner competence/attention and all-in cost improved. Retain unresolved disagreements by dimension; no aggregate score can trade a safety/authority failure for more throughput.

SPECIFICATION. Before a stochastic trial, freeze a task-stratified baseline, exact candidate, random assignment, common inputs and permitted context, resources, competent judges, critical failure predicates and outcome thresholds. Reuse historical tasks only where consent/access/lineage remain valid; hold out fresh tasks to detect benchmark memorization. Default noncritical comparison uses at least 30 matched task pairs across at least three relevant task classes and at least two independent runs per stochastic profile. This is a planning minimum, not a statistical guarantee; power depends on variance/effect size, so a predeclared interval or exact paired test and minimum worthwhile effect determine whether the evidence is sufficient. Report every run, timeout, refusal, invalid output, retry, cost and missing observation. Critical invariant tests require zero observed violations plus adversarial mechanism evidence, never a statistical permission to violate an invariant.

SPECIFICATION. An improvement claim requires no disqualifying regression, the predeclared useful-effect threshold, acceptable uncertainty and complete relevant evidence. Inconclusive remains inconclusive; extending sample size needs a declared sequential rule or a new trial, not optional stopping until significance. Model upgrades and fallback providers are evaluated on the actual work predicate, not model-name equivalence. Evaluate repairable errors, severe failures, useful completion, human correction minutes, elapsed time, cash/capacity, disclosure and accessibility separately. Independent blind assessment where feasible conceals candidate identity but preserves necessary context/competence; assessors disclose conflicts and cannot rely solely on a colluding model panel.

SPECIFICATION. Staged rollout uses: offline replay and deterministic contracts → isolated full company scenario rehearsal → shadow production reads with explicit disclosure and no outward effects → a bounded reversible real cohort under existing standing → expanded admitted cohorts → normal operation. Default real cohort is at most one venture, five live cases and one working day, and excludes irreversible/cross-company authority changes. The rollout plan may require longer due to the task's outcome horizon. Expansion requires independent current assessment, complete capture and reserved rollback/service capacity. High-consequence changes may skip real exposure entirely and require a full protected cutover with human oversight. Shadow work can itself disclose data or consume money; it needs its own authority/reservations.

SPECIFICATION. Monitor protocol failures at event time, stale capture/witness/network/identity within 60 s, and relevant business/quality outcomes daily and at their real due dates. These are intended detection targets to measure, not guaranteed latency. Missing telemetry blocks expansion and triggers a visibility incident. Stop immediately on a critical invariant violation, unexpected principal/destination/charge mode, evidence integrity failure or unaccounted effect. Other regressions use predeclared thresholds, not a posteriori explanations. Old and candidate policy cannot both issue authority for the same conflict scope. Cumulative drift review compares the current release with the last independently endorsed strategic baseline after every five accepted changes or 30 days, whichever comes first; changes cannot evade review by splitting one change into small revisions. Track interaction effects across simultaneous changes and retain a single protected-change serialization boundary for overlapping scopes.

SPECIFICATION. Rollback restores an old code/configuration version only if current schema/meaning and live obligations permit it. It never restores expired grants, old recovery membership, revoked identities, deleted knowledge, stale context, consumed budgets or old native sessions. Completed disclosures, sends, payments, physical acts and schema data loss need compensation/reconciliation and communication; a git revert cannot undo them. Record stopped release, partial effects and replacement duty ownership. For a data/meaning migration, use expand-read compatibility, shadow conversion, compare predicates, stop/fence incompatible writers, witnessed activation and then retire old readers. Conflict/participant/alias changes additionally execute T-R1's union freeze and forward migration; no rollback may revive an old claim or omit an unknown hold. Backup restore follows current R frontier and deletion scope, not the release's historical snapshot.

SPECIFICATION. The whole approach is falsified for an admitted operating scope if qualified comparison cannot show useful full-company progress within actual founder money/attention limits; critical enforcement repeatedly fails; independent competence/continuity cannot be maintained; or operational complexity makes due service systematically worse than a matched simpler design. The response is a recorded architectural choice/replacement, not redefinition of success or endless improvement experiments.

DECISION. OpenTofu plus Ansible/systemd is selected over Kubernetes/containers as the final small deployment: four VM placements, explicit Linux permissions and no cluster/control-plane/scheduler daemon needed to implement SQL scheduling. State contains sensitive infrastructure metadata and may contain secrets despite intent; encrypt it, scope it to its actual account custodian, and never give a model its storage credentials. Plans are reviewed exact artifacts and applies are protected external actions. Pin provider plugins and lockfile; no IaC auto-apply in a native session. Separate state custody cannot repair shared root/MFA/billing recovery. OpenTofu, state sensitivity, systemd resource controls.

DECISION. Infrastructure images use Ubuntu24.04/Linux6.8, Pg18.6, Node24.21.0, nftables1.1.3, chrony4.6, Keycloak26.7.3 and step-ca selected by 02. Pin image/build digests and package repositories; a current available patch release must pass its protected update before changing those versions. Hono/React/Vite/Ansible/OpenTofu exact patch pins are build-manifest outputs because behavior does not depend on an unexamined hypothetical version; the admission tests still apply to exact installed artifacts. No undocumented managed service substitutes for R's durable witness.

sections.heading: 4. Storage, identity, observability and operations
sections.html:
4. Storage, identity, observability and operations

DESIGN PROPOSAL. Pg roles separate command writer, query projection, replication, capture ingress and witness ledger. Pg migrations and configuration are protected artifacts; no ordinary application can SET LOCAL a weaker replication promise and still return witnessed success. The exact independent R receipt is required even after a locally committed interrupted sync wait. Blob copies have content hashes, access/deletion scope and key availability before witnessing. Outbox/inbox dedup state and timers are authoritative, while NOTIFY is only a wakeup hint. Projection watermarks carry committed_position/source_watermarks/generated_at/omissions and never imply a future receipt was part of its own GroupBody.

DECISION. Use Keycloak OIDC PKCE/WebAuthn for humans and step-ca short-lived mTLS with live identity epochs for services as in 02. Store provider/native credentials only on their designated protected boundary; use systemd credential files or equally scoped root-owned files mounted into the exact service, never in source, shell history, logs, model input or test fixtures. R signing and per-scope encryption keys have separate backup/recovery/deletion inventory; software key custody is an explicit trusted root. Key rotation overlaps only the declared validity window, drains old workload identities and records native revocation. Backup encryption without retained authorized keys is not a recoverable backup; retained keys after a deletion obligation are not completed deletion.

DESIGN PROPOSAL. Observability uses structured bounded JSON events, OpenTelemetry trace IDs and Prometheus metrics on R, with journald size/retention caps and encrypted capture artifacts. Metrics report command/witness latency, exact unconfirmed group age, native job/cgroup/gate status, unknown effects, cursor gaps, invalidation backlog, due duties and breaches, human response/attention, evaluator omissions, restore age, credential/renewal expiry and cost inventory. No prompt/raw customer content in metrics labels or traces. R witness/capture disk has reserved space separate from low-value logs; discarding telemetry never permits evidence-required release. Alerts go to authenticated operator views and the standing custodian channel under a preauthorized content form. Actual on-call response remains a measured human service, not a dashboard property. OpenTelemetry Node, Prometheus practices.

DESIGN PROPOSAL. Daily base backup and continuous WAL to R-controlled S3 use PostgreSQL native backup/WAL tooling with explicit file manifests and encrypted key inventory; nightly verify checksums/completeness, weekly restore a complete dataset on a disposable trusted R-boundary VM, never on untrusted X, quarterly rehearse actual custodian absence and primary loss. Record RPO/RTO as measured results; no numerical production promise before the exercise and workload qualification. Recovery restores authoritative groups and current R frontiers, revocation/expiry/conflicts/unknown holds/potential duties/deletion scopes and access descendants before any release. Historical signed frontier responses are stored as Observation artifacts for audit; activation demands the fresh signed response protocol. Schema migration and provider imports cannot overwrite the current recovery membership. Provider/account removal checks remote resources, subscriptions, D1 exports, native sessions, DNS and keys, not just local code deletion.

SPECIFICATION. Each release builds deterministic artifacts in X from a standalone pinned source checkout, records dependency lock/SBOM/source digest and test evidence, then sends a reviewed immutable release bundle to the protected deployer. Production hosts never git pull unreviewed source or run project install hooks with production credentials. Preview/dry-run and real activation are distinct operations; missing native readback means unknown activation. Rollback is a new authorized release with current restrictions. No unsupervised model edits to deployment policies, test selection, hidden expectation store or approval keys.

sections.heading: 8. Baseline comparison, transition and remaining obligations
sections.html:
8. Baseline comparison, transition and remaining obligations

SPECIFICATION. Before change, record native and manual baseline performance on the same task population: actual accepted value, open duties, truth/errors, owner/expert attention, inaccessible or unanswered interactions, total cash/capacity and time. Compare S1 against a credible simpler S0 using equivalent authority/rights/recovery outcomes and explicitly declared trusted humans/mechanisms, not identical component count. Price observed services separately from estimated sizing and unknown professional labor. Randomize or match task difficulty, include ordinary successes and difficult failures, and retain cost of all retries/refusals/reviews. A system that only refuses safely or creates beautiful records has not passed useful operation.

DESIGN PROPOSAL. Shadow transition lasts at least two complete operating weeks and one complete relevant obligation/settlement cycle, whichever is longer, within an explicit resource cap. This is a default evaluation window, not an automatic acceptance rule; sufficient sample and real outcome horizon may require longer. Old and new systems may read the same sources with authorization but exactly one has write/release responsibility for a business scope. Cutover records current duties, native objects, source cursors, actor standing, conflicts and unknown effects, fences the old issuer, imports and validates, then activates the new one with current evidence. Any gap keeps the duty assigned to its previous accountable owner or a genuinely accepted alternate.

SPECIFICATION. Stop building discretionary additions when all final contract/stage evidence is complete and the admitted operation has no uncovered material requirement; begin use only after B10, then judge real outcomes at B11. Stop or replace the architecture when the falsifiers in §2 hold. Retire obsolete agents, prompts, providers, policies, hooks, schemas and accounts through dependency-aware removal with portable records and no revived authority. Do not accumulate redundant systems because deletion is inconvenient.

DEFERRED. Outstanding consolidation: the canonical 46-subject schema/relationship catalog, all remaining question answers and independent complete-plan review. Outstanding empirical/operating evidence: every runtime/provider/isolation test, local tooling installation, real account eligibility and billing, actual custodian/professional acceptance, priced deployment approval, workload/attention measurements, operational recovery and customer outcomes. These are named obligations with stage owners and tests, not assertions of successful implementation. This authoring task completes neither G acceptance nor operational admission.

Company and human question traceability

SPECIFICATION. Contract: CHT-1.0 · architecture: S1.0 · authoring base: 857a98c · 2026-09-12. Status: substantive Phase F answers, unimplemented and pending independent complete-plan review. This amendment changes only source_question_contracts in capabilities.json. It does not change capability procedures, record schemas, authority, selected architecture, original questions or root coverage statuses.

Statement kinds (directive §6). Every substantive statement in this chapter carries one of: SPECIFICATION — our normative design, true by our decision and falsifiable only by our own tests; SOURCE CLAIM — attributed to a dated observation already registered in this package; DIRECT OBSERVATION — something observed while authoring, stated as what was seen; DECISION — a choice taken here, with its reason; UNKNOWN — a value or behavior this package does not establish, which constrains the dependent effect and never defaults to the permissive branch; DEFERRED — a question deliberately left open, with what would reopen it. A paragraph's opening label governs the whole paragraph unless a later clause carries its own; unlabelled prose inside a table cell inherits its row's kind. Nothing here is a runtime result.

Each entry preserves the original question, supplies an actual answer, points to the specific record and capability contracts, identifies the applied design decision and bounded evidence, states uncertainty, and names planned implementation and a distinct unexecuted conformance case. Audience and public relationships

Useful content, discovery and relationship work have labor and disclosure costs even when placement is unpaid. Campaigns hold exact audience, assets, cadence, expiry and measurement; an expired schedule does not authorize a later send burst.

SPECIFICATION. First encounters establish truthful expectations; ongoing communication preserves exact sold terms, restrictions and outstanding duties. Real interest uses coherent denominators and actual conversations, agreements or use rather than vanity activity. A public correction includes affected people and remedies where due. Original ordinary/adverse encounters challenge favorable account selection. Company commerce and 07's route contracts anchor the procedures without establishing audience response or publication authority now.

sections.heading: Culture, history and correction
sections.html:
Culture, history and correction

DECISION. CHT-D06 · F30-Q01–08. Endorsed values remain explicit and operationally testable through hard decisions. Newcomers receive scoped originals, settled constraints and legitimate reopening routes. A factual contradiction can be investigated without silently changing personal ends. Corrections append attributed versions and propagate invalidation while preserving the older decision's actual meaning and applicable retention limits.

SPECIFICATION. Distinct memory forms and purpose-filtered account views make history usable. A successor must perform an unfamiliar duty using the account; receiving a fluent summary is insufficient. Sensitive short fields, numeric values and relationships obey 06's storage contract: necessary surviving plaintext copies keep deletion incomplete. SOURCE CLAIM. L05 supports the distinction between retention, retrieval, correct use and validity; UNKNOWN: the selected approach remains untested on the company's actual corpus.

sections.heading: Institutional readiness and ending
sections.html:
Institutional readiness and ending

DECISION. CHT-D07 · F53-Q01–09. Actual principal, signatory, activity/location facts, account access, required rights/registrations and competent determinations establish readiness for the particular activity. FormationReadiness records exact dependencies, owner, evidence and supported lead-time ranges. This specification provides no universal jurisdiction, legal form, filing rule or setup duration.

SPECIFICATION. Pre-sale company.delivery_capacity.verify.v1 checks actual availability, competence, materials/access, performance window and continuity without needing an earlier SalesAgreement. Launch then joins the current distinct product, delivery, support and offer-condition judgments against its admitted requirements manifest. Customer fulfillment later needs actual agreement-bound performance. Money observed outside the intended route remains a possible real duty for competent resolution. Filing and closure require actual submissions/dispositions, not reminders or prepared packets. SOURCE CLAIM. L11 supplies conditional background; jurisdiction-specific determinations and accepted professional services remain real operating work.

sections.heading: Operator account and intervention
sections.html:
Operator account and intervention

DECISION. CHT-D08 · F21-Q01–11. C09 projects authoritative records with current permission filtering, Position, source watermarks, omissions and freshness. The account begins with due consequences, unknown effects and changes since last acknowledgment. It does not wait for model narrative or use fictional busyness as progress. Each decision retains exact terms, reasons, limits and latest/no-answer behavior.

SPECIFICATION. Phone and terminal views preserve consequential distinctions and accessible inspection. Intervention separates request, release fence, worker cessation, external reconciliation and actual remedy. A stale or disconnected view cannot authorize an effect; same-ID lookup resolves lost acknowledgments. Batch minutes and adopted availability control attention, with actual due-duty alternatives. 04's surface contracts and L09 supply design and bounded evidence; UNKNOWN: latency targets, accessibility under real use and a thirty-second triage experience are unexecuted tests.

sections.heading: Personal authority and absence
sections.html:
Personal authority and absence

DECISION. CHT-D09 · F22-Q01–10. Ask this particular person only where their legitimate decision right or indispensable capacity is actually needed. Routine choices use explicit current mandates; past similar approvals do not create new authority. A changed mind creates an exact successor decision and affects future work without erasing old promises.

SPECIFICATION. Absent response invokes the already adopted no-answer route, accepted substitute or bounded preservation, never consent. A month-long owner/provider absence requires real alternate standing, access, competence, funds and performance. Practiced oversight includes original adverse evidence and unfamiliar intervention, while values stay with their actual owner. 04's absence contract remains an operating-capacity obligation, not a claim that a backup packet solves unavailable people.

sections.heading: Observation and bounded accounts
sections.html:
Observation and bounded accounts

DECISION. CHT-D10 · F42-Q01–09. Trace exact work, causal episode, attempts, concurrent branches, artifacts, decisions, effects and accepted transfers. Telemetry and event order establish observed sequence and gaps; they do not by themselves establish cause or complete native capture. Keep endorsed reasons, executor explanation and causal hypothesis distinct.

SPECIFICATION. Account reconstruction, captured-response replay, live rerun and distribution replication have different guarantees and grants. Evidence minimization excludes secrets and unrelated personal data while preserving declared omissions and legitimate duties. Cost/capacity exhaustion cannot silently delete required evidence. An unfamiliar investigator must reconstruct the bounded result with honest limits. 06's evidence/account contract and L06 control these distinctions; UNKNOWN: no current completeness or reproducibility result is claimed.

sections.heading: Human decisions and practiced competence
sections.html:
Human decisions and practiced competence

DECISION. CHT-D11 · F46-Q01–09. Human requirements name the actual reason: values/taste, standing, specialist competence, relationship/service work or independent evidence. Layered packets preserve critical terms and contrary facts. Only dependent work waits; current authorized work continues with preserved resources and duties. Exact affirmative response, silence and release remain separate events.

SPECIFICATION. Independent ordinary/adverse samples, pre-advice judgments and unfamiliar delayed transfer can test meaningful understanding within consented time. A material domain gap changes the affected operational path through assistance, narrowing, rehearsal or wait, with contestation and values authority preserved. Standing bounded preservation may act immediately when its declared evidence/authority requires it; urgency alone does not authorize broad control. No general intelligence score, surveillance profile or universal learning dose is introduced.

sections.heading: Collaboration, transfer and departure
sections.html:
Collaboration, transfer and departure

DECISION. CHT-D12 · F51-Q01–10. Canonical IdentityBinding, Principal and Mandate control people; ActorBinding is their filtered projection. Joint decisions require the exact declared combination. Specialist authority and founder authority differ, and shared contribution retains an accountable outcome sponsor.

SPECIFICATION. Human handoff is Continuation plus accepted ResponsibilityAssignment/HandoffAcceptance after actual access and competence checks. Receipt alone does not discharge the sender. Succession and departure inventory native descendants, fees, data, unknown effects and due duties, then require acknowledged cutover and continuing residual custody. A company of one is a scope choice only within demonstrated actual capacity; invented model roles cannot supply missing professionals or independent continuity.

Statement kinds (directive §6). Every substantive statement in this chapter carries one of: SPECIFICATION — our normative design, true by our decision and falsifiable only by our own tests; SOURCE CLAIM — attributed to a dated observation already registered in this package; DESIGN PROPOSAL — a construction offered for review, not yet decided; UNKNOWN — a value or behavior this package does not establish, which constrains the dependent effect and never defaults to the permissive branch; DEFERRED — a question deliberately left open, with what would reopen it. A paragraph's opening label governs the whole paragraph unless a later clause carries its own; unlabelled prose inside a table cell inherits its row's kind. Nothing here is a runtime result.

sections.heading: 1. Catalog semantics and ownership
sections.html:
1. Catalog semantics and ownership

SPECIFICATION. The nine component IDs are the logical responsibilities selected in S1.0. They do not imply nine services, nine agents or one owner for every kind of decision. C01/C02/C05 and appropriate domain coordinators may share a protected process; the producer, authority, independent witness and evidence-control privileges retain the separations prescribed in 01–02. Records, signed responses, projections, operating processes and actual human mandates are distinct things. DEFERRED: The complete record/predicate catalog is a separate consolidation obligation.

SPECIFICATION. Every component below supplies purpose, responsibility, nonresponsibility, owner, interfaces, inputs, outputs, state, lifecycle, dependencies, trust, permissions, failure, observability, evaluation, scaling, version, replacement and removal. State/lifecycle entries explain ownership and transition conditions using the existing canonical machines; they do not create another persisted component state or competing grant/acceptance machine. Planned module paths name implementation destinations under the final construction graph; those modules are not represented as implemented.

SPECIFICATION. An owner is an actual Principal acting under a current accepted ResponsibilityAssignment and Mandate for the relevant scope. A job title, component ID, company namespace, agent template or authenticated account cannot supply legal standing, professional competence or consent. The exact holder, accepted alternate, available time, fees, response window and recovery access are operating setup evidence. One person may hold compatible assignments within actual capacity; producer independence, legitimate deciding parties and independent recovery custody cannot be waived to simplify the roster.

sections.heading: 2. Enforcement and actual standing
sections.html:
2. Enforcement and actual standing

SPECIFICATION. At the authoring boundary, these mechanisms are prose contracts. Implementation must demonstrate deterministic schema/revision/epoch checks, attenuation, serialization, protected capture, exact independent witness, bounded transport, resource accounting and all-channel isolation. Actual provider eligibility, professional performance, custodian independence, lawful standing, continuing service and an owner's practiced competence require external evidence and accepted people. Software can refuse an act whose required evidence is absent; it cannot make the underlying fact true by recording an approval.

SPECIFICATION. The operational placement remains OP-AWS-LINUX-1: A and R use distinct actual account/admin/recovery roots in the specified regions; R and G deliberately share one host/admin/load root; native authentication resides in N and arbitrary code in X. AWS common-provider failure and the declared admitted root compromises are outside the stronger independent-loss claim. Local processes or the development VM cannot demonstrate those roots. The priced deployment and outcome-matched comparators retain estimated sizing and unknown actual professional/custodian/founder costs. The subscription baseline does not establish infrastructure funding or owner attention adequacy.

SPECIFICATION. Failure behavior follows the affected dependency and consequence. Missing required identity, witness, trusted time, disclosure lineage or exact accepted predicate denies dependent authority. D0 ephemeral work, genuinely saved D1 local staging/export and D2 witnessed transitions have different claims. Already admitted local work may continue within surviving context, lease and allowance. An offline browser draft is neither a server StageRef nor independently durable; a primary-ahead command row is not a witnessed acceptance. Actual owed service still needs an accepted competent route or a truthful missed-duty account. A system that only refuses safely has not demonstrated useful company operation.

SOURCE CLAIM. The SC-POLICY-1 maintenance contract applies explicitly to inherited substrate reliance. Record source/version, publication date or unknown, access time, issuer interests, confidence and applicability limits; primary documentation can be interested and cannot prove runtime composition or business value. Recheck before dependency lock or operating reliance, on upstream/security/support/auth/terms change or contradiction, and no later than 2026-10-12 for this initial living reliance unless an earlier consequence deadline applies. Preserve historical claims with their original scope; stale/inaccessible/contradicted sources lose eligibility as the sole current prerequisite. Relied-on 07–08 sources must carry the same maintenance fields before operating admission, without pretending they already have entries in the shared register.

Every unique requirement ID joins exactly one binding of exact subject/version, predicate and current accepted EvidenceJudgment. No omissions, duplicates, substitution across distinct subjects or readiness self-evidence. A changed requirement, child or mapping invalidates dependent readiness before release.

Accepting an uncertainty report does not accept an unrelated product.

Approved claim forms, trusted slots or actual competent review accompany the separate disclosure, all-channel network and descendant controls. No opaque native subcall count or automatic paid fallback is presumed.
Current validity and sensitive storageLive lineage invalidation checks at use/publication include actual delivered ancestry and transitive evidence dependencies. Sensitive fields include short text, numbers and relationships. Encrypt protected canonical bytes before persistent record/group/log/WAL/index/backup copies; surviving plaintext linkage, live holders, shared keys or external copies keep deletion residuals explicit.
Stop and retryRequest, future-release fence, worker cessation, external reconciliation and remedy completion are separate. Unknown effects retain holds and cannot receive an automatic fresh mutation merely because an acknowledgement was lost.
Controlled changeEvaluator, authority, schema, meaning and component replacement changes use ProtectedChange and current independent authorization. Rollback preserves current revocations, deletion, released/unknown scopes and duties. Replacement or removal must transfer actual custody and revoke native descendants, not just delete a module.

Superseded 2026-09-13. "Replacement or removal must transfer actual custody and revoke native descendants, not just delete a module" stands verbatim, **and so do the nine per-component Removal rows in §3 below* — S1-C01's "unresolved ownership blocks complete removal", S1-C02's "Drain or assign every active/parked order", S1-C03's "Remaining duties pass only through accepted responsibility transfer"*, and the matching clause in S1-C04 through S1-C09. What changed is that one predicate now reads the field they all depend on. All 173 records carry owner_component, S1-C03 owns 35 of them, and until this repair none of the 2255 predicates read it, so every one of those ten sentences was a rule with no reader. The new primitive component_custody_transferred(subject_ref, scope_field) — restricted by its own record_type enum to ProtectedChange — sits on edge.ProtectedChange.staged.activated.v1, the edge where a staged change becomes a live one, which is where "complete removal" happens rather than where it is authorised. It resolves the components a change's scope removes, enumerates every record whose owner_component names them, and requires an accepted successor owner for each. Its unresolved case is the load-bearing half: an owned set that cannot be COMPLETELY enumerated at the witnessed frontier is unresolved, never true, because an incomplete enumeration is precisely the condition under which a record is silently orphaned. A change whose scope removes no component is true and demands nothing. Primitives 56 → 57; the guard is pinned by REQUIRED_GUARD_OPS in validate_contracts.py, so deleting it fails the build. Read the scope narrowly: no runtime exists, so the removal of S1-C03 with 35 owned records and no successor is specified behaviour, not an executed result. Decided as R-J (G2-07).
