OwnerActual accepted authority/security ResponsibilityAssignment with scoped Mandate, independent competent assessment for protected changes and accepted alternate. Sole issuance is a logical contract, not an agent named chief executive or a claim that one human owns every decision domain.
InterfacesCommon operation/grant/reservation/release/send-claim commands from 02; GET /v1/operations/{id}/status; R witness/proof lookup and G bounded transport. All callers use exact typed payloads, actor identity, revisions, current ContextManifest and causal reservations.
InputsOperationIntent exact bytes/account/principal, parameter provenance, live identity/grant/validity epochs, participants/conflict map, accepted subject/predicate evidence, resource/duty holds, trusted-time admission and exact independent completeness receipt.
OutputsGuarded refusal, preparation/reservation, immutable Release/SendClaim business records and separate post-witness SendAuthorizationBundle/status proof. Status may expose unknown/partial effects; it is never a renewed permit or a receipt embedded in its own hash.
StateCanonical Grant/ResourceAccount/Reservation/OperationIntent/ConflictClaim/Release/SendClaim and epochs; exact registered attempt/effect/stop dimensions. BusinessResult/GroupBody are immutable, external signatures and current status are joined values/projections.
LifecyclePrepare holds → independent complete envelope witness → ordered release → one-use witnessed send claim → bounded G transport → protected observation/reconciliation. Revoke/freeze stops new authority and contains finite issued exposure; rollback/migration never revives consumed or expired claims.
DependenciesC01 actual mandates; C05 current disclosure/lineage; C06 exact current independent judgments; C02 causal/work scope; C07 actual standing/competence; C08 full durable witness/frontier/key availability; admitted G/clock/credential roots and provider effect semantics.
TrustPg administrator, R signer/admin, G clock/network root, IdP/CA custody and native account provider are declared roots with scoped exclusions. Separate process or account names alone prove no independence. Source text cannot choose trusted recipient/payee/account or evaluator.
PermissionsOnly protected command service may change control records; grants intersect actions/resources/destinations/purpose/budget/expiry/delegation depth. Workers cannot edit SQL schema/replication, mint grant or alter G. Consequential human decisions require exact current challenge and real authority/competence.
FailureMissing/contradictory/stale prerequisite denies dependent release, not all company computation. Lost ack looks up exact stable result/proof; ambiguous send keeps holds. G expiry bounds sk_buff admission at its named hook, while partial requests and later wire/provider effects remain reconcilable unknowns.
ObservabilityUnconfirmed group age, prepare/release/send-claim positions, current restriction epochs, credential/time attestation, gate window/bytes, retained unknown holds, conflict scope migrations, native effect/status and stop phases; never reduce these to a green success flag.
EvaluationCA-C04: successful distinct-subject launch plus lost ack; wrong/stale JudgmentBinding fails; concurrent revocation/send claim, empty standby/local sync cancellation, delayed sender/pooled socket, scope alias migration and parameter injection retain required safety and useful valid progress.
ScalingOne admitted writer/order per registry generation and one unconfirmed authoritative group/company initially. Batch pure compatible work only with unchanged atomicity; measure R/G witness latency and contention before enlargement. Independent departmental issuers require the explicitly reviewed extension, not spontaneous sharding.
VersionProtectedChange exact manifest governs policy/auth/gate/schema/meaning revisions. T-R1 freezes the union of old/new participant/business scopes, fences pending exposure and maps every unknown/potential duty before forward activation. No arbitrary mutation of proof formats or key membership.
ReplacementFence old issuer and transport, obtain current independent frontier, account all released/unknown work and current restrictions, qualify replacement roots/profile, then issue a new generation under authorized recovery. Old snapshots/receipts/status cannot renew authority.
RemovalStop new commitments, expire/revoke/fence grants and windows, reconcile native descendants/effects and assign actual remaining duties; preserve permitted evidence and key/deletion inventory. A running company cannot drop the consequence boundary while claiming the same contract.

sections.heading: S1-C05 — Context and validity
sections.html:
S1-C05 — Context and validity

DESIGN PROPOSAL. Planned primary module: system/packages/context. Contract anchors: 2. Logical component and deployment interfaces, 3. Repository and process implementation target, 2. Context assembly and information loss, 4. Maintenance, corrections and deliberate forgetting.

AttributeContract
PurposeProvide relevant usable information whose source, purpose, recipient, temporal applicability and surviving restrictions remain explicit at use.
ResponsibilityLoad actual delivered context/ancestry, maintain knowledge/source/correction and validity dependencies, filter before retrieval, track transformations/loss, atomically publish derivatives against live epochs and apply continuing deletion/forgetting scopes.
NonresponsibilityDoes not decide founder values, factual truth by search rank, independent acceptance, legal retention duration or native deletion that it cannot observe. It cannot infer permission from public availability, a small field, a content hash or an old manifest.
OwnerAccepted knowledge/data ResponsibilityAssignment and actual maintenance custodian, with competent C07 retention/duty determination where needed and C06 assessment of knowledge/evaluation claims. Owner identity and protected-data authority remain setup evidence.
Interfacescontext.capture/publish plus knowledge.* and current record/query interfaces; returns permission-filtered manifests/handles to C03, current validity predicates to C04, dependency changes to C06/C08 and omission-preserving views to C09.
InputsWorkOrder/purpose/destination, exact source/original/claim/capture refs, permission/retention and live epochs, prior complete native ancestry, accepted critical preservation contract, storage classification and bounded retrieval/context capacity.
OutputsContextManifest with actual delivered sources/transformations/omissions, current-use eligibility, exact corrections and contradictions, encrypted canonical/derivative artifact refs, scoped invalidation/forgetting effects and owned unresolved KnowledgeQuestions.
StateCanonical ContextManifest/ValidityEpoch and domain SourceRecord/KnowledgeEntry/KnowledgeQuestion/ContextTransformation/SummaryLoss/ForgetRequest; lexical indexes and scan results are rebuildable derived state with complete frontiers, never authorities.
LifecycleReceive source → classify/verify for scoped use → load current permitted context → publish atomically → maintain/review/correct → restrict/forget/archive/erase under actual duty. New ancestry or recipient requires a new current manifest, not a local validity toggle.
DependenciesKernel serial current-epoch/publication boundary and encrypted durable blobs; C01 endorsed purpose; C04 disclosure/access authority; C06 evidence closure/assessment; C07 retention/consent standing; C08 keys/copies/restore and external adapter capture.
TrustLoader-observed input set replaces producer-selected citations. Unknown hidden native context disqualifies protected use. Text is protected by default and numeric/relationship metadata can be sensitive; primary sources have interests and applicability limits, not universal truth.
PermissionsFilter principal/purpose/recipient before metadata/search results; persist plaintext only on a field-specific admitted allowlist. Protected lexical scan/index is bounded in memory without plaintext cache/spill; validation occurs before encryption and persistent GroupBody/JSONB/WAL/logs cannot accidentally copy plaintext.
FailureIncomplete closure/index/source coverage yields explicit restricted/incomplete use; late invalidated output cannot become active. Preserve originals and contrary evidence within access; unknown provider-held copies or retained plaintext linkage keep deletion incomplete instead of claiming crypto-erasure solved it.
ObservabilitySource access/publication/version/interest/confidence/review dates, unsupported/unsearched/inaccessible distinctions, source/closure frontiers, omitted required context, stale dependency backlog, retrieval/use error, copy/key holders, deletion residuals and maintenance/attention cost.
EvaluationCA-C05: useful permitted lexical retrieval plus correction uptake; private snippet/title/count cannot leak; deletion races late summary and restore; short salary/health/linkage fixtures leave no unintended plaintext in GroupBody/WAL/index/log/backup; continued permitted search must succeed.
ScalingTyped exact refs narrow scope before lexical search. Initial 20 metadata candidates/eight chunks per step and finite scan byte/time/memory; expose unexamined corpus rather than feed all history. Vector/graph products require measured advantage and reviewed permission/deletion mapping.
VersionPin parser/language/chunk/ranking/transformation/source/meaning and storage-classification versions; changed or overdue source reliance invalidates dependent current claims even without software upgrade. SC-POLICY-1 metadata/recheck inheritance applies to relied-on substrate claims.
ReplacementExport authorized originals/ciphertext/keys, exact lineage/corrections/contradictions/retention/restriction epochs and omissions; rebuild a qualified index/loader at a verified complete frontier, fence old loaders and reauthorize live sessions before use.
RemovalRetire redundant indexes/summaries by dependency inventory; retain necessary source/duty evidence lawfully. Deletion closes/fences current holders, handles derived/export/backup/provider copies and records residuals until actual purge/expiry/key conditions hold; removal cannot erase accountability or resurrect an obsolete correction.

sections.heading: S1-C06 — Evidence and acceptance
sections.html:
S1-C06 — Evidence and acceptance

DESIGN PROPOSAL. Planned primary module: system/packages/evidence. Contract anchors: 2. Logical component and deployment interfaces, 3. Repository and process implementation target, 5. Protected evidence and account reconstruction, 6. Evaluation contracts at every level.

AttributeContract
PurposeProduce a truthful bounded account and independent scoped assessment of outcomes, processes and required prerequisites, including useful success and failure.
ResponsibilityProtect capture/selection from evaluated producers, maintain full transitive EvidenceBaseVersion, run competent independent evaluations and controls, record canonical EvidenceJudgment states, preserve disagreements/omissions and reconstruct company accounts without fabricated causation.
NonresponsibilityDoes not issue grants/releases, choose legitimate values, infer truth from signatures/model agreement, create professional competence or turn accepted uncertainty reports into accepted products. It cannot independently accept its own evaluator change.
OwnerAccepted evidence/acceptance ResponsibilityAssignment with actual competent assessor for each predicate, separate authority from the evaluated producer and declared shared roots/conflicts. An evaluator model or second account is not automatically independent.
InterfacesProtected capture and evidence commands; evaluation.* and scoped Review/EvaluationPlan/Run; supplies exact current judgments/bindings to C01/C02/C04/C07 and reconstructed accounts to C09; source dependency invalidation joins C05/C08.
InputsExact subject/version/predicate and independently admitted requirements manifest, protected raw observations, parser/measurement/selection/denominator/evaluator/label/acceptance dependencies, population and omissions, current source/access/authority, competent judging rule and finite budget.
OutputsAttributable findings/limitations, canonical accepted/rejected/inconclusive/contested/stale/withdrawn judgments, current EvidenceBaseVersion and exact JudgmentBinding arrays, observed cost/outcomes and permission-filtered account reconstruction. Review completion is not acceptance of its subject.
StateEvidenceJudgment proposed is unfinished; completed inconclusive does not establish the predicate; contested is canonical for disputed presentation. Evaluation plans/runs/reviews and captured evidence retain exact revisions; no standalone Evaluation pass or mutable aggregate success may bypass current child predicates.
LifecycleFreeze plan/requirements before outcomes → protected capture of all selected attempts → independent scoped assessment → current accepted use or rejection/uncertainty → stale/contested/withdrawn on changed dependencies → reasoned reassessment revision. Launch assembly is a complete requirement-ID join, not self-evidence.
DependenciesC05 current full lineage/epochs; C08 durable protected captures/keys/frontiers; C04 authority and protected evaluator policy; C07 actual assessor competence/rights; C03 reports and native observations are inputs, not proof; C01 actual values determine legitimate criterion domains.
TrustIndependence covers capture, parser, schema, normalization, sample/test selection, labels, denominator, evaluator and acceptance rule, including shared roots/incentives. Primary docs/author reports provide scoped source evidence only; known hidden provider reasoning is not claimed observable.
PermissionsCapture/selection/expected answers/evaluator activation sit outside evaluated producer write authority. Reviewers receive only relevant permitted evidence; model output cannot mutate evidence history or sign its own gate. Current exact subject/predicate/expiry/authority guards apply at downstream release.
FailureMissing original/attempt/coverage or inadequate power produces limited/inconclusive evidence; corruption invalidates dependent use before release. Preserve conflicting findings and obtain a discriminating test or legitimate decision; do not average incompatible meanings or silently drop adverse cases.
ObservabilitySelected/attempted/failed/refused/missing denominators, native capture gaps, shared roots, current predicate bindings, stale judgments, false acceptance/refusal controls, reviewer duration/cost, endpoint/stratum uncertainty and source/claim review age.
EvaluationCA-C06: independently held known-defect and clean controls catch always-pass/always-reject judges; mutate a shared parser/denominator with producer bytes unchanged; accepted uncertainty report fails launch; distinct valid product/delivery/support judgments satisfy the complete manifest and allow useful launch.
ScalingBound evaluation populations and use the cheapest valid discriminating evidence; reserve reviewer/professional/owner time and protected controls. Diagnostic five-trial cases and IB matched trial defaults serve different claims; no universal sample count or model panel replaces task-specific power/dependence analysis.
VersionFreeze exact plan/subject/baseline/selection/evaluator/metric/label versions, bridge changed populations and preserve old results. Changing checks/requirements is a ProtectedChange; source maintenance can reopen evidence without package change. Revision cannot rewrite a prior conclusion.
ReplacementIndependent successor qualifies on known defects, clean cases and account reconstruction; transfer source/denominator/dependency history and current judgments, invalidate unsupported carryover and keep one accountable acceptance rule per scope during cutover.
RemovalRetire an evaluator/check only through protected authority with coverage/replacement evidence and retained dissent. Preserve still-required captures/judgments and current deletion obligations; a missing required independent assessor blocks dependent acceptance, not unrelated valid work.

sections.heading: S1-C07 — Human and external responsibility interface
sections.html:
S1-C07 — Human and external responsibility interface

DESIGN PROPOSAL. Planned primary module: system/packages/company/human. Contract anchors: 2. Logical component and deployment interfaces, 3. Repository and process implementation target, Human records and command contract, 4. Communication and independent continuity.

AttributeContract
PurposeEnsure real people can exercise legitimate judgment, obtain competent service and rights progress, and remain accountable within actual attention and standing limits.
ResponsibilityPrepare exact DecisionPackets, obtain attributable current responses, arrange accepted competent human/professional/manual performance, preserve founder values/taste, participation/competence protocol, grievance/rights handling, continuity, handoff and departure with actual custody.
NonresponsibilityCannot manufacture lawful standing, diagnosis, professional expertise, founder consent, always-available substitutes or liability allocation; a record, warning or prepared professional packet is not fulfilled service or a new Grant.
OwnerActual accepted human/service ResponsibilityAssignment for each deciding/performance/rights domain, with Principal/Mandate/AuthorityMatrix, scoped competence and accepted alternate. Real names/jurisdiction/engagement/funding remain admission data; no synthetic C-suite role supplies them.
Interfaceshuman.decision.answer/evidence.challenge/intervention.request/participation.respond/mandate.accept/handoff.accept/departure.request and company work/intake commands; IC-HUMAN and independent Fastmail/public grievance route; exact C09 views and C04 authority validation.
InputsExact decision/action/subject/predicate versions, alternatives/contrary evidence/uncertainty/latest time/no-answer rule, actual actor identity/standing/competence, consented ParticipationPlan, accepted performer availability/fees/access and surviving duties.
OutputsHumanResponse/DecisionRecord, actual professional or manual performance evidence, accepted HandoffAcceptance/ResponsibilityAssignment, scoped incapacity and real alternate route, grievance disposition/remedy progress and consented participation coverage; no false approval from silence.
StateDecisionPacket draft/ready/presented/answered/expired/superseded/conflicted; response recorded/invalidated and domain service/grievance/participation states. ActorBinding and OperatorProjection are derived views; continued duty ownership survives a failed handoff.
LifecycleQualify standing/need → prepare inspectable packet or service handoff → deliberate acceptance/response/performance → independently assess exact outcome → maintain actual response/competence/availability → accepted succession or departure with duties/access settled.
DependenciesC01 actual values and deciding rules; C04 current auth/grants/effects; C05 permitted originals; C06 competent independent assessment; C02 deadlines/attention scheduling; C08 independent continuity/current recovery; actual professional/custodian/provider arrangements.
TrustAuthenticated person controls only their legitimate domain. Lawful approval does not imply specialist competence; decline/nonresponse does not diagnose incapacity. Independent grievance recipient must be reachable without permission from the actor complained about and not solely through failed A login.
PermissionsCurrent actor/packet/subject validation on every response, WebAuthn where required, access only to needed original evidence, no offline approvals. Consent and retention constrain assessment data; secret personality/health/general-intelligence profiling and unrelated monitoring are excluded.
FailureNo answer follows the recorded bounded fallback, accepted substitute or wait; existing duties remain assigned. Missing professional/access/capacity blocks new dependent exposure and triggers actual continuity/renegotiation or accountable failure. Founder values authority remains while specific competence prerequisites restrict affected acts.
ObservabilityPacket age/changed terms, response windows, actual service/alternate acknowledgement, grievance/remedy deadlines, unmet competence predicates, attention minutes/interrupts, participation omissions and emotional burden with consent; request/stop/fence/cessation/settlement remain separate.
EvaluationCA-C07: a legitimate routine decision succeeds within cap; stale phone/double response cannot approve changed terms; absent founder plus provider outage still obtains actual due service through accepted alternate; affected person reaches independent grievance route; competence misunderstanding changes only the relevant action path.
ScalingAdmit work at actual human/professional/attention capacity, batch equivalent decision needs without merging rights and reduce new commitments before overload. One-person staffing is allowed only within demonstrated capacity; hiring or agent fan-out does not create unaccepted substitute service.
VersionAuthorityMatrix/ParticipationPlan/interaction/retention/service contracts pin exact versions and legitimate amendment routes. Preserve original personal values/taste and reasons; practice cadence and competence thresholds require consented evidence, not inferred universal doses.
ReplacementSuccessor/alternate accepts exact scope, duties, access, competence, availability and fees; exercise actual route before dependent promises. Transfer acknowledgments differ from receipt, preserve old custodian for unresolved scope and revalidate current authority.
RemovalOn departure stop assignments, transfer accepted duties, settle actual worker/professional obligations, revoke native access/descendants and give permitted export. Keep legitimate grievance/retention duties until actual disposition; removing a person's UI account does not end liability or erase owed service.

sections.heading: S1-C08 — Recovery and continuity
sections.html:
S1-C08 — Recovery and continuity

DESIGN PROPOSAL. Planned primary module: system/packages/authority/recovery. Contract anchors: 2. Logical component and deployment interfaces, 3. Repository and process implementation target, 11. Outbox, membership, fencing and restore, 12. Keys, native descendants, deletion and backup handling.

AttributeContract
PurposeRecover complete authoritative consequences and current restrictions across declared loss/absence boundaries while preserving actual duties and useful continuation.
ResponsibilityIndependently witness complete groups/blobs/keys, persist receipt/frontier and membership, handle lost acknowledgments and fenced generations, reconcile unknown effects/native descendants, manage backup/restore/key/deletion inventory and accepted continuity with C07.
NonresponsibilityDoes not become a departmental grant issuer, infer missing records from old snapshots, turn a signature into truth, claim independent admin roots from local processes or guarantee instant external cancellation/physical erasure/provider availability.
OwnerActual accepted R/recovery custodian and alternate, with independent account/admin/MFA/billing/recovery control relative to A as required by the fault model; actual identity/availability/fees and exercised access are admission evidence. G shares R host/admin/load root explicitly.
InterfacesR complete-group witness and keyed receipt/status lookup, fresh signed RecoveryFrontier response, authorized generation/recovery and native reconciliation interfaces; C04 SendAuthorizationBundle joins existing proof; C07 accepted continuity and C09 status surface.
InputsExact canonical GroupBody plus full blob/key manifests and predecessor/generation/sequence, current independent membership/frontier nonce, revocations/unknown holds/potential duties/leases/deletion/descendant indexes, protected native observations and accepted substitute standing.
OutputsDurabilityReceipt and signed current frontier/recovery response values, authoritative recovered references and reconciliation evidence, continuing restrictions and accepted Continuation. Historical frontier snapshots are Observation artifacts; signed values are not invented Ref targets or future self-hashes.
StateHot standby plus separate writable witness PostgreSQL ledger, detached receipt/signature index, current membership/frontier, blob/key and access/deletion inventories. D0/D1 local material remains separately staged; complete proof never comes from A's own ahead-of-witness row.
LifecycleAdmit independent roots/replica/keys → witness exact complete group before authority response → monitor frontier and copies → fence on loss/revoke → reconcile current independent frontier and unknowns → restore isolated generation → activate only with current membership/restrictions; retire old roots after obligations/copies accounted.
DependenciesPg durability/replication plus separate writable witness, actual R signing/encryption custody, C04 serial operation scope/gates, C05 current lineage/deletion, C06 protected native evidence, C07 real custodians/continuity, G admitted time/network and backup/provider account access.
TrustA and R accounts/regions require actual distinct recovery roots; AWS common provider failure and admitted root compromise are bounded exclusions. Software Ed25519/AES key custody is explicit, not HSM-backed proof. Local tests cannot establish administrator or human absence independence.
PermissionsOnly admitted witness reads replicated groups and writes its own receipt ledger; signer cannot invent missing content. Protected recovery actor changes membership/generation under exact current rules; ordinary workers cannot read keys, promote standby, delete audit/copies or reactivate old peers.
FailureLost ack recovers exact durable receipt without new authority; missing group/blob/key or stale frontier fails dependent activation. Witness outage still permits D1 save/export and surviving bounded local work. Unknown native effect retains hold and due work; restore never reintroduces deleted/revoked authority.
ObservabilityReplica replay/current snapshot, complete group/hash/frontier, receipt signing/lookup, key/blob gaps, backup/restore age, measured RPO/RTO, membership/boot/time changes, unknown effects, residual native access/deletion and actual custodian response/renewal readiness.
EvaluationCA-C08: primary plus its backup destruction, witness local-commit/sign/ack crashes, stale restore/revocation, missing blob/key, R/G load and native descendant revocation; valid recovery completes with current restrictions and actual due-service continuity. Independent host/admin tests require real separate roots.
ScalingDurable A/R placements plus ephemeral N/X jobs and a budgeted trusted restore worker; G and R share a load/fault root. One unconfirmed group/company initially; measure complete-envelope/blob throughput and restoration before sizing growth. Never relax remote proof or split issuers to hide saturation.
VersionReceipt/frontier/proof/group/key/membership formats and clocks are protected protocol versions. Signed receipt fields cannot contain future signatures/self-hashes. Restore/schema/meaning migration uses current restriction indexes, forward T-R1 scope accounting and explicit compatible versions.
ReplacementObtain fresh independently witnessed recovery inventory, fence old generation/peers/keys, validate replacement replica/signer/clock/custodian, map all released/unknown scopes and activate new membership. Old signed snapshots cannot authorize takeover by themselves.
RemovalTerminate old generations only after current successor custody, proof/key/blob retention and native access/resource/subscription removal are observed. Record remaining provider/backup copies and legal duties; inability to erase or enumerate keeps residual status open.

sections.heading: S1-C09 — Operator surfaces

S1-C09 — Operator surfaces

DESIGN PROPOSAL. Planned primary module: system/apps/operator. Contract anchors: 2. Logical component and deployment interfaces, 3. Repository and process implementation target, Surfaces derived from operator jobs, Complete terminal and coding interaction.

AttributeContract
PurposeLet authorized people understand current company reality, inspect original evidence and exercise meaningful control without misleading completion or hidden burden.
ResponsibilityDeliver account/decisions/ventures/work/evidence/capacity/people/requests/continuity/terminal views, permission-filtered source watermarks and accessible mobile/keyboard interactions; submit exact current commands and display five stop/effect phases separately.
NonresponsibilityDoes not own upstream truth, auth/standing, grant/release, evidence acceptance, current provider quota or customer duty discharge. It cannot make stale cached state authoritative, invent missing source completeness or diagnose a person's competence from nonparticipation.
OwnerActual accepted operator-product ResponsibilityAssignment with legitimate user/taste owner for interaction criteria, plus independent accessibility/evidence assessment. Backend security and upstream component owners remain responsible for their enforcement; UI designer cannot waive them.
InterfacesGET /v1/records/{id}?revision={n}, POST /v1/queries, authorized events, command/status/operation/health endpoints and D1 staging/export; all authoritative mutations return through POST /v1/commands and exact domain payloads, never browser-side authority.
InputsCurrent actor scope and actual Principal/Mandate/IdentityBinding, witnessed Position, source watermarks/omissions, exact decision/operation/work/evidence refs, current restrictions, allowed original content and user-selected participation preferences.
OutputsAccessible permission-filtered projections, typed command requests and explicit conflict/pending/unknown/error states; Server-confirmed local staging returns StageRef; an offline browser draft has no StageRef or accepted-decision status until the staging service actually saves it. A rendered successful-looking surface never manufactures an authoritative completion flag.
StateDerived OperatorProjection/ActorBinding and permitted local draft/view state only. ProjectionMetadata records committed_position/source_watermarks/generated_at/omissions; status can be stale/incomplete/unknown, and OperationStatus remains an observation/projection, not a send token.
LifecycleAuthenticate/resolve scope → load admitted projection → inspect originals/terms → submit exact deliberate command → display stable business/proof/current-status response; disconnect marks last observed, stale revisions force refresh and new decision; logout/revoke removes current access and handles retained drafts.
DependenciesC01…C08 exact read/command/status semantics, Keycloak current authentication, C05 pre-retrieval filtering and permitted evidence, C07 understandable deciding/service pathways, independent continuity channel and actual browser/accessibility support.
TrustBrowser/client state and caller-supplied actor fields are untrusted; backend enforces all mutations and filtered retrieval. A conversation, terminal skin, animation, cached summary or HTTP receipt is not proof of stopped work, released action or fulfilled service.
PermissionsOnly current authorized projections and registered commands. No arbitrary SQL/filesystem path, offline approvals, cross-principal snippets/counts or swipe/default-approved material terms. Technical shell stays behind admitted N/X mediation, not unrestricted browser access to production.
FailureNetwork loss preserves safe local drafts and shows unknown request outcome; same-command lookup reconciles. Missing feed never becomes zero activity; inaccessible originals show limited reconstruction. Independent public/grievance route remains discoverable, and complex phone decisions defer rather than omit terms.
ObservabilityProjection/source age and omissions, command/status errors, stale decision conflicts, accessibility task failures, actual decision/attention latency and source-check path. Exclude sensitive content from telemetry and retain uncertainty when native feeds lag.
EvaluationCA-C09: valid keyboard/mobile decision and useful terminal continuation succeed; stale changed-amount packet, lost/double submission, actor switch, hidden missing source, inaccessible original and unknown stop do not mislead. Human task/accessibility tests supplement deterministic browser checks.
ScalingServe bounded filtered pages/events and cached derived views with current access; no model summary blocks first display of duties/stop controls. Initial latency targets L/N/D require reference workload measurement; load cannot authorize stale data or leak aggregate existence.
VersionPin React/Hono/Vite/client schema and exact view/selection/meaning versions in release manifest. UI changes that alter consequential interpretation are ProtectedChanges with current contract/accessibility regression; wire compatibility alone is insufficient.
ReplacementNew surface consumes the same canonical clients/commands and passes exact-term/accessibility/unknown-state tests; migrate permitted draft/view preferences with consent, retain portable terminal continuations and retire old session/client credentials without a second writer.
RemovalRemove obsolete screens, local caches/drafts and client sessions under retention policy; preserve usable replacement control/evidence/grievance access and open obligations. Deleting a dashboard is not deleting authoritative evidence or withdrawing another person's rights.

sections.heading: FI-12: exact subject revisions and acceptance
sections.html:
FI-12: exact subject revisions and acceptance

INFERENCE. The existing documents combine exact subject-version judgments with mutable records whose state and acceptance-reference fields belong to the same revision. A normal sequence exposes a join conflict: a ProductSpec at revision 7 is assessed, then changing its state from proposed to validated produces revision 8. A judgment of revision 7 cannot authorize revision 8. Adding an output acceptance reference to the subject has the same problem. Quietly ignoring state, comparing a subset of fields, accepting a future record or weakening exact-version matching would contradict the stated authority contract.

DECISION. CS1 selects immutable business revisions with separately versioned authoritative lifecycle decisions. A business revision is recorded before it is assessed. Its bytes and exact Ref never change. The result of assessment, admission, execution progress or closure changes a LifecycleStatus that refers to that exact business revision. Output links to the judgment that decides the subject belong to that status. Input evidence that the subject itself asserts remains in the business payload.

SPECIFICATION. This is a change to the drafted representation, not a discovery that the old runtime failed; no such runtime exists. Preserving the old drafts is not the reason for the choice. The chosen mechanism removes a repeated coordination operation from ordinary acceptance while keeping exact content identity and authoritative state transitions.

DESIGN PROPOSAL. The strongest alternative is an atomic candidate-postimage and judgment group. It can avoid a future-proof cycle: preallocate all record/event refs, freeze the complete candidate including business and state fields, independently assess those exact bytes, obtain final evaluator and owner endorsements of the same digest, recheck prior state/current mandates/epochs, and commit only the complete declared group. Captured performance evidence must precede the group; references cannot mean arbitrary optimistic future records. Editing any candidate byte invalidates review, and a group cannot manufacture a native effect or exempt a C04/C08 guard.

DECISION. That alternative is technically plausible, but it requires a preparation protocol, full-group review, final digest endorsements and edit-after-review recovery for ordinary acceptance. Composite launches amplify that labor. Late links to actual responses/reasons have to be prepared without smuggling assumptions into the frozen group. The immutable-revision solution instead records a proposed subject, evaluates it, then records the disposition. Its main cost is a second authoritative head and explicit joins on current lifecycle. The migration is broader but mechanical and auditable. Independent assessment must challenge that cost comparison and the correctness of the selected joins; author preference does not establish closure.

sections.heading: Two identities, one current interpretation
sections.html:
Two identities, one current interpretation

SPECIFICATION. Ref<T> remains {record_id, record_type, revision}. Revision is the existing canonical nonzero unsigned decimal string. A reference never means “latest.” A Ref<ProductSpec> identifies immutable business content. A Ref<LifecycleStatus> identifies one immutable decision about that content. These are different record types, not two meanings for the same reference.

SPECIFICATION. The version 2.0 business envelope retains the exact kernel identity, company/principal, owner assignment, schema version, creation/last event refs, recorded/effective times, access and retention policies, and provenance. It removes state. All payload and envelope fields remain immutable for that business revision. last_event_id means the event that recorded those immutable bytes; it is not backfilled on a later lifecycle transition. The lifecycle event has its own identifier. Owner, policy or payload changes create a new business revision and are not hidden metadata edits.

SPECIFICATION. A LifecycleStatus has the common immutable envelope and this closed payload:

Every row below is SPECIFICATION; a cell states its own kind where it differs.

FieldExact meaning

phaseThe finite lifecycle enum registered for that subject type.

entered_event_id, entered_atActual transition event and recorded time. These do not contain the event's future transaction proof.
reason_refAttributed reason for this transition.
supporting_judgment_refsExact C06 judgments used by the registered transition predicate. An arbitrary report judgment is insufficient.
decision_refs, response_refsActual competent decisions and authenticated responses supporting this transition.
continuation_refOptional exact continuation required when unresolved work/duties persist.
prior_status_refPrevious lifecycle decision for this same exact subject, absent only at initialization.

SPECIFICATION. The database has one constrained business head per (company_id, record_id) and one constrained lifecycle head per exact business Ref. Every revision behind either head remains immutable. LifecycleStatus is an intrinsic control fact: it has no lifecycle record of its own and requires no judgment accepting itself. Its validity follows from the authorized command, exact edge guard, transaction and independent durability. Immutable event bodies, reason records and witness receipts similarly have intrinsic representations. They do not generate an infinite status or acceptance chain.

SPECIFICATION. A lifecycle head is authoritative control state maintained by the subject's responsible component through the kernel. A UI projection is disposable. Rebuilding a projection cannot move a business or lifecycle head, restore an old accepted phase, clear a live restriction, or produce durability proof. C09 renders the joined state and its watermark; it cannot author the join.

sections.heading: Ordinary acceptance and change
sections.html:
Ordinary acceptance and change

SPECIFICATION. A producer first records the complete proposed business revision. Required inputs may be honest unknown values where the capability permits uncertainty. For example, a provisional price need not invent demand, and preparatory interview research does not need an Offer or product delivery capacity. Its own actual contact/privacy/interviewer/response requirements still apply. Recording the revision does not make its output acceptable or authorize effects.

SPECIFICATION. An evaluator receives that exact immutable revision, an independently admitted criterion, the actual evidence base and its current source/meaning/selection/denominator/evaluator closure. The evaluator's EvidenceJudgment body is also recorded as immutable proposed content. Its predicate, subject, evidence, limitations and reason are fixed before C06 decides its lifecycle. C06 may mark the judgment accepted, rejected, inconclusive or contested under the kernel distinctions. The judgment itself cannot be in its own supporting evidence graph.

SPECIFICATION. The domain owner then requests a lifecycle transition of the already recorded subject. The kernel checks the exact current subject head, exact current judgment and judgment lifecycle, exact predicate and arguments, competence/mandates, scope, expiry, and complete live dependency closure. If they satisfy the registered subject edge, it writes the new LifecycleStatus, its output judgment link and the transition event in one ordered group. The business Ref stays unchanged.

SPECIFICATION. For the example above, revision 7 remains revision 7 when validated. Its validation status refers to a judgment of precisely revision 7. If a producer changes one requirement, policy, input child judgment binding or owner assignment, that is revision 8. Its lifecycle initializes as proposed; the revision-7 judgment remains historical and cannot accept revision 8. If a field represents a fact already fixed by a prior event, model that immutable fact explicitly and refer to it; do not declare all later content edits harmless.

SPECIFICATION. A correction to a judgment's predicate, source set or reason is a new judgment business revision. Contestation, staleness and withdrawal are separate lifecycle decisions with their own reasons and evidence. An accepted judgment can later become stale or contested without rewriting its original body. Reassessment can create a successor judgment revision or record as the source contract permits. A completed inconclusive assessment remains distinct from an unfinished proposed assessment, a rejected subject and contested evidence. “Disputed” is a presentation of contested evidence only where that binding is explicit.

sections.heading: Input links, output links and composite launch
sections.html:
Input links, output links and composite launch

SPECIFICATION. Moving every judgment-shaped field would be wrong. A LaunchReadiness.acceptance_bindings collection asserts required child evidence and remains immutable payload. It is evaluated against the exact admitted, predeclared launch-requirements configuration. A one-to-one mapping must cover every unique requirement ID with the exact subject revision, predicate configuration and arguments, scope and acceptance owner. Different product, formation, delivery and support subjects can have distinct judgments. A missing, duplicate, wrong, stale or incomplete child fails the launch criterion. An accepted uncertainty report cannot substitute for a delivery or product predicate.

SPECIFICATION. The judgment that decides that assembled LaunchReadiness is an output disposition and belongs to its lifecycle status. It does not appear as a child of itself. Composite children are already recorded immutable revisions with current accepted judgments; there is no need for a self-referential future launch group. Structural backlinks are permitted only as typed relationships. Evidence, authority and work-dependency cycles cannot support themselves.

SPECIFICATION. Output acceptance fields moved to typed lifecycle links include Case.acceptance_judgment_ref, WorkOrder.acceptance_judgment_ref, WorkflowRun.acceptance_judgment_ref, StepExecution.judgment_ref, artifact validation judgments, transformation judgments, fulfillment and recovery-packet acceptance, obligation discharge/transfer judgments, and operation/attempt/claim/reservation reconciliation judgments. The registry enumerates every field migration. Existing input judgments for an evaluated child, actual exercise, demand assertion or independently observed prerequisite stay input fields unless a specific migration says otherwise.

SPECIFICATION. The same distinction resolves Handoff. A Continuation preserves exact partial work and context. Successful transfer additionally joins the current accepted responsibility assignment, actual recipient acknowledgment and HandoffAcceptance in the appropriate output lifecycle links. Delivery of a message cannot perform that join. Budget is a value binding of concrete ResourceAccount and Reservation refs. Evaluation is a value binding of role-specific plan, run, trial and judgment refs. Neither becomes a new spendable or accepting record.

sections.heading: Atomicity, invalidation and current reads
sections.html:
Atomicity, invalidation and current reads

SPECIFICATION. Lifecycle transition CAS includes the exact business head, prior lifecycle head, judgment business and lifecycle heads, current authority/meaning/configuration heads, and complete live restriction epochs relevant to the predicate. A business edit CASes the same business head and records its new initial lifecycle in that transaction. Therefore an edit and acceptance cannot both claim the same current subject under inconsistent assumptions.

SPECIFICATION. If acceptance commits first, a subsequent business edit initializes a new unaccepted revision and invalidates dependent current use. If the edit commits first, acceptance of the old revision conflicts. Neither branch silently applies the old judgment to the new bytes. An acceptance command retry with the same ID returns its stable original result; a new command must reread current refs.

SPECIFICATION. The dependency graph distinguishes content edges from lifecycle-decision edges. Evaluations of immutable content depend on the exact content, sources and criteria they actually assessed. They do not depend on their own eventual acceptance phase. When a predicate explicitly requires a prerequisite to remain admitted/accepted, its evidence closure includes that prerequisite's exact lifecycle decision plus current restriction epoch. A later stale/contested/restricted status invalidates dependent current use even though the underlying business bytes remain unchanged.

SPECIFICATION. C04 reads current business heads, lifecycle heads, admitted predicates, dependency closure and live epochs in the same current-check transaction that orders release against restrictions and competing consequences. Index cleanup and UI refresh may lag; these are not authority barriers. A cached old accepted status is historical evidence only. False or unresolved predicates deny the dependent transition and preserve surviving duties, holds, reasons and accessible complaint intake.

SPECIFICATION. The normal kernel rule that new referenced records may be present in the same complete transaction still applies to structural bookkeeping, such as a status and its event. It does not permit evaluating an unrecorded future business subject. Evidence judgment subjects and their actual supporting performance evidence must precede their deciding lifecycle transaction. This is the boundary that removes the candidate-group alternative from normal acceptance.

Registration and transition routing

SPECIFICATION. The machine registry is the closed set of record/value types, command payloads, predicates, phase enums and legal edges. No command accepts an arbitrary record name or arbitrary JSON object as authority. Reusable registration/revision commands dispatch to the registered type owner and guards; they do not let C02 write another component's protected records.

SPECIFICATION. kernel.record.register creates only the registered initial business revision and initial phase. Intrinsic authority facts have exclusive factories: a release is created only by the release handler, a send claim only by the attempt-claim handler, a witness receipt only by R, an event only by the commit builder, and a lifecycle decision only by its authorized transition handler. A producer cannot register a preaccepted subject or add an accepted output link.

SPECIFICATION. kernel.record.revise takes an exact prior ref and a closed typed payload. It creates a successor immutable business revision, records why it changed, initializes its phase, and invalidates dependent current acceptance. Authority-sensitive revisions additionally require the appropriate protected-change, mandate and migration contracts. Material revision is not an implicit renewal, reservation reset, ownership transfer or permission enlargement.

SPECIFICATION. kernel.record.transition takes the exact subject, target phase, typed output links, reason, actual evidence/decisions and any required protected-change ref. It cannot change business payload. Source commands such as work.run.advance, human.handoff.accept and authority.operation.reconcile remain specialized entries to the same exact per-edge predicates and component responsibility. A generic name is not a bypass. Commands authenticate the actor from transport, reject type mismatches, use exact expected revisions and keep stable duplicate results.

SPECIFICATION. Public query responses return immutable business content and the exact current lifecycle ref/phase separately, with source Position, freshness and omissions. The wire envelope remains permission-filtered. A historical request labels both historical content and historical status; it never supplies a latest alias for an authority check. D1 staging continues to use StageRef, including explicit local durability and expiry. A browser draft is not a StageRef until actually staged, and neither is a witnessed record Ref.

sections.heading: Predicate runtime boundary
sections.html:
Predicate runtime boundary

SPECIFICATION. A TypedPredicate is an exact registered ID, version and closed argument object. The registry contains its typed arguments, pure expression, component owner, source contract, failure behavior and planned implementation module. Unregistered IDs, missing arguments, implicit coercion, unknown record types and recursive predicate call graphs fail validation. A string describing a desirable result is not an executable predicate.

SPECIFICATION. Common functions handle exact comparison, field lookup, finite sets, decimal arithmetic, ref/lifecycle resolution and graph traversal. Per-edge programs bind the actual subject type, from/to phases, permitted commands, current owner, relevant criterion, event basis and duty disposition. Readiness uses the corresponding subject-specific criterion; expiry needs actual deadline evidence; restrictive action preserves duties; external settlement needs exact native correlation. The 373 earlier work-catalog edge delegates are inputs to this expansion, not evidence that their guards were already complete.

IMPLEMENTATION DISCOVERY. **"Uses the criterion" means an op: "call", and that is checked.** This paragraph claimed the criterion was used while criterion_id was named on every edge and evaluated by no guard — op: "call" occurred zero times in any edge program, and the whole criterion.* family was unreachable. An edge guard now calls its own criterion_id, passing exactly the arguments that criterion declares, and the criterion is the sole home of target-phase content: it reads judgment_refs through accepted_for against its own id, so a judgment accepted for one criterion cannot license a different transition. validate_contracts.py fails an edge that does not call its criterion, and fails any predicate declaring an argument nothing transitively reads. UNKNOWN. What remains open is CONTENT, not mechanism: for 167 of 173 records the source corpus states no per-phase evidence requirement, so two criteria of one record can still differ only by the criterion a judgment must name. Measure it with contracts/tools/guard_distinctness.py; do not take this paragraph's word for it.

SPECIFICATION. Some propositions require the world: whether a service was delivered, a human understood a transfer, a professional is competent for an activity, a customer accepted terms, or a tested runtime actually enforces egress. These enter through typed protected observations under a named actual performer/assessor and admitted method. The predicate checks source/capture identity, exact subject and arguments, applicable competence/mandate, freshness, actual inputs, independent evaluator roots, completeness and observed result. It cannot make the underlying fact true. A model may propose an assessment; it does not mint a competent professional's standing.

SPECIFICATION. The conformance interpreter exercises the specified pure logic and synthetic trusted-input boundary. Production collectors, signatures, clock/egress mechanisms and physical competence checks remain implementation and operating obligations. Unsupported boundary inputs return unresolved; tests cannot fill them with a default true. Source claims, negative results and uncertainty are retained under SC-POLICY-1.

sections.heading: Bootstrap and competent acceptance
sections.html:
Bootstrap and competent acceptance

SPECIFICATION. Bootstrap is a finite, narrow protocol with an external human trust boundary. The actual founder/root custodian authenticates a preparatory company namespace, original intent material, initial identities, scoped mandates/assignments, access/retention policies and actual key/witness custodians. The exact initial group and scope are signed by the admitted root identities. Structural crossrefs are permitted inside that complete group; no bootstrap record proves its own real legal registration, bank balance, professional qualification or provider capacity.

SPECIFICATION. The first lifecycle heads follow from this one initialization command and its verified root authorization, not recursively from accepted lifecycle records. The initial grant set permits only the declared preparatory scope. It provides no ungranted spending, publishing, contacting, private disclosure or professional engagement. A legal entity can remain an asserted principal with its formation unknown. Preparatory investigation can proceed with honest unknowns where its actual activity prerequisites permit it.

SPECIFICATION. A first evaluator cannot be admitted by an infinite chain of model evaluators. evidence.bootstrap binds an actual competent human assessor and independently accountable custodian to a narrowly described evaluation scope, their actual identity/standing/competence evidence, exact method, source captures and accepted responsibility. IMPLEMENTATION DISCOVERY: This section described that binding while no predicate implemented it: bootstrap_roots was defined in the primitive registry and invoked by zero of 2252 predicates, and nothing named evidence.bootstrap existed in any registry, so mandate acceptance required an accepted assessor mandate with no terminator. It is now evidence.bootstrap.<Record>.v1, registered for each of the nine criteria the chain walk returns as ungrounded, offered as a disjunct beside the derived path so acceptance is either out of band at the root or derived and never neither. contracts/tools/acceptance_chain.py walks the chain from criterion.Mandate.accepted.v1 and the validator fails if it does not terminate. The genesis group is the signed BootstrapCandidate set that BootstrapAuthorization covers — there is no separate genesis record type, because membership of that signed group is the distinction. UNKNOWN. Who the founder and root custodian actually are is a deployment prerequisite and is supplied by no contract in this repository. The root decision admits that evaluator for the named scope after the person actually accepts. A same-person configuration records the common root and cannot satisfy a predicate requiring independent review. If independent competent review is required but unavailable, that acceptance path is unavailable; low-consequence preparatory work may continue within its own authorized scope.

SPECIFICATION. Later evaluator admission uses the ordinary calibration, negative-control, false-accept/reject and drift contracts. Root admission is not a permanent exemption or a route to professional standing. Expired competence, source restrictions, departure or common-failure discovery invalidates dependent use. Actual owner values decisions remain with the owner; a competence gap routes assistance or narrows operations instead of replacing personal preferences with model rankings.

sections.heading: Storage, retention and historical interpretation
sections.html:
Storage, retention and historical interpretation

SPECIFICATION. The removal of inline state does not relax 06's protected-storage rule. Classification is independent of size and primitive type. Titles, reasons and short human/model strings are protected by default. IDs, salaries, enums and relationships may also be personal or confidential. The exact field storage registry names permitted plaintext metadata only after sensitivity and purpose assessment.

SPECIFICATION. Protected canonical business and lifecycle bytes are encrypted before any GroupBody, JSONB, WAL, event/log, index, cache or backup plaintext duplicate is made. Necessary plaintext routing/projection fields require an explicit copy-class retention/deletion policy; they may keep deletion incomplete until genuine purge or authorized expiry. Encrypted blobs and control references retain exact hashes and key manifests without retaining accidental plaintext proofs. Smallness is never permission to persist cleartext.

SPECIFICATION. Current access and deletion restrictions filter historical reads too. Continuing DeletionScope covers late derivatives, offline copies and rejoin, while receipts state residual retention and unknown copies. A deletion cutoff is an inventory boundary, not an exclusion for later discovered descendants. Copy/purge evidence must name its physical class and limits. A historical revision may be inaccessible while its safe audit metadata remains interpretable; that does not authorize reconstituting deleted content from an old index or backup.

sections.heading: Amendment and migration contract
sections.html:
Amendment and migration contract

DESIGN PROPOSAL. CS1 proposes this finite amendment set; none is silently applied to the earlier documents:

  1. In 01, remove lifecycle state from immutable business-version bytes, introduce intrinsic LifecycleStatus, distinguish business and lifecycle heads, and bind exact acceptance/current checks as above. Preserve common identity, immutable Ref, canonical bytes, events, independent receipt and command-result rules.
  2. In 02, retain release/claim/receipt bodies and their proof ordering; change mutable reconciliation/restriction/status references to exact lifecycle decisions. Current-check transactions join business and lifecycle heads plus live epochs. OperationStatus remains a response projection.
  3. In 03–09 and their machine catalogs, retain source capability/procedure meaning and source question answers, but map output acceptance/transfer/reconciliation fields into typed lifecycle links. Keep child evidence and predeclared launch bindings in immutable inputs. Resolve Evaluation/Budget/Handoff and source aliases through explicit field maps.
  4. In 10's component contracts, replace any “record.state” read with the joined authoritative lifecycle read. Component ownership does not change. C02 dispatches, the relevant domain/control owner decides, C06 judges evidence, C04 releases and C08 establishes recovery truth.

SPECIFICATION — added by the F2 join (R-X02). The amendment-and-migration contract covers an alias table, and no candidate-era name is admissible as a record name. The F2 round produced five candidate designs, four of which proposed renaming existing registry records — WorkRecord, Procedure, Step, Journal and others — which would have left roughly a hundred dangling registry references with no migration, at irreversible tier. Nothing is renamed. New content lands as fields on existing records, and an alias table publishes every candidate-era name against its registry name. The table is part of this contract, not documentation beside it: a candidate-era name is never admitted as a record name, kernel.record.register rejects one exactly as it rejects any arbitrary record name, and an alias resolves to its registry name for reading only. Unknown or ambiguous alias mappings remain restricted, which is the rule the paragraph below already states for migration and which applies here unchanged.

SPECIFICATION. A migration freezes affected writers and admissions, captures the complete old business/status/unknown-hold frontier, and uses an exact versioned identity/field mapping. Old history remains byte-addressable under its original schema. The converter extracts the old payload and lifecycle/output-link fields into version 2.0 objects and records source evidence. It must not assert that an old judgment now matches newly constructed content: such judgments are historical unless a competent fresh assessment accepts the exact converted business revision. Unknown or ambiguous alias mappings remain restricted.

SPECIFICATION. During the fence, old unreleased preparations using obsolete state/meaning/issuer definitions are invalidated. Combined conflict scopes retain all old unknown holds and order admission before resumption. Reader/writer compatibility, current subject/lifecycle indexes, deletion policy, evidence closure and exact native reconciliation are tested before activation. There is no in-place rewrite of old signed bytes or a rollback that restores revoked permission, erases business effects or forgets old unknowns.

sections.heading: Conformance cases and limits
sections.html:
Conformance cases and limits

SPECIFICATION. These are specification obligations, with synthetic pure-logic checks distinguished from future integration/operating tests:

Every row below is SPECIFICATION; a cell states its own kind where it differs.

CaseRequired result

Edit a requirement after assessmentNew business revision starts unaccepted; prior judgment remains historical and fails the new subject guard.
Race content edit with acceptanceOne subject-head CAS wins; loser conflicts. No revision receives a judgment of different bytes.
Replay an old accepted projection/statusCurrent authoritative heads and epochs prevail; no resurrection.
Complete inconclusive assessment of uncertaintyJudgment may be completed-inconclusive; subject launch/product acceptance fails. Acceptance of a report about uncertainty only accepts that report predicate.
Distinct product, formation, delivery and support launch childrenExact complete bijection succeeds; missing/duplicate/wrong/stale child, wrong predicate arguments or self-support fails.
First venture and pre-sale delivery checkNo invented customers or SalesAgreement; actual performer/access/material/window/continuity check can verify capacity. Unknown demand permits the internal provisional price path.
Actual scoped interview researchResearch activity prerequisites apply; an unrelated Offer/ProductSpec/product delivery requirement is not introduced.
